vulgate_text: prajāpati samaḥ śrīmān dhatā ripu niṣūdanaḥ / rakṣitā jīvalokasya dharmasya pari rakṣitā
ce_text: rakṣitā jīvalokasya dharmasya parirakṣitā / vedavedāṅgatattvajño dhanurvede ca niṣṭhitaḥ

vulgate_text: jyeṣṭam śreṣṭa guṇaiḥ yuktam priyam daśarathaḥ sutam / prakṛtīnām hitaiḥ yuktam prakṛti priya kāmyayā
ce_text: jyeṣṭhaṃ śreṣṭhaguṇair yuktaṃ priyaṃ daśarathaḥ sutam / yauvarājyena saṃyoktum aicchat prītyā mahīpatiḥ

vulgate_text: janakasya kule jātā deva māyeva nirmitā / sarva lakṣaṇa saṃpannā nārīṇām uttamā vadhūḥ
ce_text: sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannā nārīṇām uttamā vadhūḥ / sītāpy anugatā rāmaṃ śaśinaṃ rohiṇī yathā

vulgate_text: śṛngibera pure sūtam gaṃgā kūle vyasarjayat / guham āsādya dharmātmā niṣāda adhipatim priyam
ce_text: paurair anugato dūraṃ pitrā daśarathena ca / śṛṅgaverapure sūtaṃ gaṅgākūle vyasarjayat

vulgate_text: guheana sahito rāmo lakṣmaṇena ca sītayā / te vanena vanam gatvā nadīḥ tīrtvā bahu udakāḥ
ce_text: te vanena vanaṃ gatvā nadīs tīrtvā bahūdakāḥ / citrakūṭam anuprāpya bharadvājasya śāsanāt

vulgate_text: na ca icchat pitur ādeśāt rājyam rāmo mahābalaḥ / pāduke ca asya rājyāya nyāsam dattvā punaḥ punaḥ
ce_text: pāduke cāsya rājyāya nyāsaṃ dattvā punaḥ punaḥ / nivartayām āsa tato bharataṃ bharatāgrajaḥ

vulgate_text: nandi grāme akarot rājyam rāma āgamana kāṃkṣayā / gate tu bharate śrīmān satya sandho jitendriyaḥ
ce_text: sa kāmam anavāpyaiva rāmapādāv upaspṛśan / nandigrāme 'karod rājyaṃ rāmāgamanakāṅkṣayā

vulgate_text: praviśya tu mahāaraṇyam rāmo rājīva locanaḥ / virādham rākṣasam hatvā śarabhaṃgam dadarśa ha
ce_text: virādhaṃ rākṣasaṃ hatvā śarabhaṅgaṃ dadarśa ha / sutīkṣṇaṃ cāpy agastyaṃ ca agastya bhrātaraṃ tathā

vulgate_text: sutīkṣṇam ca api agastyam ca agastya bhrātaram tathā / agastya vacanāt ca eva jagrāha aindram śarāsanam
ce_text: agastyavacanāc caiva jagrāhaindraṃ śarāsanam / khaḍgaṃ ca paramaprītas tūṇī cākṣayasāyakau

vulgate_text: ṛṣayaḥ abhyāgaman sarve vadhāya asura rakṣasām / sa teṣām prati śuśrāva rākṣasānām tathā vane
ce_text: vasatas tasya rāmasya vane vanacaraiḥ saha / ṛṣayo 'bhyāgaman sarve vadhāyāsurarakṣasām

vulgate_text: nijaghāna raṇe rāmaḥ teṣām ca eva pada anugān / vane tasmin nivasatā janasthāna nivāsinām
ce_text: nijaghāna raṇe rāmas teṣāṃ caiva padānugān / rakṣasāṃ nihatāny āsan sahasrāṇi caturdaśa

vulgate_text: cakāra sakhyam rāmeṇa prītaḥ ca eva agni sākṣikam / tato vānara rājena vaira anukathanam prati
ce_text: tato vānararājena vairānukathanaṃ prati / rāmāyāveditaṃ sarvaṃ praṇayād duḥkhitena ca / vālinaś ca balaṃ tatra kathayām āsa vānaraḥ

vulgate_text: rāghavaḥ pratyayārtham tu duṃdubheḥ kāyam uttamam / darśayāmāsa sugrīvaḥ mahāparvata saṃnibham
ce_text: rāghavaḥ pratyayārthaṃ tu dundubheḥ kāyam uttamam / pādāṅguṣṭhena cikṣepa saṃpūrṇaṃ daśayojanam

vulgate_text: utsmayitvā mahābāhuḥ prekṣya ca asti mahābalaḥ / pāda aṃguṣṭena cikṣepa saṃpūrṇam daśa yojanam
ce_text: rāghavaḥ pratyayārthaṃ tu dundubheḥ kāyam uttamam / pādāṅguṣṭhena cikṣepa saṃpūrṇaṃ daśayojanam

vulgate_text: tena gatvā purīm laṃkām hatvā rāvaṇam āhave / rāmaḥ sītām anuprāpya parām vrīḍām upāgamat
ce_text: tena gatvā purīṃ laṅkāṃ hatvā rāvaṇam āhave / abhyaṣiñcat sa laṅkāyāṃ rākṣasendraṃ vibhīṣaṇam

vulgate_text: tataḥ agni vacanāt sītām jñātvā vigata kalmaṣām / karmaṇā tena mahatā trailokyam sa carācaram
ce_text: karmaṇā tena mahatā trailokyaṃ sacarācaram / sadevarṣigaṇaṃ tuṣṭaṃ rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: sa devarṣi gaṇam tuṣṭam rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ / babhau rāmaḥ saṃprahṛṣṭaḥ pūjitaḥ sarva devataiḥ
ce_text: karmaṇā tena mahatā trailokyaṃ sacarācaram / sadevarṣigaṇaṃ tuṣṭaṃ rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: devatābhyo varām prāpya samutthāpya ca vānarān / ayodhyām prasthitaḥ rāmaḥ puṣpakeṇa suhṛt vṛtaḥ
ce_text: devatābhyo varān prāpya samutthāpya ca vānarān / puṣpakaṃ tat samāruhya nandigrāmaṃ yayau tadā

vulgate_text: punaḥ ākhyāyikām jalpan sugrīva sahitaḥ tadā / puṣpakam tat samārūhya naṃdigrāmam yayau tadā
ce_text: devatābhyo varān prāpya samutthāpya ca vānarān / puṣpakaṃ tat samāruhya nandigrāmaṃ yayau tadā

vulgate_text: na ca agnijam bhayam kincit na apsu majjanti jantavaḥ / na vātajam bhayam kincit na api jvara kṛtam tathā
ce_text: na vātajaṃ bhayaṃ kiṃ cin nāpsu majjanti jantavaḥ / na cāgrijaṃ bhayaṃ kiṃ cid yathā kṛtayuge tathā

vulgate_text: nityam pramuditāḥ sarve yathā kṛta yuge tathā / aśvamedha śataiḥ iṣṭvā tathā bahu suvarṇakaiḥ
ce_text: aśvamedhaśatair iṣṭvā tathā bahusuvarṇakaiḥ / gavāṃ koṭyayutaṃ dattvā vidvadbhyo vidhipūrvakam

vulgate_text: gavām koṭyayutam dattvā vidvabhyo vidhi pūrvakam / asaṃkhyeyam dhanam dattvā brāhmaṇebho mahāyaśāḥ
ce_text: aśvamedhaśatair iṣṭvā tathā bahusuvarṇakaiḥ / gavāṃ koṭyayutaṃ dattvā vidvadbhyo vidhipūrvakam

vulgate_text: brahmaṇā samanujñātaḥ so'pi upāviśat āsane / upaviṣṭe tadā tasmin sākṣāt loka pitāmahe
ce_text: upaviṣṭe tadā tasmin sākṣāl lokapitāmahe / tad gatenaiva manasā vālmīkir dhyānam āsthitaḥ

vulgate_text: pādukā agrya abhiṣekam ca nandi grāma nivāsanam / daṇḍakāraṇya gamanam virādhasya vadham tathā
ce_text: pādukāgryābhiṣekaṃ ca nandigrāma nivāsanam / daṇḍakāraṇyagamanaṃ sutīkṣṇena samāgamam

vulgate_text: darśanam śarabhaṅgasya sutīkṣṇena samāgamam / anasūyā samākhyā ca aṅgarāgsya ca arpaṇam
ce_text: anasūyāsamasyāṃ ca aṅgarāgasya cārpaṇam / śūrpaṇakhyāś ca saṃvādaṃ virūpakaraṇaṃ tathā

vulgate_text: darśanam ca api agastyasya dhanuṣo grahaṇam tathā / śūrpaṇakhāḥ ca saṃvādam virūpakaraṇam tathā
ce_text: anasūyāsamasyāṃ ca aṅgarāgasya cārpaṇam / śūrpaṇakhyāś ca saṃvādaṃ virūpakaraṇaṃ tathā

vulgate_text: śabarī darśanam ca eva phala mūla aśanam tathā / pralāpam ca eva pampāyam hanumad darśanam
ce_text: śarbaryā darśanaṃ caiva hanūmaddarśanaṃ tathā / vilāpaṃ caiva pampāyāṃ rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: parvata ārohaṇam ca api sāgarsya api laṅghanam / samudra vacanāt ca eva mainākasya ca darśanam
ce_text: parvatārohaṇaṃ caiva sāgarasya ca laṅghanam / rātrau laṅkāpraveśaṃ ca ekasyāpi vicintanam

vulgate_text: darśanam rāvaṇasya api puṣpakasya ca darśanam / aśoka vanikāyānam sītāyāḥ ca api darśanam
ce_text: āpānabhūmigamanam avarodhasya darśanam / aśokavanikāyānaṃ sītāyāś cāpi darśanam

vulgate_text: preṣaṇam vāyu putrasya bharatena samāgamam / rāma abhiṣeka abhyudayam sarva sainya visarjanam / sva rāṣṭra raṃjanam ca eva vaidehyāḥ ca visarjanam
ce_text: rāmābhiṣekābhyudayaṃ sarvasainyavisarjanam / svarāṣṭrarañjanaṃ caiva vaidehyāś ca visarjanam

vulgate_text: madhye sabham samīpasthau idam kāvyam agāyatām / tat śrutvā munayaḥ sarve bāṣpa paryākulekṣaṇāḥ
ce_text: tac chrutvā munayaḥ sarve bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇāḥ / sādhu sādhv ity tāv ūcatuḥ paraṃ vismayam āgatāḥ

vulgate_text: prasanno valkalam kaścid dadau tābhyām mahāyaśāḥ / anyaḥ kṛṣṇājinam adad yajña sūtram tathā aparaḥ
ce_text: prītaḥ kaś cin munis tābhyāṃ saṃsthitaḥ kalaśaṃ dadau / prasanno valkalaṃ kaś cid dadau tābhyāṃ mahāyaśāḥ

vulgate_text: daduḥ ca evam varān sarve munayaḥ satyavādinaḥ / āścaryam idam ākhyānam muninā saṃprakīrtitam
ce_text: āścaryam idam ākhyānaṃ muninā saṃprakīrtitam / paraṃ kavīnām ādhāraṃ samāptaṃ ca yathākramam

vulgate_text: param kavīnām ādhāram samāptam ca yathā kramam / abhigītam idam gītam sarva gīteṣu kovidau
ce_text: āścaryam idam ākhyānaṃ muninā saṃprakīrtitam / paraṃ kavīnām ādhāraṃ samāptaṃ ca yathākramam

vulgate_text: āyuṣyam puṣṭi jananam sarva śruti manoharam / praśasyamānau sarvatra kadācit tatra gāyakau
ce_text: praśasyamānau sarvatra kadā cit tatra gāyakau / rathyāsu rājamārgeṣu dadarśa bharatāgrajaḥ

vulgate_text: upopaviṣṭaiḥ sacivaiḥ bhrātṛbhiḥ ca samanvita / dṛṣṭvā tu rūpa saṃpannau vinītau bhrātarau ubhau
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā tu rūpasaṃpannau tāv ubhau vīṇinau tataḥ / uvāca lakṣmaṇaṃ rāmaḥ śatrughnaṃ bharataṃ tathā

vulgate_text: vicitrārtha padam samyak gāyakau samacodayat / tau ca api madhuram raktam svacittāyata niḥsvanam
ce_text: śrūyatām idam ākhyānam anayor devavarcasoḥ / vicitrārthapadaṃ samyag gāyator madhurasvaram

vulgate_text: na anāhita agnīḥ na ayajvā na kṣudro vā na taskaraḥ / kaścit asīt ayodhyāyām na ca āvṛtto na saṃkaraḥ
ce_text: nānāhitāgnir nāyajvā vipro nāpy asahasradaḥ / kaś cid āsīd ayodhyāyāṃ na ca nirvṛttasaṃkaraḥ

vulgate_text: na aṣaḍaṃga vit na asti na avrato na asahasradaḥ / na dīnaḥ kṣipta cittao vā vyathito vā api kaścana
ce_text: na dīnaḥ kṣiptacitto vā vyathito vāpi kaś cana / kaś cin naro vā nārī vā nāśrīmān nāpy arūpavān / draṣṭuṃ śakyam ayodhyāyāṃ nāpi rājanyabhaktimān

vulgate_text: varṇeṣu agrya caturtheṣu devatā atithi pūjakāḥ / kṛtajñāḥ ca vadānyaḥ ca śūrā vikrama saṃyutāḥ
ce_text: varṇeṣv agryacaturtheṣu devatātithipūjakāḥ / dīrghāyuṣo narāḥ sarve dharmaṃ satyaṃ ca saṃśritāḥ

vulgate_text: dīrgha āyuṣo narāḥ sarve dharmam satyam ca saṃśritāḥ / sahitāḥ putra pautraiḥ ca nityam strībhiḥ purottame
ce_text: varṇeṣv agryacaturtheṣu devatātithipūjakāḥ / dīrghāyuṣo narāḥ sarve dharmaṃ satyaṃ ca saṃśritāḥ

vulgate_text: irāvata kulīnaiḥ ca mahāpadma kulaiḥ tathā / aṃjanādapi niṣkrāntaiḥ vāmanādapi ca dvipaiḥ
ce_text: añjanād api niṣkrāntair vāmanād api ca dvipaiḥ / bhadramandrair bhadramṛgair mṛgamandraiś ca sā purī

vulgate_text: bhadraiḥ mandraiḥ mṛgaiḥ ca eva bhadra mandra mṛgaiḥ thathā / bhadra mandraiḥ bhadra mṛgaiḥ mṛga mandraiḥ ca sā purī
ce_text: añjanād api niṣkrāntair vāmanād api ca dvipaiḥ / bhadramandrair bhadramṛgair mṛgamandraiś ca sā purī

vulgate_text: dhṛṣṭir jayanto vijayo surāṣṭro rāṣṭra vardhanaḥ / akopo dharmapālaḥ ca sumaṃtraḥ ca aṣṭamo arthavit
ce_text: dhṛṣṭir jayanto vijayaḥ siddhārtho arthasādhakaḥ / aśoko mantrapālaś ca sumantraś cāṣṭamo 'bhavat

vulgate_text: avekṣamāṇaḥ cāreṇa prajā dharmeṇa rakṣayan / prajānām pālanam kurvan adharmam parivarjayan
ce_text: avekṣamāṇaś cāreṇa prajā dharmeṇa rañjayan / nādhyagacchad viśiṣṭaṃ vā tulyaṃ vā śatrum ātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: na adhyagacchat viśiṣṭam vā tulyam vā śatrum ātmanaḥ / mitravān nata sāmantaḥ pratāpa hata kaṇṭakaḥ / sa śaśāsa jagat rājā divi deva patir yathā
ce_text: avekṣamāṇaś cāreṇa prajā dharmeṇa rañjayan / nādhyagacchad viśiṣṭaṃ vā tulyaṃ vā śatrum ātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: tat aham yaṣṭum icchami śāstra dṛṣṭena karmaṇā / katham prāpsyāmi aham kāmam buddhiḥ atra vicintyatām
ce_text: tad ahaṃ yaṣṭum icchāmi śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā / ṛṣiputraprabhāvena kāmān prāpsyāmi cāpy aham

vulgate_text: ūcuḥ ca parama prītāḥ sarve daśaratham vacaḥ / saṃbhārāḥ saṃbhriyaṃtām te turagaḥ ca vimucyatām
ce_text: tatheti ca sa rājānam uvāca ca susatkṛtaḥ / saṃbhārāḥ saṃbhriyantāṃ te turagaś ca vimucyatām

vulgate_text: sarayvāḥ ca uttare tīre yajña bhūmir vidhīyatām / sarvathā prāpsyase putrān abhipretān ca pārthiva
ce_text: sarayvāś cottare tīre yajñabhūmir vidhīyatām / śāntayaś cābhivardhantāṃ yathākalpaṃ yathāvidhi

vulgate_text: amātyān abravīt rājā harṣa paryākula locana / saṃbhārāḥ saṃbhriyaṃtām me gurūṇām vacanāt iha
ce_text: gurūṇāṃ vacanāc chīghraṃ saṃbhārāḥ saṃbhriyantu me / samarthādhiṣṭhitaś cāśvaḥ sopādhyāyo vimucyatām

vulgate_text: pārthivendrasya tad vākyam yathā pūrvam niśamya te / tathā dvijāḥ te dharmajñā varthayato nṛpottamam
ce_text: tatheti ca tataḥ sarve mantriṇaḥ pratyapūjayan / pārthivendrasya tad vākyaṃ yathājñaptam akurvata

vulgate_text: anujñātāḥ tataḥ sarve punar jagmur yathā āgatam / visarjayitvā tān viprān sacivān idam abravīt
ce_text: tato dvijās te dharmajñam astuvan pārthivarṣabham / anujñātās tataḥ sarve punar jagmur yathāgatam

vulgate_text: visarjayitvā svam veśma praviveśa mahāmatiḥ / tataḥ sa gatvā tāḥ patnīr narendro hṛdayaṃgamāḥ
ce_text: gatānāṃ tu dvijātīnāṃ mantriṇas tān narādhipaḥ / visarjayitvā svaṃ veśma praviveśa mahādyutiḥ

vulgate_text: etat śrutvā rahaḥ sūto rājānam idam abravīt / śrūyatām tat purā vṛttam purāṇe ca mayā śrutam
ce_text: etac chrutvā rahaḥ sūto rājānam idam abravīt / ṛtvigbhir upadiṣṭo 'yaṃ purāvṛtto mayā śrutaḥ

vulgate_text: samādiśantu niyamam prāyaścittam yathā bhavet / iti uktāḥ te tato rājñā sarve brāhmaṇa sattamāḥ
ce_text: bhavantaḥ śrutadharmāṇo lokacāritravedinaḥ / samādiśantu niyamaṃ prāyaścittaṃ yathā bhavet

vulgate_text: atha hṛṣṭo daśarathaḥ sumaṃtram pratyabhāṣata / yathā ṛṣyaśṛṅgaḥ tu ānīto yena upāyena sa uccatām
ce_text: atha hṛṣṭo daśarathaḥ sumantraṃ pratyabhāṣata / yatharṣyaśṛṅgas tv ānīto vistareṇa tvayocyatām

vulgate_text: sumaṃtraḥ codito rājñā provāca idam vacaḥ tadā / yathā ṛṣyaśṛṅgaḥ tu ānīto yena upāyena maṃtribhiḥtanme nigaditam sarvam śṛṇu me maṃtribhiḥ saha
ce_text: sumantraś codito rājñā provācedaṃ vacas tadā / yatharṣyaśṛṅgas tv ānītaḥ śṛṇu me mantribhiḥ saha

vulgate_text: ṛṣi putra vacaḥ śrutvā sarvāsām matirāsa vai / tat āśrama padam draṣṭum jagmuḥ sarvāḥ tato aṃganaḥ
ce_text: ṛṣiputravacaḥ śrutvā sarvāsāṃ matir āsa vai / tad āśramapadaṃ draṣṭuṃ jagmuḥ sarvāś ca tena ha

vulgate_text: tato'pare dyuḥ tam deśam ājagāma sa vīryavān / vibhāṇḍaka sutaḥ śrīmān manasā vicintayan muhuḥ
ce_text: tato 'paredyus taṃ deśam ājagāma sa vīryavān / manojñā yatra tā dṛṣṭā vāramukhyāḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥ

vulgate_text: sumaṃtrasya vacaḥ śrutvā hṛṣṭo daśaratho'bhavat / anumānya vasiṣṭham ca sūtavākyam niśāmya ca
ce_text: anumānya vasiṣṭhaṃ ca sūtavākyaṃ niśamya ca / sāntaḥpuraḥ sahāmātyaḥ prayayau yatra sa dvijaḥ

vulgate_text: dhūpitam sikta sammṛṣṭam patākābhiḥ alaṃkṛtam / tataḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ paurāḥ te śrutvā rājānam āgatam
ce_text: tataḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ paurās te śrutvā rājānam āgatam / tathā pracakrus tat sarvaṃ rājñā yat preṣitaṃ tadā

vulgate_text: praveśyamānam satkṛtya narendreṇa indra karmaṇā / yathā divi surendreṇa sahasrākṣeṇa kāśyapam
ce_text: tataḥ pramuditāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā taṃ nāgarā dvijam / praveśyamānaṃ satkṛtya narendreṇendrakarmaṇā

vulgate_text: saravyāḥ ca uttare tīre yajña bhūmiḥ vidhīyatām / tato abravīt nṛpaḥ vākyam brāhmaṇān veda pāragān
ce_text: sarayvāś cottare tīre yajñabhūmir vidhīyatām / śāntayaś cābhivardhantāṃ yathākalpaṃ yathāvidhi

vulgate_text: gateṣu teṣu vipreṣu maṃtriṇaḥ tān narādhipaḥ / visarjayitvā svam veśma praviveśa mahāmatiḥ
ce_text: gatānāṃ tu dvijātīnāṃ mantriṇas tān narādhipaḥ / visarjayitvā svaṃ veśma praviveśa mahādyutiḥ

vulgate_text: punaḥ prāpte vasante tu pūrṇaḥ saṃvatsaro'bhavat / prasavārtham gato yaṣṭum hayamedhena vīryavān
ce_text: punaḥ prāpte vasante tu pūrṇaḥ saṃvatsaro 'bhavat / abhivādya vasiṣṭhaṃ ca nyāyataḥ pratipūjya ca

vulgate_text: tathā paura janasya api kartavyāḥ ca suvistarāḥ / āgatānām sudūrāt ca pārthivānām pṛthak pṛthak

vulgate_text: kṛtārtho asmi mahābāho kṛtam guru vacaḥ tvayā / siddhāśramam idam satyam kṛtam vīra mahāyaśaḥ / sa hi rāmam praśasya evam tābhyām saṃdhyām upāgamat
ce_text: kṛtārtho 'smi mahābāho kṛtaṃ guruvacas tvayā / siddhāśramam idaṃ satyaṃ kṛtaṃ rāma mahāyaśaḥ

vulgate_text: iti uktvā muniśārdūlaḥ kauśikaḥ sa tapodhanaḥ / uttarām diśam uddiśya prasthātum upacakrame
ce_text: pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā siddhāśramam anuttamam / uttarāṃ diśam uddiśya prasthātum upacakrame

vulgate_text: nivartayāmāsa tataḥ sa ṛsi sanghaḥ sa pakṣiṇaḥ / te gatvā dūram adhvānam lambamāne divākare
ce_text: te gatvā dūram adhvānaṃ lambamāne divākare / vāsaṃ cakrur munigaṇāḥ śoṇākūle samāhitāḥ

vulgate_text: brahma yonir mahān āsīt kuśo nāma mahātapāḥ / akliṣṭa vrata dharmajñaḥ sajjana prati pūjakaḥ
ce_text: brahmayonir mahān āsīt kuśo nāma mahātapāḥ / vaidarbhyāṃ janayām āsa caturaḥ sadṛśān sutān / kuśāmbaṃ kuśanābhaṃ ca ādhūrtarajasaṃ vasum

vulgate_text: sa mahātmā kulīnāyām yuktāyām sumahābalān / vaidarbhyām janayām āsa caturaḥ sadṛśān sutān
ce_text: brahmayonir mahān āsīt kuśo nāma mahātapāḥ / vaidarbhyāṃ janayām āsa caturaḥ sadṛśān sutān / kuśāmbaṃ kuśanābhaṃ ca ādhūrtarajasaṃ vasum

vulgate_text: tāḥ kanyā vāyunā bhagnā viviśur nṛpateḥ gṛham / praviśya ca susaṃbhrāntāḥ sa lajjāḥ sa asra locana
ce_text: tāḥ kanyā vāyunā bhagnā viviśur nṛpater gṛham / dṛṣṭvā bhagnās tadā rājā saṃbhrānta idam abravīt

vulgate_text: sa ca tā dayitā bhagnāḥ kanyāḥ parama śobhanāḥ / dṛṣṭvā dīnāḥ tadā rājā saṃbhrāṃta idam abravīt
ce_text: tāḥ kanyā vāyunā bhagnā viviśur nṛpater gṛham / dṛṣṭvā bhagnās tadā rājā saṃbhrānta idam abravīt

vulgate_text: kim idam kathyatām putryaḥ ko dharmam avamanyate / kubjāḥ kena kṛtāḥ sarvāḥ ceṣṭantyo na abhibhāṣatha / evam rājā viniḥśvasya samādhim saṃdadhe tataḥ
ce_text: kim idaṃ kathyatāṃ putryaḥ ko dharmam avamanyate / kubjāḥ kena kṛtāḥ sarvā veṣṭantyo nābhibhāṣatha

vulgate_text: somadā api sutam dṛṣṭvā putrasya sadṛśīm kriyām / yathā nyāyam ca gandharvī snuṣāḥ tāḥ pratyanaṃdata / spṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā ca tāḥ kanyāḥ kuśanābham praśasya ca
ce_text: somadāpi susaṃhṛṣṭā putrasya sadṛśīṃ kriyām / yathānyāyaṃ ca gandharvī snuṣās tāḥ pratyanandata

vulgate_text: viśvāmitram mahātmānam parivārya samaṃtataḥ / viṣṭitāḥ ca yathā nyāyam rāghavo ca yathā arham / saṃprahṛṣṭa manā rāmo viśvāmitram atha abravīt
ce_text: viviśur jāhnavītīre śucau muditamānasāḥ / viśvāmitraṃ mahātmānaṃ parivārya samantataḥ

vulgate_text: etat te sarvam ākhyātam yathā tri patha gāminī / kham gatā prathamam tāta gatim gatimatām vara
ce_text: etat te dharmam ākhyātaṃ yathā tripathagā nadī / khaṃ gatā prathamaṃ tāta gatiṃ gatimatāṃ vara

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā ca bhagavān devīm maithunāya upacakrame / tasya saṃkrīḍamānasya mahādevasya dhīmataḥ / śitikaṇṭhasya devasya divyam varṣa śatam gatam
ce_text: purā rāma kṛtodvāhaḥ śitikaṇṭho mahātapāḥ / dṛṣṭvā ca spṛhayā devīṃ maithunāyopacakrame

vulgate_text: na ca api tanayo rāma tasyām āsīt paraṃtapa / sarve devāḥ samudyuktāḥ pitāmaha purogamāḥ
ce_text: śitikaṇṭhasya devasya divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ gatam / na cāpi tanayo rāma tasyām āsīt paraṃtapa

vulgate_text: yatra jāto mahātejāḥ kārtikeyo agni saṃbhavaḥ / atha umām ca śivam caiva devāḥ sa ṛṣi gaṇāḥ tadā
ce_text: tad agninā punar vyāptaṃ saṃjātaḥ śvetaparvataḥ / divyaṃ śaravaṇaṃ caiva pāvakādityasaṃnibham / yatra jāto mahātejāḥ kārtikeyo 'gnisaṃbhavaḥ

vulgate_text: tapyamāne tadā deve sa indrāḥ sa agni purogamāḥ / senāpatim abhīpsantaḥ pitāmaham upāgaman
ce_text: tapyamāne tapo deve devāḥ sarṣigaṇāḥ purā / senāpatim abhīpsantaḥ pitāmaham upāgaman

vulgate_text: ariṣṭhanemi duhitā suparṇa bhaginī tu sā / dvitīyā sagarasya āsīt patnī sumati saṃjñitā
ce_text: ariṣṭanemiduhitā rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi / dvitīyā sagarasyāsīt patnī sumatisaṃjñitā

vulgate_text: prakṣipya prahasan nityam majjatas tān nirīkṣya vai / evam pāpa samācāraḥ sajjana pratibādhakaḥ
ce_text: sa ca jyeṣṭho naraśreṣṭha sagarasyātmasaṃbhavaḥ / bālān gṛhītvā tu jale sarayvā raghunandana / prakṣipya prahasan nityaṃ majjatas tān nirīkṣya vai

vulgate_text: tasya tat vacanam śrutvā kautūhala samanvitaḥ / viśvāmitraḥ tu kākutstham uvāca prahasanniva
ce_text: viśvāmitras tu kākutstham uvāca prahasann iva / śrūyatāṃ vistaro rāma sagarasya mahātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: viṃdhya parvatam āsādya nirīkṣete parasparam / tayor madhye saṃbhavat yajñaḥ sa puruṣottama
ce_text: śaṃkaraśvaśuro nāma himavān acalottamaḥ / vindhyaparvatam āsādya nirīkṣete parasparam

vulgate_text: yasya iyam vasudhā kṛtsnā vāsudevasya dhīmataḥ / mahiṣī mādhavasaya sa eṣā sa eva bhagavan prabhuḥ
ce_text: yasyeyaṃ vasudhā kṛtsnā vāsudevasya dhīmataḥ / kāpilaṃ rūpam āsthāya dhārayaty aniśaṃ dharām

vulgate_text: kāpilam rūpam āsthāya dhārayatya aniśam dharām / tasya kopāgninā dagdhā bhaviṣyaṃti nṛpātmajā
ce_text: yasyeyaṃ vasudhā kṛtsnā vāsudevasya dhīmataḥ / kāpilaṃ rūpam āsthāya dhārayaty aniśaṃ dharām

vulgate_text: te tu sarve mahatmāno bhimavega mahabalāḥ / dadṛśuḥ kapilam tatra vāsudevam sanātanam
ce_text: dadṛśuḥ kapilaṃ tatra vāsudevaṃ sanātanam / hayaṃ ca tasya devasya carantam avidūrataḥ

vulgate_text: hayam ca tasya devasya carantam avidūrataḥ / praharṣam atulam praptaḥ sarve te raghunaṃdana
ce_text: dadṛśuḥ kapilaṃ tatra vāsudevaṃ sanātanam / hayaṃ ca tasya devasya carantam avidūrataḥ

vulgate_text: diśā gajaḥ tu tat śrutvā pratyuvāca mahāmatiḥ / āsamaṃja kṛtārthaḥ tvam saha aśvaḥ śīghram eṣyasi
ce_text: diśāgajas tu tac chrutvā prītyāhāṃśumato vacaḥ / āsamañjakṛtārthas tvaṃ sahāśvaḥ śīghram eṣyasi

vulgate_text: sa teṣām rāja putrāṇām kartu kāmo jala kriyām / sa jalārtham mahātejā na ca apaśyat jala āśayam
ce_text: dadarśa puruṣavyāghro kartukāmo jalakriyām / salilārthī mahātejā na cāpaśyaj jalāśayam

vulgate_text: gaṃgā himavato jyeṣṭhā duhitā puruṣarṣabha / tasyām kuru mahābāho pitṝṇām tu jala kriyām
ce_text: gaṅgā himavato jyeṣṭhā duhitā puruṣarṣabha / bhasmarāśīkṛtān etān pāvayel lokapāvanī

vulgate_text: katham gaṃgā avataraṇam katham teṣāṃ jalakriyā / tārayeyam katham ca etān iti ciṃtāparo abhavat
ce_text: kathaṃ gaṅgāvataraṇaṃ kathaṃ teṣāṃ jalakriyā / tārayeyaṃ kathaṃ caitān iti cintā paro 'bhavat

vulgate_text: maṃtriṣu ādhāya tat rajyam gaṅga avataraṇe rataḥ / tapo dīrgham samātiṣṭhat gokarṇe raghunaṃdana
ce_text: sa tapo dīrgham ātiṣṭhad gokarṇe raghunandana / ūrdhvabāhuḥ pañcatapā māsāhāro jitendriyaḥ

vulgate_text: atītāni mahabaho tasya rājño mahātmanaḥ / suprīto bhagavān brahmā prajānām patiḥ īśvaraḥ
ce_text: tasya varṣasahasrāṇi ghore tapasi tiṣṭhataḥ / suprīto bhagavān brahmā prajānāṃ patir īśvaraḥ

vulgate_text: bhagīratha mahārāja prītaḥ te aham janādhipa / tapasā ca sutaptena varam varaya suvrata
ce_text: bhagīratha mahābhāga prītas te 'haṃ janeśvara / tapasā ca sutaptena varaṃ varaya suvrata

vulgate_text: deva yāce ha saṃtatyai na avasīdet kulam ca naḥ / ikṣvākūṇām kule deva eṣa me astu varaḥ paraḥ
ce_text: deyā ca saṃtatir deva nāvasīdet kulaṃ ca naḥ / ikṣvākūṇāṃ kule deva eṣa me 'stu varaḥ paraḥ

vulgate_text: ākāśāt apatat rāma śive śiva śirasy uta / acintayaḥ ca sā devī gaṃga parama durdharā
ce_text: tato haimavatī jyeṣṭhā sarvalokanamaskṛtā / tadā sātimahad rūpaṃ kṛtvā vegaṃ ca duḥsaham / ākāśād apatad rāma śive śivaśirasy uta

vulgate_text: tām apaśyan punaḥ tatra tapaḥ paramam āsthitaḥ / sa tena toṣitaḥ ca asīt atyaṃtam raghunaṃdana
ce_text: anena toṣitaś cāsīd atyarthaṃ raghunandana / visasarja tato gaṅgāṃ haro bindusaraḥ prati

vulgate_text: visasarja tato gaṃgām haro bindu saraḥ prati / tasyam visṛujyamānāyām sapta srotaṃsi jajñire
ce_text: anena toṣitaś cāsīd atyarthaṃ raghunandana / visasarja tato gaṅgāṃ haro bindusaraḥ prati

vulgate_text: saptamī ca anvagāt tāsam bhagīratha ratham tadā / bhagīratho api rajarṣi divyam syaṃdanam āsthitaḥ
ce_text: bhagīratho 'pi rājarṣir divyaṃ syandanam āsthitaḥ / prāyād agre mahātejās taṃ gaṅgā pṛṣṭhato 'nvagāt

vulgate_text: prāyāt agre mahātejā gaṃga tam ca api anuvrajat / gaganāt śaṃkara śiraḥ tato dharaṇim āgatā
ce_text: gaganāc chaṃkaraśiras tato dharaṇim āgatā / vyasarpata jalaṃ tatra tīvraśabdapuraskṛtam

vulgate_text: asarpata jalam tatra tīvra śabda puraskṛtam / matsya kacchapa saṃghaiḥ ca śiśumāra gaṇaiḥ tathā
ce_text: gaganāc chaṃkaraśiras tato dharaṇim āgatā / vyasarpata jalaṃ tatra tīvraśabdapuraskṛtam

vulgate_text: patadbhiḥ patitaiḥ ca eva vyarocata vasuṃdharā / tato deva ṛṣi gaṃdharvā yakṣa siddha gaṇāḥ tathā
ce_text: tato devarṣigandharvā yakṣāḥ siddhagaṇās tathā / vyalokayanta te tatra gaganād gāṃ gatāṃ tadā

vulgate_text: kṛtvā tatra abhiṣekam te babhūvuḥ gata kalmaṣāḥ / dhūta pāpāḥ punaḥ tena toyena atha śubha anvitā
ce_text: śāpāt prapatitā ye ca gaganād vasudhātalam / kṛtvā tatrābhiṣekaṃ te babhūvur gatakalmaṣāḥ

vulgate_text: prāyāt agre mahārājāḥ tam gaṃgā pṛṣṭhato anvagāt / devāḥ sa ṛṣi gaṇāḥ sarve daitya dānava rākṣasāḥ
ce_text: devāḥ sarṣigaṇāḥ sarve daityadānavarākṣasāḥ / gandharvayakṣapravarāḥ sakiṃnaramahoragāḥ

vulgate_text: jagāma saritām śreṣṭhā sarva pāpa praṇāśinī / tato hi yajamānasya jahnoḥ adbhuta karmaṇaḥ
ce_text: yato bhagīratho rājā tato gaṅgā yaśasvinī / jagāma saritāṃ śreṣṭhā sarvapāpavināśinī

vulgate_text: jagāma ca punaḥ gaṃga bhagīratha ratha anugā / sāgaram ca api saṃpraptā sā sarit pravarā tadā
ce_text: sarvāś cāpsaraso rāma bhagīratharathānugāḥ / gaṅgām anvagaman prītāḥ sarve jalacarāś ca ye

vulgate_text: dhanyam yaśasyam āyuṣyam putryam svargyam atha api ca / yaḥ śrāvayati vipreṣu kṣatriyeṣu itereṣu ca
ce_text: dhanyaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyaṃ svargyaṃ putryam athāpi ca / idam ākhyānam ākhyātaṃ gaṅgāvataraṇaṃ mayā

vulgate_text: tataḥ teṣām naravyāghraḥ buddhiḥ āsīt mahātmanām / amarā virjarāḥ caiva katham syāmo nirāmayāḥ
ce_text: tatas teṣāṃ naraśreṣṭha buddhir āsīn mahātmanām / amarā nirjarāś caiva kathaṃ syāma nirāmayāḥ

vulgate_text: udatiṣṭhat sudharmātmā sa daṇḍa sa kamaṇduluḥ / pūrvam dhanvantarir nāma apsarāḥ ca su varcasaḥ
ce_text: atha dhanvantarir nāma apsarāś ca suvarcasaḥ / apsu nirmathanād eva rasāt tasmād varastriyaḥ / utpetur manujaśreṣṭha tasmād apsaraso 'bhavan

vulgate_text: mama aparādhāt garbho ayam saptadhā śakalī kṛtaḥ / na aparādho hi deva īśa tava atra balasūdana
ce_text: mamāparādhād garbho 'yaṃ saptadhā viphalīkṛtaḥ / nāparādho 'sti deveśa tavātra balasūdana

vulgate_text: brahma lokam caratu eka indra lokam tathā aparaḥ / divya vāyuḥ iti khyātaḥ tṛtīyo api mahāyaśāḥ
ce_text: brahmalokaṃ caratv eka indralokaṃ tathāparaḥ / divi vāyur iti khyātas tṛtīyo 'pi mahāyaśāḥ

vulgate_text: catvāraḥ tu suraśreṣṭha diśo vai tava śāsanāt / saṃcariṣyanti bhadram te kalena hi mama ātmajāḥ
ce_text: catvāras tu suraśreṣṭha diśo vai tava śāsanāt / saṃcariṣyanti bhadraṃ te devabhūtā mamātmajāḥ / tvatkṛtenaiva nāmnā ca mārutā iti viśrutāḥ

vulgate_text: prayatnāt nirmitām dhātrā divyām māyāmayīm iva / dhūmena abhiparīta aṃgīm dīptāam agni sikhām iva
ce_text: prayatnān nirmitāṃ dhātrā divyāṃ māyāmayīm iva / dhūmenābhiparītāṅgīṃ pūrṇacandraprabhām iva

vulgate_text: śāpasya antam upāgamya teṣām darśanam āgatā / rāghavau tu tataḥ tasyāḥ pādau jagṛhatuḥ mudā
ce_text: rāghavau tu tatas tasyāḥ pādau jagṛhatus tadā / smarantī gautamavacaḥ pratijagrāha sā ca tau

vulgate_text: prati ujjagāma sahasā vinayena samanvitaḥ / ṛtvijo api mahātmānaḥ tu arghyam ādāya sa tvaram
ce_text: ṛtvijo 'pi mahātmānas tv arghyam ādāya satvaram / viśvāmitrāya dharmeṇa dadur mantrapuraskṛtam

vulgate_text: na tvām tyajāmi śabale na api me apakṛtam tvayā / eṣa tvām nayate rājā balāt mattaḥ mahābalaḥ
ce_text: na tvāṃ tyajāmi śabale nāpi me 'pakṛtaṃ tvayā / eṣa tvāṃ nayate rājā balān matto mahābalaḥ

vulgate_text: tasya tat vacanam śrutvā surabhiḥ sā asṛjat tadā / tasyā huṃbhā rava utsṛṣṭāḥ pahlavāḥ śataśo nṛpa
ce_text: tasyā humbhāravotsṛṣṭāḥ pahlavāḥ śataśo nṛpa / nāśayanti balaṃ sarvaṃ viśvāmitrasya paśyataḥ

vulgate_text: nirdagdham tat balam sarvam pradīptaiḥ iva pāvakaiḥ / tato astrāṇi mahātejā viśvāmitro mumoca ha / taiḥ taiḥ yavana kāṃbhojā barbarāḥ ca akulī kṛtāḥ
ce_text: dīrghāsipaṭṭiśadharair hemavarṇāmbarāvṛtaiḥ / nirdagdhaṃ tad balaṃ sarvaṃ pradīptair iva pāvakaiḥ

vulgate_text: avamānam katham kartum tasya śakṣāyāmahe vayam / teṣām tad vacanam śrutvā krodha paryākula akṣaram
ce_text: teṣāṃ tad vacanaṃ śrutvā krodhaparyākulākṣaram / sa rājā punar evaitān idaṃ vacanam abravīt

vulgate_text: tataḥ tat karma siddhi artham putrān tasya gato nṛpaḥ / vāsiṣṭhā dīrgha tapasaḥ tapo yatra hi tepire
ce_text: pratyākhyāto vasiṣṭhena sa yayau dakṣiṇāṃ diśam / vasiṣṭhā dīrgha tapasas tapo yatra hi tepire

vulgate_text: avāg śirāḥ triśaṃkuḥ ca tiṣṭhatu amara saṃnibhaḥ / anuyāsyanti ca etāni jyotīnṣi nṛpa sattamam
ce_text: nakṣatrāṇi muniśreṣṭha teṣu jyotiḥṣu jājvalan / avākśirās triśaṅkuś ca tiṣṭhatv amarasaṃnibhaḥ

vulgate_text: kṛtārtham kīrtimantam ca svarga loka gatam yathā / viśvāmitraḥ tu dharmātmā sarva devaiḥ abhiṣṭutaḥ
ce_text: viśvāmitras tu dharmātmā sarvadevair abhiṣṭutaḥ / ṛṣibhiś ca mahātejā bāḍham ity āha devatāḥ

vulgate_text: ṛṣi madhye mahātejā bāḍham iti āha devatāḥ / tato devā mahātmāno ṛṣayaḥ ca tapo dhanāḥ / jagmuḥ yathā āgatam sarve yajñasya ante narottama
ce_text: tato devā mahātmāno munayaś ca tapodhanāḥ / jagmur yathāgataṃ sarve yajñasyānte narottama

vulgate_text: uvāca nara śārdūlam aṃbarīṣam idam vacaḥ / avikreyam sutam jyeṣṭham bhagavān āha bhārgavaḥ
ce_text: ṛcīkasya vacaḥ śrutvā teṣāṃ mātā mahātmanām / uvāca naraśārdūlam ambarīṣaṃ tapasvinī

vulgate_text: mama api dayitam viddhi kaniṣṭham śunakam prabho / tasmāt kanīyasam putram na dāsye tava pārthiva
ce_text: mamāpi dayitaṃ viddhi kaniṣṭhaṃ śunakaṃ nṛpa

vulgate_text: tapyantam ṛṣibhiḥ sārtham mātulam parama āturaḥ / viṣaṇṇa vadano dīnaḥ tṛṣṇayā ca śrameṇa ca
ce_text: viṣaṇṇavadano dīnas tṛṣṇayā ca śrameṇa ca / papātāṅke mune rāma vākyaṃ cedam uvāca ha

vulgate_text: rāja siṃha mahābuddhe śīghram gacchāvahe vayam / nivartayasva rājendra dīkṣām ca samudāhara
ce_text: rājasiṃha mahāsattva śīghraṃ gacchāvahe sadaḥ / nivartayasva rājendra dīkṣāṃ ca samupāhara

vulgate_text: tato hi me bhayam deva prasādam kartum arhasi / evam uktaḥ tayā rāma sa bhayam bhītayā tadā
ce_text: ayaṃ surapate ghoro viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ / krodham utsrakṣyate ghoraṃ mayi deva na saṃśayaḥ / tato hi me bhayaṃ deva prasādaṃ kartum arhasi

vulgate_text: trai lokyam yena saṃbhrāṃtam ātāpitam iva abhavat / tato devarṣi gandharvāḥ pannaga uraga rākṣasāḥ
ce_text: tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ pannagāsurarākṣasāḥ / mohitās tejasā tasya tapasā mandaraśmayaḥ / kaśmalopahatāḥ sarve pitāmaham athābruvan

vulgate_text: bhāskaro niṣprabhaḥ caiva maharṣeḥ tasya tejasā / buddhim na kurute yāvat nāśe deva mahāmuniḥ
ce_text: buddhiṃ na kurute yāvan nāśe deva mahāmuniḥ / tāvat prasādyo bhagavān agnirūpo mahādyutiḥ

vulgate_text: evam uktvā mahātejā virarāma dvijottamaḥ / śatānaṃda vacaḥ śrutvā rāma lakṣmaṇa saṃnidhau
ce_text: śatānandavacaḥ śrutvā rāmalakṣmaṇasaṃnidhau / janakaḥ prāñjalir vākyam uvāca kuśikātmajam

vulgate_text: mithilām abhyupāgamya vīryam jijñāsavaḥ tadā / teṣām jijñāsamānānām śaivam dhanuḥ upāhṛtam
ce_text: tataḥ sarve nṛpatayaḥ sametya munipuṃgava / mithilām abhyupāgamya vīryaṃ jijñāsavas tadā

vulgate_text: kauśikaḥ ca tathā iti āha rājā ca ābhāṣya maṃtriṇaḥ / ayodhyām preṣayāmāsa dharmātmā kṛta śāsanān / yathā vṛttam samākhyātum ānetum ca nṛpam tathā
ce_text: kauśikaś ca tathety āha rājā cābhāṣya mantriṇaḥ / ayodhyāṃ preṣayām āsa dharmātmā kṛtaśāsanāt

vulgate_text: maṃtriṇo bāḍham iti āhuḥ saha sarvaiḥ maharṣibhiḥ / su prītaḥ ca abravīt rājā śvaḥ yātrā iti ca maṃtriṇaḥ
ce_text: mantriṇo bāḍham ity āhuḥ saha sarvair maharṣibhiḥ / suprītaś cābravīd rājā śvo yātreti sa mantriṇaḥ

vulgate_text: uvāca vacanam śreṣṭho naraśreṣṭham mudā anvitam / svāgatam te naraśreṣṭhaḥ diṣṭyā prāpto asi rāghava
ce_text: tato rājānam āsādya vṛddhaṃ daśarathaṃ nṛpam / janako mudito rājā harṣaṃ ca paramaṃ yayau / uvāca ca naraśreṣṭho naraśreṣṭhaṃ mudānvitam

vulgate_text: harṣeṇa mahatā yuktāḥ tām niśām avasan sukham / atha rāmo mahātejā lakṣmaṇena samam yayau
ce_text: tataḥ sarve munigaṇāḥ parasparasamāgame / harṣeṇa mahatā yuktās tāṃ niśām avasan sukham

vulgate_text: viśvāmitram puraskṛtya pituḥ pādau upaspṛśan / rājā ca rāghavau putrau niśāmya pariharṣitaḥ
ce_text: rājā ca rāghavau putrau niśāmya pariharṣitaḥ / uvāsa paramaprīto janakena supūjitaḥ

vulgate_text: tad vṛttam nṛpatiḥ śrutvā dūta śreṣṭhaiḥ mahā javaiḥ / ājñayā tu narendrasya ājagāma kuśadhvajaḥ
ce_text: ājñayā tu narendrasya ājagāma kuśadhvajaḥ

vulgate_text: ikṣvākoḥ tu sutaḥ śrīmān kukṣiḥ iti eva viśrutaḥ / kukṣeḥ atha ātmajaḥ śrīmān vikukṣiḥ upapadyata
ce_text: tam ikṣvākum ayodhyāyāṃ rājānaṃ viddhi pūrvakam / ikṣvākos tu sutaḥ śrīmān vikukṣir udapadyata

vulgate_text: sapatnyā tu garaḥ tasyaiḥ datto garbha jighāṃsayā / saha tena gareṇa eva saṃjātaḥ sagaroi abhavat
ce_text: saha tena gareṇaiva jātaḥ sa sagaro 'bhavat / sagarasyāsamañjas tu asamañjād athāṃśumān

vulgate_text: aṃbarīṣasya putro abhūt nahuṣaḥ ca mahīpatiḥ / nahuṣasya yayātiḥ tu nābhāgaḥ tu yayāti jaḥ
ce_text: maroḥ praśuśrukas tv āsīd ambarīṣaḥ praśuśrukāt / ambarīṣasya putro 'bhūn nahuṣaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ

vulgate_text: kulam dhanyam idam manye yeṣām tau munipuṃgavau / sadṛśam kula saṃbandham yat ājñāpayathaḥ svayam
ce_text: sadṛśaṃ kulasaṃbandhaṃ yad ājñāpayathaḥ svayam / evaṃ bhavatu bhadraṃ vaḥ kuśadhvajasute ime / patnyau bhajetāṃ sahitau śatrughnabharatāv ubhau

vulgate_text: prabhāte punaḥ utthāya kṛtvā karmāṇi tattvavit / ṛṣīn tadā puraskṛtya yajña vāṭam upāgamat
ce_text: tatas tām uṣito rātriṃ saha putrair mahātmabhiḥ / ṛṣīṃs tadā puraskṛtya yajñavāṭam upāgamat

vulgate_text: pratīccha ca enām bhadram te pāṇim gṛhṇīṣva pāṇinā / pativratā mahabhāgā chāya iva anugatā sadā
ce_text: abravīj janako rājā kausalyānandavardhanam / iyaṃ sītā mama sutā sahadharmacarī tava / pratīccha caināṃ bhadraṃ te pāṇiṃ gṛhṇīṣva pāṇinā

vulgate_text: abravīt janako rājā harṣeṇa abhiparipluta / lakṣmaṇa āgaccha bhadram te ūrmilām udyatām mayā
ce_text: lakṣmaṇāgaccha bhadraṃ te ūrmilām udyatāṃ mayā / pratīccha pāṇiṃ gṛhṇīṣva mā bhūt kālasya paryayaḥ

vulgate_text: gṛhāṇa pāṇim māṇḍavyāḥ pāṇinā raghunaṃdana / śatrughnam ca api dharmāatmā abravīt mithileśvaraḥ
ce_text: śatrughnaṃ cāpi dharmātmā abravīj janakeśvaraḥ / śrutakīrtyā mahābāho pāṇiṃ gṛhṇīṣva pāṇinā

vulgate_text: dadarśa bhīma saṃkāśam jaṭā maṇḍala dhāriṇam / bhārgavam jamadagne ayam rājā rāja vimardanam
ce_text: tasmiṃs tamasi ghore tu bhasmacchanneva sā camūḥ / dadarśa bhīmasaṃkāśaṃ jaṭāmaṇḍaladhāriṇam

vulgate_text: skandhe ca āsajya paraśum dhanuḥ vidyut gaṇa upamam / pragṛhya śaram ugram ca tri pura ghnam yathā śivam
ce_text: skandhe cāsajya paraśuṃ dhanur vidyudgaṇopamam / pragṛhya śaramukhyaṃ ca tripuraghnaṃ yathā haram

vulgate_text: tat idam ghora saṃkāśam jāmadagnyam mahat dhanuḥ / pūrayasva śareṇa eva sva balam darśayasva ca
ce_text: tad idaṃ ghorasaṃkāśaṃ jāmadagnyaṃ mahad dhanuḥ / pūrayasva śareṇaiva svabalaṃ darśayasva ca

vulgate_text: virodham janayāmāsa tayoḥ satyavatām varaḥ / virodhe tu mahat yuddham abhavat roma harṣaṇam
ce_text: abhiprāyaṃ tu vijñāya devatānāṃ pitāmahaḥ / virodhaṃ janayām āsa tayoḥ satyavatāṃ varaḥ

vulgate_text: iti uktvā rāghavaḥ kruddho bhārgavasya vara āyudham / śaram ca pratijagrāha hastāt laghu parākramaḥ
ce_text: ity uktvā rāghavaḥ kruddho bhārgavasya varāyudham / śaraṃ ca pratisaṃgṛhya hastāl laghuparākramaḥ

vulgate_text: so aham guru vacaḥ kurvan pṛthivyām na vase niśām / tadā prabhṛti kākutstha kṛtā me kāśyapasya ha
ce_text: so 'haṃ guruvacaḥ kurvan pṛthivyāṃ na vase niśām / iti pratijñā kākutstha kṛtā vai kāśyapasya ha

vulgate_text: gato rāma iti śrutvā hṛṣṭaḥ pramudito nṛpaḥ / punarjātam tadā mene putram ātmānam eva ca
ce_text: gato rāma iti śrutvā hṛṣṭaḥ pramudito nṛpaḥ / codayām āsa tāṃ senāṃ jagāmāśu tataḥ purīm

vulgate_text: sampūrṇām prāviśat rājā jana oghaiḥ samalamkṛtām / pauraiḥ prati udgato dūram dvijaiḥ ca pura vāsibhiḥ
ce_text: rājapraveśasumukhaiḥ paurair maṅgalavādibhiḥ / saṃpūrṇāṃ prāviśad rājā janaughaiḥ samalaṃkṛtām

vulgate_text: nananda svajanaiḥ rājā gṛhe kāmaiḥ supūjitaḥ / kausalyā ca sumitrā ca kaikeyī ca sumadhyamā
ce_text: kausalyā ca sumitrā ca kaikeyī ca sumadhyamā / vadhūpratigrahe yuktā yāś cānyā rājayoṣitaḥ

vulgate_text: śuśrūṣamāṇāḥ pitaram vartayanti nararṣabhāḥ / kasyacit atha kālasya rājā daśaradhaḥ sutam
ce_text: kṛtadārāḥ kṛtāstrāś ca sadhanāḥ sasuhṛjjanāḥ / śuśrūṣamāṇāḥ pitaraṃ vartayanti nararṣabhāḥ

vulgate_text: rāmasya śīla vṛttena sarvam viṣaya vāsinaḥ / teṣām ati yaśā loke rāmaḥ satya parākramaḥ
ce_text: teṣām atiyaśā loke rāmaḥ satyaparākramaḥ / svayambhūr iva bhūtānāṃ babhūva guṇavattaraḥ

vulgate_text: guṇāt rūpa guṇāt ca api prītiḥ bhūyo abhivardhate / tasyāḥ ca bhartā dviguṇam hṛdaye parivartate
ce_text: tasyāś ca bhartā dviguṇaṃ hṛdaye parivartate / antarjātam api vyaktam ākhyāti hṛdayaṃ hṛdā

vulgate_text: sa tu sreṣṭhairguṇairyuktaḥ prajānāṃ pārthivātmajaḥ / bahiścara iva prāṇo babhūva guṇataḥ priyaḥ
ce_text: evaṃ śreṣṭhair guṇair yuktaḥ prajānāṃ pārthivātmajaḥ / saṃmatas triṣu lokeṣu vasudhāyāḥ kṣamāguṇaiḥ / buddhyā bṛhaspates tulyo vīryeṇāpi śacīpateḥ

vulgate_text: satsaṃgrahapragrahaṇe sthānavinnigrahasya ca / āyakarmaṇyupāyajñaḥ saṃdṛṣṭavyayakarmavit
ce_text: āyakarmaṇy upāyajñaḥ saṃdṛṣṭavyayakarmavit / śraiṣṭhyaṃ śāstrasamūheṣu prāpto vyāmiśrakeṣv api

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā daśaratho rājā cakre cintāṃ paraṃtapaḥ / atha rājño babhūvaivaṃ vṛddhasya cirajīvinaḥ
ce_text: etais tu bahubhir yuktaṃ guṇair anupamaiḥ sutam / dṛṣṭvā daśaratho rājā cakre cintāṃ paraṃtapaḥ

vulgate_text: prītireṣā kathaṃ rāmo rājā syānmayi jīvati / eṣā hyasya parā prītirhṛdi saṃparivartate
ce_text: eṣā hy asya parā prītir hṛdi saṃparivartate / kadā nāma sutaṃ drakṣyāmy abhiṣiktam ahaṃ priyam

vulgate_text: anena vayasā dṛṣṭvā yathā svargamavāpnuyām / ityetai rvividhai staistai ranyapārthivadurlabhaiḥ
ce_text: mahīm aham imāṃ kṛtsnām adhitiṣṭhantam ātmajam / anena vayasā dṛṣṭvā yathā svargam avāpnuyām

vulgate_text: śiṣṭairaparimeyaiścha loke lokottarairguṇaiḥ / taṃ samīkṣya mahārājo yuktaṃ samuditaiḥ śubhaiḥ
ce_text: taṃ samīkṣya mahārājo yuktaṃ samuditair guṇaiḥ / niścitya sacivaiḥ sārdhaṃ yuvarājam amanyata

vulgate_text: niścitya sacivaiḥ sārdhaṃ yuvarājamamanyata / divyantarikṣe bhūmau ca ghoramutpātajaṃ bhayam
ce_text: taṃ samīkṣya mahārājo yuktaṃ samuditair guṇaiḥ / niścitya sacivaiḥ sārdhaṃ yuvarājam amanyata

vulgate_text: prāptakālena dharmātmā bhaktyā tvaritavān nṛpaḥ / nānānagaravāstavyān pṛthagjānapadānapi
ce_text: nānānagaravāstavyān pṛthagjānapadān api / samānināya medinyāḥ pradhānān pṛthivīpatiḥ

vulgate_text: samānināya medinyāḥ pradhānān pṛthivīpatīn / na tu kekayarājānaṃ janakaṃ vā narādhipaḥ
ce_text: nānānagaravāstavyān pṛthagjānapadān api / samānināya medinyāḥ pradhānān pṛthivīpatiḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ praviviśuḥ śeṣa rājāno lokasammatāḥ / atha rājavitīrṇeṣu vividheṣvāsaneṣu ca
ce_text: atha rājavitīrṇeṣu vividheṣv āsaneṣu ca / rājānam evābhimukhā niṣedur niyatā nṛpāḥ

vulgate_text: tasya dharmārthaviduṣo bhāvamājañāya sarvaśaḥ / brāhmaṇā janamukhyāśca paurajānapadaiḥ saha
ce_text: tasya dharmārthaviduṣo bhāvam ājñāya sarvaśaḥ / ūcuś ca manasā jñātvā vṛddhaṃ daśarathaṃ nṛpam

vulgate_text: sametya mantrayitvā tu samatāgatabuddhayaḥ / ūcuśca manasā jañātvā vṛddhaṃ daśarathaṃ nṛpam
ce_text: tasya dharmārthaviduṣo bhāvam ājñāya sarvaśaḥ / ūcuś ca manasā jñātvā vṛddhaṃ daśarathaṃ nṛpam

vulgate_text: rāmaḥ satpuruṣo loke satyadharmaparāyaṇaḥ / sākṣhādrāmādvinirvṛtto dharmaścāpi śriyā saha
ce_text: rāmaḥ satpuruṣo loke satyadharmaparāyaṇaḥ / dharmajñaḥ satyasaṃdhaś ca śīlavān anasūyakaḥ

vulgate_text: prajāsukhatve candrasya vasudhāyāḥ kṣhamāguṇaiḥ / budhyā bṛhaspatestulyo vīrye sākṣācchacīpateḥ
ce_text: evaṃ śreṣṭhair guṇair yuktaḥ prajānāṃ pārthivātmajaḥ / saṃmatas triṣu lokeṣu vasudhāyāḥ kṣamāguṇaiḥ / buddhyā bṛhaspates tulyo vīryeṇāpi śacīpateḥ

vulgate_text: devāsuramanuṣyāṇāṃ sarvāstreṣu viśāradaḥ / samyagvidyāvratasnāto yathavatsāṅgavedavit
ce_text: tenāsyehātulā kīrtir yaśas tejaś ca vardhate / devāsuramanuṣyāṇāṃ sarvāstreṣu viśāradaḥ

vulgate_text: dvijairabhivinītaśca śreṣṭhairdharmārthanaipuṇaiḥ / yadā vrajati saṃgrāmaṃ grāmārthe nagarasya vā
ce_text: yadā vrajati saṃgrāmaṃ grāmārthe nagarasya vā / gatvā saumitrisahito nāvijitya nivartate

vulgate_text: tamevaṃguṇasampannaṃ rāmaṃ satyaparākramam / lokapālopamaṃ nāthamakāmayata medinī
ce_text: tam evaṃvṛttasaṃpannam apradhṛṣya parākramam / lokapālopamaṃ nātham akāmayata medinī

vulgate_text: balamārogyamāyuśca rāmasya viditātmanaḥ / devāsuramanuṣyeṣu sagandharvorageṣu ca
ce_text: balam ārogyam āyuś ca rāmasya viditātmanaḥ / āśaṃsate janaḥ sarvo rāṣṭre puravare tathā

vulgate_text: cakratuścaiva yaccheṣaṃ pārthivāya nivedya ca / kṛtamityeva cābrūtāmabhigamya jagatpatim
ce_text: kṛtam ity eva cābrūtām abhigamya jagatpatim / yathoktavacanaṃ prītau harṣayuktau dvijarṣabhau

vulgate_text: amātyaprabhṛtīḥ sarvāḥ prakṛtīścānurañjaya / koṣṭhāgārāyudhāgāraiḥ kṛtvā sanni cayān bahūn
ce_text: parokṣayā vartamāno vṛttyā pratyakṣayā tathā / amātyaprabhṛtīḥ sarvāḥ prakṛtīś cānurañjaya

vulgate_text: prahṛuṣṭamuditaiḥ paurairuccri tadvajamālinīm / ayodhyāṃ vantharā tasmātprāsādādanvavaikṣata
ce_text: siktarājapathāṃ kṛtsnāṃ prakīrṇakamalotpalām / ayodhyāṃ mantharā tasmāt prāsādād anvavaikṣata

vulgate_text: praharṣotphullanayanāṃ pāṇḍurakṣaumavāsinīm / avidūre sthitāṃ dṛṣṭvā dhātrīṃ papraccha mantharā
ce_text: avidūre sthitāṃ dṛṣṭvā dhātrīṃ papraccha mantharā / uttamenābhisaṃyuktā harṣeṇārthaparā satī

vulgate_text: mantharāyā vacaḥ śrutvā śayanātsa śubhānanā / uttasthau harṣasaṃpūrṇā candralekhava śāradī
ce_text: mantharāyā vacaḥ śrutvā śayanāt sā śubhānanā / ekam ābharaṇaṃ tasyai kubjāyai pradadau śubham

vulgate_text: atīva sā tu saṃhṛṣṭāa kaikeyī vismayānvitā / ekamābharaṇaṃ tasyai kubjāyai pradadau śubham
ce_text: mantharāyā vacaḥ śrutvā śayanāt sā śubhānanā / ekam ābharaṇaṃ tasyai kubjāyai pradadau śubham

vulgate_text: yathā ne bharato mānyastathā bhūyo'pi rāghāvaḥ / kausalyāto'riktaṃ ca so hi śuśrūṣate hi mām
ce_text: sā tvam abhyudaye prāpte vartamāne ca manthare / bhaviṣyati ca kalyāṇe kimarthaṃ paritapyase / kausalyāto 'tiriktaṃ ca sa tu śuśrūṣate hi mām

vulgate_text: yadā hi rāmaḥ pṛthivīmavāpsyati / prabhūtaratnākaraśailapattanām / tadā gamiṣyasyaśubhaṃ parābhavaṃ / sahaiva dīnā bharatena bhāmini
ce_text: yadā hi rāmaḥ pṛthivīm avāpsyati dhruvaṃ pranaṣṭo bharato bhaviṣyati / ato hi saṃcintaya rājyam ātmaje parasya cādyaiva vivāsakāraṇam

vulgate_text: kathaiṣā tava tu snehānmanasā dhāryate mayā / rāmābhiṣekasaṃbhārānnigṛhya vinivartaya
ce_text: prāptakālaṃ tu te manye rājānaṃ vītasādhvasā / rāmābhiṣekasaṃkalpān nigṛhya vinivartaya

vulgate_text: māsmainaṃ pratyudīkṣethā mācaina mabhibhāṣathāḥ / rudantī cāpi taṃ dṛṣṭvā jagatyāṃ śokalālasā
ce_text: krodhāgāraṃ praviśyādya kruddhevāśvapateḥ sute / śeṣvānantarhitāyāṃ tvaṃ bhūmau malinavāsinī / mā smainaṃ pratyudīkṣethā mā cainam abhibhāṣathāḥ

vulgate_text: hṛṣṭā pratītā kaikeyī mantharāmidamabravīt / sā hi vākyena kubjāyāḥ kiśorīvotpathaṃ gatā / kaikeyī vismayaṃ prāptā paraṃ paramadarśanā
ce_text: anartham artharūpeṇa grāhitā sā tatas tayā / hṛṣṭā pratītā kaikeyī mantharām idam abravīt

vulgate_text: adhastāccodaraṃ śātaṃ sunābhamiva lajjitam / paripūrṇaṃ tu jaghanaṃ supīnau ca payodharau
ce_text: uras te 'bhiniviṣṭaṃ vai yāvat skandhāt samunnatam / adhastāc codaraṃ śāntaṃ sunābham iva lajjitam

vulgate_text: vimalendusamaṃ vaktramaho rājasi manthare / jaghanaṃ tava nirghuṣṭaṃ raśanādāmaśobhitam
ce_text: jaghanaṃ tava nirghuṣṭaṃ raśanādāmaśobhitam / jaṅghe bhṛśam upanyaste pādau cāpy āyatāv ubhau

vulgate_text: sarvāstvayi niviṣṭāstā bhūyaścānyāḥ sahasraśaḥ / tavedaṃ sthagu yaddīrghaṃ rathaghoṇamivāyatam
ce_text: tavedaṃ sthagu yad dīrghaṃ rathaghoṇam ivāyatam / matayaḥ kṣatravidyāś ca māyāś cātra vasanti te

vulgate_text: yamasya vā māṃ viṣayaṃ gatāmito / niśāmya kubje prativedayiṣyasi / vanaṃ gate vā sucirāya rāghave / samṛddhakāmo bharato bhaviṣyati
ce_text: iha vā māṃ mṛtāṃ kubje nṛpāyāvedayiṣyasi / vanaṃ tu rāghave prāpte bharataḥ prāpsyati kṣitim

vulgate_text: sā dīnā niścayaṃ kṛtvā mantharāvākyamohitā / nāgakanyeva niḥsvasya dīrghamuṣṇaṃ ca bhāminī
ce_text: evam uktā tu kaikeyī krodhena jvalitānanā / dīrgham uṣṇaṃ viniḥśvasya mantharām idam abravīt

vulgate_text: ekaveṇīṃ dṛḍhaṃ baddhvā gatasattveva kinnarī / ājñāpya tu mahārājo rāghavasyābhiṣecanm
ce_text: ājñāpya tu mahārājo rāghavasyābhiṣecanam / priyārhāṃ priyam ākhyātuṃ viveśāntaḥpuraṃ vaśī

vulgate_text: priyārhaṃ priyamākhyātuṃ viveśāntaḥpuraṃ vaśī / sa kaikeyyā gṛhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ praviveśa mahāyaśāḥ
ce_text: ājñāpya tu mahārājo rāghavasyābhiṣecanam / priyārhāṃ priyam ākhyātuṃ viveśāntaḥpuraṃ vaśī

vulgate_text: viṣasāda punarbhuyo lulitavyākulendhriyaḥ / tatratāṃ patitāṃ bhūmau śayānāmatathocitām
ce_text: tāṃ tatra patitāṃ bhūmau śayānām atathocitām / pratapta iva duḥkhena so 'paśyaj jagatīpatiḥ

vulgate_text: apāpaḥ pāpasaṅkalpāṃ dadarśa dharaṇītale / latāmiva viniṣkṛttāṃ patitāṃ deva tāmiva
ce_text: sa vṛddhas taruṇīṃ bhāryāṃ prāṇebhyo 'pi garīyasīm / apāpaḥ pāpasaṃkalpāṃ dadarśa dharaṇītale

vulgate_text: tatte vyapanayiṣyāmi nīharamiva rśmivān / tathoktā sā samāsvastā vaktukāmā tadapriyam
ce_text: tathoktā sā samāśvastā vaktukāmā tad apriyam / paripīḍayituṃ bhūyo bhartāram upacakrame

vulgate_text: tāmuvāca mahātejāḥ kaikeyīmīṣadutsmaitaḥ / kāmī hastena saṃgṛhya mūrdhajeṣu śucismitām
ce_text: evam uktas tayā rājā priyayā strīvaśaṃ gataḥ / tām uvāca mahātejāḥ kaikeyīm īṣadutsmitaḥ

vulgate_text: anenaivābhiṣe keṇa bharato me'bhiṣicyatām / yo dvitīyo varo deva dattaḥ prītena me tvayā
ce_text: abhiṣeka samārambho rāghavasyopakalpitaḥ / anenaivābhiṣekeṇa bharato me 'bhiṣicyatām

vulgate_text: tadā daivāsure yuddhe tasya kālo'ya māgataḥ / nava pañca ca varṣāṇi daṇḍakāraṇyamāśritaḥ
ce_text: nava pañca ca varṣāṇi daṇḍakāraṇyam āśritaḥ / cīrājinajaṭādhārī rāmo bhavatu tāpasaḥ

vulgate_text: eṣa me paramaḥ kāmo dattameva varaṃ vṛṇe / adyacaiva hi paśyeyaṃ prayāntaṃ rāghavaṃ vanm
ce_text: bharato bhajatām adya yauvarājyam akaṇṭakam / adya caiva hi paśyeyaṃ prayāntaṃ rāghavaṃ vane

vulgate_text: tataḥ śrutvā mahārājaḥ kaikeyyā dāruṇam vacaḥ / cintāmabhisamāpede muhūrtam pratatāpa ca
ce_text: tataḥ śrutvā mahārājaḥ kaikeyyā dāruṇaṃ vacaḥ / vyathito viklavaś caiva vyāghrīṃ dṛṣṭvā yathā mṛgaḥ

vulgate_text: maṇḍle pannago ruddho mantrairiva mahāviṣaḥ / ahodhigiti sāmarṣo vācamuktvā narādhipaḥ
ce_text: asaṃvṛtāyām āsīno jagatyāṃ dīrgham ucchvasan / aho dhig iti sāmarṣo vācam uktvā narādhipaḥ / moham āpedivān bhūyaḥ śokopahatacetanaḥ

vulgate_text: kim kṛtam tava rāmeṇa pāpaṃ pāpe mayāpi vā / tvaṃ mamātmavināśārtham bhavanam svaṃ praveśitā
ce_text: tvaṃ mayātmavināśāya bhavanaṃ svaṃ praveśitā / avijñānān nṛpasutā vyālī tīkṣṇaviṣā yathā

vulgate_text: apite caraṇau mūrdhnā spṛśāmyeṣa prasīda me / kimidam cintitam pāpe tvayā paramadāruṇam
ce_text: tad alaṃ tyajyatām eṣa niścayaḥ pāpaniścaye / api te caraṇau mūrdhnā spṛśāmy eṣa prasīda me

vulgate_text: yadi satyam bravīmyetattadasatyam bhaviṣyati / kim mām vakṣyati kausalyā rāghave vanamāsthite
ce_text: yadi satyaṃ bravīmy etat tad asatyaṃ bhaviṣyati / akīrtir atulā loke dhruvaṃ paribhavaś ca me

vulgate_text: mṛtyurakṣamaṇīyam mām nayiṣyati yamakṣayam / mṛte mayi gate rāme vanam manujapuṅgave
ce_text: mṛte mayi gate rāme vanaṃ manujapuṃgave / hantānārye mamāmitre rāmaḥ pravrājito vanam

vulgate_text: mṛte mayi gate rāme vanam puruṣapuṅgave / sedānīm vidhavā rājyam saputrā kārayiṣyasi
ce_text: mṛte mayi gate rāme vanaṃ manujapuṃgave / hantānārye mamāmitre rāmaḥ pravrājito vanam

vulgate_text: tvam rājaputrīvādena nyavaso mama veśmani / akīrtiścātulā loke dhruvaḥ paribhavaśca me
ce_text: yadi satyaṃ bravīmy etat tad asatyaṃ bhaviṣyati / akīrtir atulā loke dhruvaṃ paribhavaś ca me

vulgate_text: kaikeyyāḥ priyakāmena rāmaḥ pravrājito mayā / yadi satyam bravīmy etat tat asatyam bhaviṣyati
ce_text: yadi satyaṃ bravīmy etat tad asatyaṃ bhaviṣyati / akīrtir atulā loke dhruvaṃ paribhavaś ca me

vulgate_text: kuru sādhu prasādam me bāle sahṛdayā hi asi / prasīda devi rāmo me tvaddhattaṃ rājyamavyayam
ce_text: śūnyena khalu suśroṇi mayedaṃ samudāhṛtam / kuru sādhu prasādaṃ me bāle sahṛdayā hy asi

vulgate_text: kṣaudram dadhi ghṛtaṃ lājā darbhāḥ sumanasaḥ payaḥ / aṣṭau ca kanyā rucirā mattaścha varavāraṇaḥ
ce_text: kṣaudraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ lājā darbhāḥ sumanasaḥ payaḥ / salājāḥ kṣīribhiś channā ghaṭāḥ kāñcanarājatāḥ / padmotpalayutā bhānti pūrṇāḥ paramavāriṇā

vulgate_text: buddhyasva sṛpaśārdūla kuru kāryamanantaram / udatiṣṭhata rāmasya samagramabhiṣecanm
ce_text: gatā bhagavatī rātrirahaḥ śivam upasthitam / budhyasva nṛpaśārdūla kuru kāryam anantaram

vulgate_text: vākyaistu khalu marmāṇi mama bhūyo nikṛntasi / sumantraḥ karuṇam śrutvā dṛṣṭvā dīnam ca pārthivam
ce_text: sumantraḥ karuṇaṃ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā dīnaṃ ca pārthivam / pragṛhītāñjaliḥ kiṃ cit tasmād deśād apākraman

vulgate_text: tadā sumantram mantrajñā kaikeyī pratyuvāca ha / sumantra rājā rajanīṃ rāmaharṣasamutsukaḥ
ce_text: yadā vaktuṃ svayaṃ dainyān na śaśāka mahīpatiḥ / tadā sumantraṃ mantrajñā kaikeyī pratyuvāca ha

vulgate_text: rāmamānaya bhadraṃ te nātra kāryā vicāraṇā / sa manyamānaḥ kalyāṇam hṛdayena nannandha ca
ce_text: sumantra rāmaṃ drakṣyāmi śīghram ānaya sundaram / sa manyamānaḥ kalyāṇaṃ hṛdayena nananda ca

vulgate_text: nirjagāma ca saṃprītyā tvarito rājaśāsanāt / sumantraścintayāmāsa tvaritaṃ coditastayā
ce_text: sumantraś cintayām āsa tvaritaṃ coditas tayā / vyaktaṃ rāmo 'bhiṣekārtham ihāyāsyati dharmavit

vulgate_text: nirjagāma mahābāho rāghavasya didṛkṣayā / sāgarahradasaṃkāśātsumantro'ntaḥpurācchubhāt
ce_text: iti sūto matiṃ kṛtvā harṣeṇa mahatā punaḥ / nirjagāma mahātejā rāghavasya didṛkṣayā

vulgate_text: veśyāścaiva śubhācārāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ / candrāṃśuvikacaprakhyaṃ kāñcanaṃ ratnabhuṣitam
ce_text: candrāṃśuvikacaprakhyaṃ pāṇḍuraṃ ratnabhūṣitam / sajjaṃ tiṣṭhati rāmasya vālavyajanam uttamam

vulgate_text: āśīrbhirguṇayuktābhirabhituṣṭāva rāghavam / somasūryau ca kākutstha śivavaiśravaṇāvapi
ce_text: ity uktvāntaḥpuradvāram ājagāma purāṇavit / āśīrbhir guṇayuktābhir abhituṣṭāva rāghavam

vulgate_text: varuṇaścagnirindraśca vijayam pradiśantu te / gatā bhagavatī rātriraḥ śivamupasthitam
ce_text: gatā bhagavatī rātrirahaḥ śivam upasthitam / budhyasva nṛpaśārdūla kuru kāryam anantaram

vulgate_text: pratibuddhya tato rājā idaṃ vacanamabravīt / rāmamānaya sūteti yadasyabhihitoanayā
ce_text: stuvantaṃ taṃ tadā sūtaṃ sumantraṃ mantrakovidam / pratibudhya tato rājā idaṃ vacanam abravīt

vulgate_text: kimidaṃ kāraṇam yena mamājñā pratihanyate / na caiva samprasupto'hamānayehāśu rāghavam
ce_text: na caiva saṃprasuto 'ham ānayed āśu rāghavam / iti rājā daśarathaḥ sūtaṃ tatrānvaśāt punaḥ

vulgate_text: hṛṣṭaḥ pramuditaḥ sūto jagāmāśu vilokayan / sa sūtastatra śuśrāva rāmādhikaraṇāḥ kathāḥ
ce_text: prapanno rājamārgaṃ ca patākā dhvajaśobhitam / sa sūtas tatra śuśrāva rāmādhikaraṇāḥ kathāḥ

vulgate_text: abhiṣecanasaṃyuktāssarvalokasya hṛṣṭavat / tato dadarśa ruciraṃ kailāsaśikharaprabham
ce_text: tato dadarśa ruciraṃ kailāsasadṛśaprabham / rāmaveśma sumantras tu śakraveśmasamaprabham

vulgate_text: maṇibhirvaramālyānāṃ sumahadbhiralaṃkṛtam / muktāmaṇibhirākīrṇaṃ candhanāgurubhūṣitam
ce_text: śāradābhraghanaprakhyaṃ dīptaṃ meruguhopamam / dāmabhir varamālyānāṃ sumahadbhir alaṃkṛtam

vulgate_text: sa vājiyuktena rathena sārathi / rnarākulaṃ rājakulam virājayan / varūthinā rāmagṛhābhipātinā / purasya sarvasya manāṃsi harśayan
ce_text: sa vājiyuktena rathena sārathir narākulaṃ rājakulaṃ vilokayan / tataḥ samāsādya mahādhanaṃ mahat prahṛṣṭaromā sa babhūva sārathiḥ

vulgate_text: tatassamāsādya mahādhanaṃ mahat / prahṛṣṭaromā sa babhūva sārathiḥ / mṛgairmayūraiśca samākulolbaṇaṃ / gṛhaṃ varārhasya śacīpateriva
ce_text: sa vājiyuktena rathena sārathir narākulaṃ rājakulaṃ vilokayan / tataḥ samāsādya mahādhanaṃ mahat prahṛṣṭaromā sa babhūva sārathiḥ

vulgate_text: te rāmamupasamgamya bhartuḥ priyacikīrṣavaḥ / sahabhāryāya rāmāya kṣipramevācacakṣire
ce_text: te samīkṣya samāyāntaṃ rāmapriyacikīrṣavaḥ / sahabhāryāya rāmāya kṣipram evācacakṣire

vulgate_text: atha madhyamakakṣyāyām samāgacchat suhṛjjanaiḥ / sa sarvān arthino dṛṣṭvā sametya pratinandya ca
ce_text: sa sarvān arthino dṛṣṭvā sametya pratinandya ca / tataḥ pāvakasaṃkāśam āruroha rathottamam

vulgate_text: tataḥ pāvaka samkāśam āruroha ratha uttamam / vaiyāghram puruṣvyā gho rājitam rājanamdanaḥ
ce_text: sa sarvān arthino dṛṣṭvā sametya pratinandya ca / tataḥ pāvakasaṃkāśam āruroha rathottamam

vulgate_text: meghanādamasambādham maṇihemavibhūśitam / muṣṇantam iva cakṣūmṣi prabhayā hema varcasam
ce_text: muṣṇantam iva cakṣūṃṣi prabhayā hemavarcasaṃ / kareṇuśiśukalpaiś ca yuktaṃ paramavājibhiḥ

vulgate_text: tasya niṣkramamāṇasya jana oghasya samantataḥ / tato hayavarā mukhyā nāgāśca girisannibhāḥ
ce_text: tato halahalāśabdas tumulaḥ samajāyata / tasya niṣkramamāṇasya janaughasya samantataḥ

vulgate_text: sa rāmaḥ ratham āsthāya samprahṛṣṭa suhṛj janaḥ / patākādhvajasaṃpannaṃ mahārhagurudhūpitam
ce_text: sa rāmo ratham āsthāya saṃprahṛṣṭasuhṛjjanaḥ / apaśyan nagaraṃ śrīmān nānājanasamākulam

vulgate_text: rāja mārgam yayau rāmaḥ madhyena agaru dhūpitam / candanānām ca mukhyānāmagurūṇām ca samcayaiḥ
ce_text: sa gṛhair abhrasaṃkāśaiḥ pāṇḍurair upaśobhitam / rājamārgaṃ yayau rāmo madhyenāgarudhūpitam

vulgate_text: nānāmālyopagaṃdhaiśca sadābhyarcitacatvaram / āśīr vādān bahūn śṛṇvan suhṛdbhiḥ samudīritān
ce_text: āśīrvādān bahūñ śṛṇvan suhṛdbhiḥ samudīritān / yathārhaṃ cāpi saṃpūjya sarvān eva narān yayau

vulgate_text: naraḥ śaknoti apākraṣṭum atikrānte api rāghave / yaśca rāmaṃ na paśyettu yaṃ ca rāmo na paśyati
ce_text: na hi tasmān manaḥ kaś cic cakṣuṣī vā narottamāt / naraḥ śaknoty apākraṣṭum atikrānte 'pi rāghave

vulgate_text: nindataḥ sarvalokeṣu svātmāpyenam vigarhate / sarveṣām sa hi dharma ātmā varṇānām kurute dayām
ce_text: sarveṣāṃ sa hi dharmātmā varṇānāṃ kurute dayām / caturṇāṃ hi vayaḥsthānāṃ tena te tam anuvratāḥ

vulgate_text: caturṇām hi vayahsthānām tena te tam anuvratāḥ / catpuṣpathān devapathāmścaityānyāyatanāni ca
ce_text: sarveṣāṃ sa hi dharmātmā varṇānāṃ kurute dayām / caturṇāṃ hi vayaḥsthānāṃ tena te tam anuvratāḥ

vulgate_text: pradakṣiṇam pariharan jagāma nṛpatessutaḥ / sa rāja kulam āsādya mahā indra bhavana upamam
ce_text: sa rājakulam āsādya mahendrabhavanopamam / rājaputraḥ pitur veśma praviveśa śriyā jvalan

vulgate_text: rāja putraḥ pitur veśma praviveśa śriyā jvalan / sa kakṣyā dhanvibhirguptāstisro'tikramya vājibhiḥ
ce_text: sa rājakulam āsādya mahendrabhavanopamam / rājaputraḥ pitur veśma praviveśa śriyā jvalan

vulgate_text: padātirapare kakṣye dve jagāma narottamaḥ / sa sarvāḥ samatikramya kakṣyā daśaratha ātmajaḥ
ce_text: sa sarvāḥ samatikramya kakṣyā daśarathātmajaḥ / saṃnivartya janaṃ sarvaṃ śuddhāntaḥpuram abhyagāt

vulgate_text: aprasannamanāḥ kim nu sadā māṃ prati vatsalaḥ / vivarṇa vadano dīno na hi mām abhibhāṣate
ce_text: vivarṇavadano dīno na hi mām abhibhāṣate / śārīro mānaso vāpi kaccid enaṃ na bādhate / saṃtāpo vābhitāpo vā durlabhaṃ hi sadā sukham

vulgate_text: aho dhiṅnārhase devi paktuṃ māmīdṛśaṃ vacaḥ / aham hi vacanāt rājñaḥ pateyam api pāvake
ce_text: ahaṃ hi vacanād rājñaḥ pateyam api pāvake / bhakṣayeyaṃ viṣaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ majjeyam api cārṇave / niyukto guruṇā pitrā nṛpeṇa ca hitena ca

vulgate_text: rāmaḥ api utthāpya rājānam kaikeyyā abhipracoditaḥ / kaśayā iva āhataḥ vājī vanam gantum kṛta tvaraḥ
ce_text: rāmo 'py utthāpya rājānaṃ kaikeyyābhipracoditaḥ / kaśayevāhato vājī vanaṃ gantuṃ kṛtatvaraḥ

vulgate_text: vācā madhurayā rāmaḥ srvaṃ sammānayan janam / mātussamīpaṃ dhīrātmā praviveśa mahāyaśāḥ
ce_text: dhārayan manasā duḥkham indriyāṇi nigṛhya ca / praviveśātmavān veśma māturapriyaśaṃsivān

vulgate_text: vṛddhānām dharma śīlānām rājarṣīṇām mahātmanām / prāpnuhi āyuḥ ca kīrtim ca dharmam ca upahitam kule
ce_text: vṛddhānāṃ dharmaśīlānāṃ rājarṣīṇāṃ mahātmanām / prāpnuhy āyuś ca kīrtiṃ ca dharmaṃ copahitaṃ kule

vulgate_text: dattamāsanamālabhya bhojanena nimantritaḥ / mātaram rāghavaḥ kimcit prasārya anjalim abravīt
ce_text: mātaraṃ rāghavaḥ kiṃ cit prasāryāñjalim abravīt / sa svabhāvavinītaś ca gauravāc ca tadānataḥ

vulgate_text: sa svabhāva vinītaḥ ca gauravāc ca tadā ānataḥ / prasthito daṇḍakāraṇyamāpraṣṭumupacakrame
ce_text: mātaraṃ rāghavaḥ kiṃ cit prasāryāñjalim abravīt / sa svabhāvavinītaś ca gauravāc ca tadānataḥ

vulgate_text: ataḥ duhkhataram kim nu pramadānām bhaviṣyati / tvayi samnihite api evam aham āsam nirākṛtā
ce_text: tvayi saṃnihite 'py evam aham āsaṃ nirākṛtā / kiṃ punaḥ proṣite tāta dhruvaṃ maraṇam eva me

vulgate_text: na khalv etan mayā ekena kriyate pitṛ śāsanam / etairapi kṛtam devi ye mayā tava kīrtitāḥ
ce_text: na khalv etan mayaikena kriyate pitṛśāsanam / pūrvair ayam abhipreto gato mārgo 'nugamyate

vulgate_text: nāham dharmamapūrvam te pratikūlam pravartaye / pūrvaiḥ ayam abhipretaḥ gataḥ mārgo anugamyate
ce_text: na khalv etan mayaikena kriyate pitṛśāsanam / pūrvair ayam abhipreto gato mārgo 'nugamyate

vulgate_text: tava lakṣmaṇa jānāmi mayi snehamanuttamam / vikramam caiva satyam ca tejaśca sudurāsadam
ce_text: tām evam uktvā jananīṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ punar abravīt / tava lakṣmaṇa jānāmi mayi sneham anuttamam / abhiprāyam avijñāya satyasya ca śamasya ca

vulgate_text: mama māturmahadduḥkhamatulam śubhalakṣamṇa / abhiprāyam avijñāya satyasya ca śamasya ca
ce_text: tām evam uktvā jananīṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ punar abravīt / tava lakṣmaṇa jānāmi mayi sneham anuttamam / abhiprāyam avijñāya satyasya ca śamasya ca

vulgate_text: tīrṇa pratijñaḥ ca vanāt punar eṣyāmy aham purīm / yayātiriva rājarṣiḥ purā hitvā punardhivam
ce_text: anumanyasva māṃ devi gamiṣyantam ito vanam / śāpitāsi mama prāṇaiḥ kuru svastyayanāni me / tīrṇapratijñaś ca vanāt punar eṣyāmy ahaṃ purīm

vulgate_text: sā mānumanyasva vanam vrajantam / kuruṣva naḥ svastyayanāni devi / yathā samāpte punarāvrajeyam / yathā hi styena punaryayātiḥ
ce_text: anumanyasva māṃ devi gamiṣyantam ito vanam / śāpitāsi mama prāṇaiḥ kuru svastyayanāni me / tīrṇapratijñaś ca vanāt punar eṣyāmy ahaṃ purīm

vulgate_text: etayā tattvayā buddhyā samstabhyātmānamātmanā / vyāhate api abhiṣeke me paritāpo na vidyate
ce_text: vyāhate 'py abhiṣeke me paritāpo na vidyate / tasmād aparitāpaḥ saṃs tvam apy anuvidhāya mām / pratisaṃhāraya kṣipram ābhiṣecanikīṃ kriyām

vulgate_text: loka vidviṣṭam ārabdham tvad anyasya abhiṣecanam / notsahe sahitum vīra tatra me kṣantumarhasi
ce_text: lokavidviṣṭam ārabdhaṃ tvadanyasyābhiṣecanam / yeneyam āgatā dvaidhaṃ tava buddhir mahīpate / sa hi dharmo mama dveṣyaḥ prasaṅgād yasya muhyasi

vulgate_text: śramam na avāpnuyāt kimcit apramattā tathā kuru / dāruṇaścāpyayam śoko yathainam na vināśayet
ce_text: yathā mayi tu niṣkrānte putraśokena pārthivaḥ / śramaṃ nāvāpnuyāt kiṃ cid apramattā tathā kuru

vulgate_text: rājño vṛddhasya satatam hitam cara samāhitā / vrata upavāsa niratā yā nārī parama uttamā
ce_text: vratopavāsaniratā yā nārī paramottamā / bhartāraṃ nānuvarteta sā ca pāpagatir bhavet

vulgate_text: bhartāram na anuvarteta sā ca pāpa gatir bhavet / bhartuḥ śuśrūṣayā nārī labhate svargamu ttamam
ce_text: vratopavāsaniratā yā nārī paramottamā / bhartāraṃ nānuvarteta sā ca pāpagatir bhavet

vulgate_text: api yā nirnamaskārā nivṛttā devapūjanāt / śuśrūṣam eva kurvīta bhartuḥ priya hite ratā
ce_text: śuśrūṣam eva kurvīta bhartuḥ priyahite ratā / eṣa dharmaḥ purā dṛṣṭo loke vede śrutaḥ smṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: eṣa dharmaḥ purā dṛṣṭaḥ loke vede śrutaḥ smṛtaḥ / agnikāryeṣu ca sadā sumanobhiśca devatāḥ
ce_text: śuśrūṣam eva kurvīta bhartuḥ priyahite ratā / eṣa dharmaḥ purā dṛṣṭo loke vede śrutaḥ smṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: kausalyā putra śoka ārtā rāmam vacanam abravīt / gamane sukṛtām buddhim na te śaknomi putraka
ce_text: evam uktā tu rāmeṇa bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇā / kausalyā putraśokārtā rāmaṃ vacanam abravīt / gaccha putra tvam ekāgro bhadraṃ te 'stu sadā vibho

vulgate_text: vinivartayitum vīra nūnam kālo duratyayaḥ / gacca putra tvam eka agraḥ bhadram te astu sadā vibho
ce_text: evam uktā tu rāmeṇa bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇā / kausalyā putraśokārtā rāmaṃ vacanam abravīt / gaccha putra tvam ekāgro bhadraṃ te 'stu sadā vibho

vulgate_text: pataṅgāḥ pannagāḥ simhāstvām rakṣantu narottama / svasti sādhyāḥ ca viśve ca marutaḥ ca maharṣayaḥ
ce_text: svasti sādhyāś ca viśve ca marutaś ca maharṣayaḥ / svasti dhātā vidhātā ca svasti pūṣā bhago 'ryamā

vulgate_text: sapta ṛṣayo nāradaḥ ca te tvām rakṣantu sarvataḥ / yāścāpi sarvataḥ siddā diśśca sadigīśvarāḥ
ce_text: saptarṣayo nāradaś ca te tvāṃ rakṣantu sarvataḥ / nakṣatrāṇi ca sarvāṇi grahāś ca sahadevatāḥ / mahāvanāni carato muniveṣasya dhīmataḥ

vulgate_text: dyaurantarikṣam pṛthivī nadyassarvāstathaiva ca / nakṣatrāṇi ca sarvāṇi grahāḥ ca sahadevatāḥ
ce_text: saptarṣayo nāradaś ca te tvāṃ rakṣantu sarvataḥ / nakṣatrāṇi ca sarvāṇi grahāś ca sahadevatāḥ / mahāvanāni carato muniveṣasya dhīmataḥ

vulgate_text: kalāśca kāṣṭhāśca tathā tava śarma diśantu te / mahā vanāni carataḥ muni veṣasya dhīmataḥ
ce_text: saptarṣayo nāradaś ca te tvāṃ rakṣantu sarvataḥ / nakṣatrāṇi ca sarvāṇi grahāś ca sahadevatāḥ / mahāvanāni carato muniveṣasya dhīmataḥ

vulgate_text: kravyādānām ca sarveṣam mābhūtputraka te bhayam / plavagā vṛścikā damśā maśakāḥ caiva kānane
ce_text: plavagā vṛścikā daṃśā maśakāś caiva kānane / sarīsṛpāś ca kīṭāś ca mā bhūvan gahane tava

vulgate_text: sarvebhyaḥ caiva devebhyo ye ca te paripanthinaḥ / guruḥ somaśca sūryaśca dhanado'tha yamastathā
ce_text: svasti te 'stv āntarikṣebhyaḥ pārthivebhyaḥ punaḥ punaḥ / sarvebhyaś caiva devebhyo ye ca te paripanthinaḥ

vulgate_text: upasparśanakāle tu pāntu tvām raghundadana / sarva loka prabhur brahmā bhūta bhartā tathā ṛṣayaḥ
ce_text: sarvalokaprabhur brahmā bhūtabhartā tatharṣayaḥ / ye ca śeṣāḥ surās te tvāṃ rakṣantu vanavāsinam

vulgate_text: stutibhiḥ ca anurūpābhir ānarca āyata locanā / jvalanam samupādāya brāhmaṇena mahātmanā
ce_text: iti mālyaiḥ suragaṇān gandhaiś cāpi yaśasvinī / stutibhiś cānurūpābhir ānarcāyatalocanā

vulgate_text: dakṣiṇām pradadau kāmyām rāghavam cedamabravīt / yan mangalam sahasra akṣe sarva deva namaḥ kṛte
ce_text: yan maṅgalaṃ sahasrākṣe sarvadevanamaskṛte / vṛtranāśe samabhavat tat te bhavatu maṅgalam

vulgate_text: amṛtam prārthayānasya tat te bhavatu mangalam / amṛtotpādane daityān ghnato vajradharasya yat
ce_text: yan maṅgalaṃ suparṇasya vinatākalpayat purā / amṛtaṃ prārthayānasya tat te bhavatu maṅgalam

vulgate_text: yadāsīnmaṅgalam prādāt tatte bhavatu maṅgalam / ṛtavaḥ sāgarā dvīpā vedā lokā diśścate
ce_text: yan maṅgalaṃ suparṇasya vinatākalpayat purā / amṛtaṃ prārthayānasya tat te bhavatu maṅgalam

vulgate_text: gandāmścāpi samālabhya rāmamāyatalo canā / oṣadhīm ca api siddha arthām viśalya karaṇīm śubhām
ce_text: oṣadhīṃ cāpi siddhārthāṃ viśalyakaraṇīṃ śubhām / cakāra rakṣāṃ kausalyā mantrair abhijajāpa ca

vulgate_text: cakāra rakṣām kausalyā mantraiḥ abhijajāpa ca / uvācātiprahṛṣṭeva sā duḥkhavaśartinī
ce_text: oṣadhīṃ cāpi siddhārthāṃ viśalyakaraṇīṃ śubhām / cakāra rakṣāṃ kausalyā mantrair abhijajāpa ca

vulgate_text: vāṅmātreṇa na bhāvena vācā samsajjamānayā / ānamya mūrdhni ca āghrāya pariṣvajya yaśasvinī
ce_text: ānamya mūrdhni cāghrāya pariṣvajya yaśasvinī / avadat putra siddhārtho gaccha rāma yathāsukham

vulgate_text: paśyāmi tvām sukham vatsa susthitam rāja veśmani / praṇaṣṭakuḥkhasamkalpā harṣavidyotitānanā
ce_text: arogaṃ sarvasiddhārtham ayodhyāṃ punar āgatam / paśyāmi tvāṃ sukhaṃ vatsa susthitaṃ rājaveśmani

vulgate_text: saha tvayā gamiśyāmi vasamadya na samśayaḥ / nāham śakyā mahābhāga nivartayitu mudyatā
ce_text: phalamūlāśanā nityaṃ bhaviṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ / na te duḥkhaṃ kariṣyāmi nivasantī saha tvayā

vulgate_text: abhiṣekam kariṣyāmi tāsu nityam yatavratā / saha tvayā viśāla akṣa ramsye parama nandinī
ce_text: saha tvayā viśālākṣa raṃsye paramanandinī / evaṃ varṣasahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ vāhaṃ tvayā saha

vulgate_text: evam varṣa sahasrāṇām śatam vā aham tvayā saha / vyatikramam na vetsyāmi svargo'pi hi na me mataḥ
ce_text: saha tvayā viśālākṣa raṃsye paramanandinī / evaṃ varṣasahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ vāhaṃ tvayā saha

vulgate_text: sāntvayitvā punastām tu bāṣpadūṣitalocanām / nivartanārthe dharmātmā vākyametaduvāca ha
ce_text: sa evaṃ bruvatīṃ sītāṃ dharmajño dharmavatsalaḥ / nivartanārthe dharmātmā vākyam etad uvāca ha

vulgate_text: cintayantīm tathā tām tu nivartayitum ātmavān / tāmroṣṭhīṃ sa tadā sītām kākutstho bahv asāntvayat
ce_text: cintayantīṃ tathā tāṃ tu nivartayitum ātmavān / krodhāviṣṭāṃ tu vaidehīṃ kākutstho bahv asāntvayat

vulgate_text: sā hi diṣṭā'navadyāṅgī vanāya vadirekṣaṇe / anugaccasva mām bhīru saha dharma carī bhava
ce_text: sa māṃ pitā yathā śāsti satyadharmapathe sthitaḥ / tathā vartitum icchāmi sa hi dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ / anugacchasva māṃ bhīru sahadharmacarī bhava

vulgate_text: aṅgadāni vicitrāṇi keyūrāṇi śubhāni ca / paryankam agrya āstaraṇam nānā ratna vibhūṣitam
ce_text: paryaṅkam agryāstaraṇaṃ nānāratnavibhūṣitam / tam apīcchati vaidehī pratiṣṭhāpayituṃ tvayi

vulgate_text: tataḥ asya dhanam ājahruḥ sarvam eva upajīvinaḥ / sa rāśiḥ sumahāmstatra darśanīyo hyadṛśyata
ce_text: ity uktvā duḥkhitaṃ sarvaṃ janaṃ tam upajīvinam / uvācedaṃ dhanadhyakṣaṃ dhanam ānīyatām iti / tato 'sya dhanam ājahruḥ sarvam evopajīvinaḥ

vulgate_text: tatra āsīt pingalo gārgyaḥ trijaṭaḥ nāma vai dvijaḥ / kṣatavṛttirvane nityam phālakuddālalāṅgalī
ce_text: tatrāsīt piṅgalo gārgyas trijaṭo nāma vai dvijaḥ / ā pañcamāyāḥ kakṣyāyā nainaṃ kaś cid avārayat

vulgate_text: bhṛgvaṅgirasamam dīptyā trijaṭam janasamsadi / ā pancamāyāḥ kakṣyāyā na enam kaścit avārayat
ce_text: tatrāsīt piṅgalo gārgyas trijaṭo nāma vai dvijaḥ / ā pañcamāyāḥ kakṣyāyā nainaṃ kaś cid avārayat

vulgate_text: rajasā abhyavakīrṇāni parityaktāni daivataiḥ / mūṣakaiḥ paridhāvadbhirudbilairāvṛtāni ca
ce_text: rajasābhyavakīrṇāni parityaktāni daivataiḥ / asmattyaktāni veśmāni kaikeyī pratipadyatām

vulgate_text: duṣkāleneva bhagnāni bhibhājanavanti ca / asmat tyaktāni veśmāni kaikeyī pratipadyatām
ce_text: rajasābhyavakīrṇāni parityaktāni daivataiḥ / asmattyaktāni veśmāni kaikeyī pratipadyatām

vulgate_text: iti evam vividhā vāco nānā jana samīritāḥ / tṛṇamāmsaphalādānām deśam vyālamṛgadvijam
ce_text: ity evaṃ vividhā vāco nānājanasamīritāḥ / śuśrāva rāmaḥ śrutvā ca na vicakre 'sya mānasaṃ

vulgate_text: tvāmaham satyamicchāmi nānṛtam puruṣarṣabha / pratyakṣam tava satyena sukṛtena ca te śape
ce_text: naivāhaṃ rājyam icchāmi na sukhaṃ na ca maithilīm / tvām ahaṃ satyam icchāmi nānṛtaṃ puruṣarṣabha

vulgate_text: sā viṣaṇṇā ca samtrastā kaikeyī vākyam abravīt / rājānamevābhimukhī kaikeyī vākyamabravīt
ce_text: sā viṣaṇṇā ca saṃtrastā kaikeyī vākyam abravīt / rājyaṃ gatajanaṃ sādho pītamaṇḍāṃ surām iva / nirāsvādyatamaṃ śūnyaṃ bharato nābhipatsyate

vulgate_text: vahantam kim tudasi mām niyujya dhuri mā āhite / anārye kṛtyamārbdham kim na pūrvamupārudhaḥ
ce_text: kaikeyyāṃ muktalajjāyāṃ vadantyām atidāruṇam / rājā daśaratho vākyam uvācāyatalocanām / vahantaṃ kiṃ tudasi māṃ niyujya dhuri māhite

vulgate_text: tasyaitatkrodhasamyuktamuktam śrutvā varāṅganā / kaikeyī dvi guṇam kruddhā rājānam idam abravīt
ce_text: kaikeyī dviguṇaṃ kruddhā rājānam idam abravīt / tavaiva vaṃśe sagaro jyeṣṭhaṃ putram upārudhat / asamañja iti khyātaṃ tathāyaṃ gantum arhati

vulgate_text: aśrusaṃpūrṇnetrā ca dharmajñā dharmadarśinī / gandharvarājapratimam bhartāramidamabravīt
ce_text: sā vyapatrapamāṇeva pratigṛhya ca durmanāḥ / gandharvarājapratimaṃ bhartāram idam abravīt / kathaṃ nu cīraṃ badhnanti munayo vanavāsinaḥ

vulgate_text: katham nu cīram badhnanti munayo vana vāsinaḥ / iti hyakuśalā sītā sāmumoha muhurmuhuḥ
ce_text: sā vyapatrapamāṇeva pratigṛhya ca durmanāḥ / gandharvarājapratimaṃ bhartāram idam abravīt / kathaṃ nu cīraṃ badhnanti munayo vanavāsinaḥ

vulgate_text: sa baddha iva pāśena kiśoro mātaram yathā / dharmapāśena samkṣiptaḥ prakāśam nābhudaikṣata
ce_text: anvīkṣamāṇo rāmas tu viṣaṇṇaṃ bhrāntacetasaṃ / rājānaṃ mātaraṃ caiva dadarśānugatau pathi / dharmapāśena saṃkṣiptaḥ prakāśaṃ nābhyudaikṣata

vulgate_text: rāmalakṣmaṇasītārtham sravantīm vāri netrajam / asakṛt praikṣata tadā nṛtyantīm iva mātaram
ce_text: tathā rudantīṃ kausalyāṃ rathaṃ tam anudhāvatīm / krośantīṃ rāma rāmeti hā sīte lakṣmaṇeti ca / asakṛt praikṣata tadā nṛtyantīm iva mātaram

vulgate_text: tasmimstu puruṣavyāghre viniryāti kṛtāñjalau / ārtaśabdo'tha samjajñe strīṇāmantahpute tadā
ce_text: tasmiṃs tu puruṣavyāghre niṣkrāmati kṛtāñjalau / ārtaśabdo hi saṃjajñe strīṇām antaḥpure mahān

vulgate_text: vyasṛjan kabalānnāgā gāvo vatsānna pāyayan / putram prathamajam labdhvā jananī nābhyanandata
ce_text: nāgnihotrāṇy ahūyanta sūryaś cāntaradhīyata / vyasṛjan kavalān nāgā gāvo vatsān na pāyayan

vulgate_text: sakāmā bhava kaikeyi vidhavā rājyam āvasa / kaṇṭakākramaṇa klāntāvanamadya gamiṣyati
ce_text: sakāmā bhava kaikeyi vidhavā rājyam āvasa / na hi taṃ puruṣavyāghraṃ vinā jīvitum utsahe

vulgate_text: iti bruvantam rājāna manayan dvārdarśinaḥ / kausalyāyā gṛham tatra nyaveśyata vinītavat
ce_text: kausalyāyā gṛhaṃ śīghraṃ rāma mātur nayantu mām / iti bruvantaṃ rājānam anayan dvāradarśitaḥ

vulgate_text: punaḥ praviṣṭam dṛṣṭvā tamabhiṣiktam mahāśriyam / samutsrakṣyasi netrābhyām kṣipramānndajam payaḥ
ce_text: duḥkhajaṃ visṛjanty asraṃ niṣkrāmantam udīkṣya yam / samutsrakṣyasi netrābhyāṃ kṣipram ānandajaṃ payaḥ

vulgate_text: abhivādya namasyantam śūram sasuhṛdam sutam / mudāsraiḥ prokṣyasi punarmegharāji rivācalam
ce_text: abhivādayamānaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā sasuhṛdaṃ sutam / mudāśru mokṣyase kṣipraṃ meghalekeva vārṣikī

vulgate_text: dharmataḥ sa viśuddhātmā vīraḥ śubhadṛḍhaprataḥ / upavāhyaḥ tu vo bhartā na apavāhyaḥ purāt vanam
ce_text: vahanto javanā rāmaṃ bho bho jātyās turaṃgamāḥ / nivartadhvaṃ na gantavyaṃ hitā bhavata bhartari / upavāhyas tu vo bhartā nāpavāhyaḥ purād vanam

vulgate_text: prasraviṣyanti toyāni vimalāni mahīdharāḥ / vidarśayantaḥ vividhān bhūyaḥ citrāmaḥ ca nirjharān
ce_text: vidarśayanto vividhān bhūyaś citrāṃś ca nirjharān / pādapāḥ parvatāgreṣu ramayiṣyanti rāghavam

vulgate_text: rājarṣīṇām hi loke'smin ratyartham mṛgayā vane / kāle kṛtām tām manujairdhanvināmabhikāṅkṣitām
ce_text: nātyartham abhikāṅkṣāmi mṛgayāṃ sarayūvane / ratir hy eṣātulā loke rājarṣigaṇasaṃmatā

vulgate_text: viśālān kosalān ramyān yātvā lakṣmaṇa pūrvajaḥ / ayodhyābhimukho dhīmān prāññlirvākvamabravīt
ce_text: viśālān kosalān ramyān yātvā lakṣmaṇapūrvajaḥ / āsasāda mahābāhuḥ śṛṅgaverapuraṃ prati

vulgate_text: hamsa sarasa samghuṣṭām cakra vāka upakūjitām / sadāmadaiśca vihagairabhisamnāditām tarām
ce_text: haṃsasārasasaṃghuṣṭāṃ cakravākopakūjitām / śiṃśumaraiś ca nakraiś ca bhujaṃgaiś ca niṣevitām

vulgate_text: phalaiḥ puṣpaiḥ kisalayairvaṛtām gulmaiddvijaistathā / śimśumaraiḥ ca nakraiḥ ca bhujamgaiḥ ca niṣevitām
ce_text: haṃsasārasasaṃghuṣṭāṃ cakravākopakūjitām / śiṃśumaraiś ca nakraiś ca bhujaṃgaiś ca niṣevitām

vulgate_text: īdṛśam hi mahābāho kaḥ prapsyatyatithim priyam / tataḥ guṇavad anna adyam upādāya pṛthag vidham / arghyam ca upānayat kṣipram vākyam ca idam uvāca ha
ce_text: tato guṇavadannādyam upādāya pṛthagvidham / arghyaṃ copānayat kṣipraṃ vākyaṃ cedam uvāca ha

vulgate_text: na hi me aviditam kimcit vane asmimaḥ carataḥ sadā / catur angam hi api balam sumahat prasahemahi
ce_text: na hi me 'viditaṃ kiṃ cid vane 'smiṃś carataḥ sadā / caturaṅgaṃ hy api balaṃ sumahat prasahemahi

vulgate_text: tato'bravīddāśarathiḥ sumantram / spṛśan kareṇottamadakṣiṇena / sumantra śīghram punareva yāhi / rājñaḥ sakāśe bhavacāpramattaḥ
ce_text: ātmānaṃ tv abhyanujñātam avekṣyārtaḥ sa sārathiḥ / sumantraḥ puruṣavyāghram aikṣvākam idam abravīt

vulgate_text: nivartasva iti uvāca enam etāvadd hi kṛtam mama / ratham vihāya padbhyām tu gamiṣyāmi mahāvanam
ce_text: nivartasvety uvācainam etāvad dhi kṛtaṃ mama / yānaṃ vihāya padbhyāṃ tu gamiṣyāmo mahāvanam

vulgate_text: lakṣmaṇasya ātmanaḥ caiva rāmaḥ tena akaroj jaṭāḥ / dīrghabāhurnaravyāghro jaṭilatva madhārayat
ce_text: tat kṣīraṃ rājaputrāya guhaḥ kṣipram upāharat / lakṣmaṇasyātmanaś caiva rāmas tenākaroj jaṭāḥ

vulgate_text: atha abravīn mahā bāhuḥ sumitra ānanda vardhanam / bhava samrakṣaṇārthāya sajane vijane'pi vā
ce_text: athābravīn mahābāhuḥ sumitrānandavardhanam / agrato gaccha saumitre sītā tvām anugacchatu

vulgate_text: avaśyam rakṣaṇam kāryamadṛṣṭe vijane vane / agrataḥ gacca saumitre sītā tvām anugaccatu
ce_text: athābravīn mahābāhuḥ sumitrānandavardhanam / agrato gaccha saumitre sītā tvām anugacchatu

vulgate_text: na hi tāvadatikrāntā sukarā kācana kriyā / adya duḥkham tu vaidehī vanavāsasya vetsyati
ce_text: pṛṣṭhato 'haṃ gamiṣyāmi tvāṃ ca sītāṃ ca pālayan / adya duḥkhaṃ tu vaidehī vanavāsasya vetsyati

vulgate_text: bhagavann itāasannaḥ paura jānapado janaḥ / sudarśamiha mām prekṣya manye'ha mimamāśramam

vulgate_text: tat śrutvā rāghaveṇa uktam rākṣasaḥ praśritam vacaḥ / idam provāca kākutstham virādhaḥ puruṣarṣabham
ce_text: sa bhagnabāhuḥ saṃvigno nipapātāśu rākṣasaḥ / dharaṇyāṃ meghasaṃkāśo vajrabhinna ivācalaḥ / idaṃ provāca kākutsthaṃ virādhaḥ puruṣarṣabham

vulgate_text: babhūva svarga saṃprāpto nyasta deho mahābalaḥ / tat śrutvā rāghavaḥ vākyam lakṣmaṇam vyādideśa ha
ce_text: evam uktvā tu kākutsthaṃ virādhaḥ śarapīḍitaḥ / babhūva svargasaṃprāpto nyastadeho mahābalaḥ

vulgate_text: vibhrājamānam vapuṣā sūrya vaiśvānara prabham / ratha pravaram ārūḍham ākāśe vibudha anugam
ce_text: vibhrājamānaṃ vapuṣā sūryavaiśvānaropamam / asaṃspṛśantaṃ vasudhāṃ dadarśa vibudheśvaram

vulgate_text: apaśyat vimalam chatram citra mālya upaśobhitam / cāmara vyajane ca agrye rukma daṇḍe mahādhane
ce_text: cāmaravyajane cāgrye rukmadaṇḍe mahādhane / gṛhīte vananārībhyāṃ dhūyamāne ca mūrdhani

vulgate_text: antarikṣa gatam devam gīrbhir agryābhir aiḍiyan / saha saṃbhāṣamāṇe tu śarabhaṃgena vāsave
ce_text: gandharvāmarasiddhāś ca bahavaḥ paramarṣayaḥ / antarikṣagataṃ devaṃ vāgbhir agryābhir īḍire

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā śata kratum tatra rāmo lakṣmaṇam abravīt / rāmo'tha ratham uddiśya bhrātur darśayata adbhutam
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā śatakratuṃ tatra rāmo lakṣmaṇam abravīt / ye hayāḥ puruhūtasya purā śakrasya naḥ śrutāḥ / antarikṣagatā divyās ta ime harayo dhruvam

vulgate_text: arciṣmantam śriyā juṣṭam adbhutam paśya lakṣmaṇa / pratapantam iva ādityam antarikṣa gatam ratham
ce_text: haribhir vājibhir yuktam antarikṣagataṃ ratham / dadarśādūratas tasya taruṇādityasaṃnibham

vulgate_text: tasya romāṇi keśām ca tadā vahniḥ mahātmanaḥ / jīrṇam tvacam tad asthīni yat ca māṃsam ca śoṇitam
ce_text: tasya romāṇi keśāṃś ca dadāhāgnir mahātmanaḥ / jīrṇaṃ tvacaṃ tathāsthīni yac ca māṃsaṃ ca śoṇitam

vulgate_text: na evam arhatha mām vaktum ājñāpyaḥ aham tapasvinām / kevalena sva kāryeṇa praveṣṭavyam vanam mayā
ce_text: etac chrutvā tu kākutsthas tāpasānāṃ tapasvinām / idaṃ provāca dharmātmā sarvān eva tapasvinaḥ / naivam arhatha māṃ vaktum ājñāpyo 'haṃ tapasvinam

vulgate_text: tapasvinām raṇe śatrūn hantum icchāmi rākṣasān / paśyantu vīryam ṛṣayaḥ saḥ brātur me tapodhanāḥ
ce_text: bhavatām arthasiddhyartham āgato 'haṃ yadṛcchayā / tasya me 'yaṃ vane vāso bhaviṣyati mahāphalaḥ / tapasvināṃ raṇe śatrūn hantum icchāmi rākṣasān

vulgate_text: sa gatvā dīrgham adhvānam nadīḥ tīrtvā bahu udakāḥ / dadarśa vimalam śailam mahā merum iva unnatam
ce_text: sa gatvā dūram adhvānaṃ nadīs tīrtva bahūdakāḥ / dadarśa vipulaṃ śailaṃ mahāmegham ivonnatam

vulgate_text: svāgatam te raghu śreṣṭha rāma satyabhṛtām vara / āśramao ayam tvayā ākrāntaḥ sanātha iva sāṃpratam
ce_text: svāgataṃ khalu te vīra rāma dharmabhṛtāṃ vara / āśramo 'yaṃ tvayākrāntaḥ sanātha iva sāmpratam

vulgate_text: upāgamya ca me devo mahādevaḥ sura īśvaraḥ / sarvān lokān jitān āha mama puṇyena karmaṇā
ce_text: citrakūṭam upādāya rājyabhraṣṭo 'si me śrutaḥ / ihopayātaḥ kākutstho devarājaḥ śatakratuḥ / sarvāṃl lokāñ jitān āha mama puṇyena karmaṇā

vulgate_text: nā anyo doṣo bhavet atra mṛgebhyaḥ anyatra viddhi vai / tat śrutvā vacanam tasya maharṣeḥ lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ
ce_text: tac chrutvā vacanaṃ tasya maharṣer lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ / uvāca vacanaṃ dhīro vikṛṣya saśaraṃ dhanuḥ

vulgate_text: uvāca vacanam dhīro vigṛhya sa śaram dhanuḥ / tān aham sumahābhāga mṛgasaṃghān samāgatān
ce_text: tān ahaṃ sumahābhāga mṛgasaṃghān samāgatān / hanyāṃ niśitadhāreṇa śareṇāśanivarcasā

vulgate_text: hanyām niśita dhāreṇa śareṇa nata parvaṇā / bhavān tatra abhiṣajyeta kim syāt kṛcchra taram tataḥ
ce_text: bhavāṃs tatrābhiṣajyeta kiṃ syāt kṛcchrataraṃ tataḥ / etasminn āśrame vāsaṃ ciraṃ tu na samarthaye

vulgate_text: anvāsya paścimām saṃdhyām tatra vāsam akalpayat / sutīkṣṇasya āśrame ramye sītayā lakṣmanena ca
ce_text: tam evam uktvā varadaṃ rāmaḥ saṃdhyām upāgamat / anvāsya paścimāṃ saṃdhyāṃ tatra vāsam akalpayat

vulgate_text: kuto abhilaṣaṇam strīṇām pareṣām dharma nāśanam / tava nāsti manuṣyendra na ca ābhūt te kadācana
ce_text: mithyāvākyaṃ na te bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati rāghava / kuto 'bhilaṣaṇaṃ strīṇāṃ pareṣāṃ dharmanāśanam

vulgate_text: parituṣṭo asmi aham sīte na hi aniṣṭo anuśāsyate / sadṛśam ca anurūpam ca kulasya tava śobhane / sadharma cāriṇī me tvam prāṇebhyo api garīyasī
ce_text: mama snehāc ca sauhārdād idam uktaṃ tvayā vacaḥ / parituṣṭo 'smy ahaṃ sīte na hy aniṣṭo 'nuśiṣyate / sadṛśaṃ cānurūpaṃ ca kulasya tava śobhane

vulgate_text: asmakam kasyacit sthānam eṣa prārthayate muniḥ / iti saṃvigna manasaḥ sarve tatra divaukasaḥ
ce_text: tataḥ pravyathitāḥ sarve devāḥ sāgnipurogamāḥ / abruvan vacanaṃ sarve paraspara samāgatāḥ / asmakaṃ kasya cit sthānam eṣa prārthayate muniḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ saṃpannam iti uktvā dattvā haste avanejanam / bhrātaram niṣkramasva iti ca ilvalaḥ samabhāṣata
ce_text: tataḥ saṃpannam ity uktvā dattvā hastāvasecanam / bhrātaraṃ niṣkramasveti ilvalaḥ so 'bhyabhāṣata

vulgate_text: nīvārān panasān sālān vanjulān tiniśān tathā / ciri bilvān madhūkān ca bilvān atha ca tindukān
ce_text: nīvārān panasāṃs tālāṃs timiśān vañjulān dhavān / ciribilvān madhūkāṃś ca bilvān api ca tindukān

vulgate_text: yathā uktam lakṣmaṇena eva śiṣyaḥ tasya agastasya saṃmataḥ / putrau daśarathasya imau rāmo lakṣmaṇa eva ca
ce_text: putrau daśarathasyemau rāmo lakṣmaṇa eva ca / praviṣṭāv āśramapadaṃ sītayā saha bhāryayā

vulgate_text: dhātur vidhātuḥ sthānam ca vāyoḥ sthānam tathaiva ca / sthānam ca pāśa hastasya vāruṇasya mahātmanaḥ
ce_text: somasthānaṃ bhagasthānaṃ sthānaṃ kauberam eva ca / dhātur vidhātuḥ sthānaṃ ca vāyoḥ sthānaṃ tathaiva ca

vulgate_text: kārtikeyasya ca sthānam dharma sthānam ca paśyati / tataḥ śiṣyaiḥ parivṛto munir api abhiniṣpatat
ce_text: tataḥ śiṣyaiḥ parivṛto munir apy abhiniṣpatat / taṃ dadarśāgrato rāmo munīnāṃ dīptatejasaṃ / abravīd vacanaṃ vīro lakṣmaṇaṃ lakṣmivardhanam

vulgate_text: so aham vāsa sahāyaḥ te bhaviṣyāmi yadi icchasi / idam durgam hi kāntāram mṛga rākṣasa sevitam sītām ca tāta rakṣiṣye tvayi yāte salakṣmaṇe
ce_text: so 'haṃ vāsasahāyas te bhaviṣyāmi yadīcchasi / sītāṃ ca tāta rakṣiṣye tvayi yāte salakṣmaṇe

vulgate_text: tarpayitvā atha salilaiḥ taiḥ pitṝn daivatāni ca / stuvanti sma uditam sūryam devatāaḥ ca tathā anaghāḥ
ce_text: tarpayitvātha salilais te pitṝn daivatāni ca / stuvanti smoditaṃ sūryaṃ devatāś ca samāhitāḥ

vulgate_text: uvāsa sukhitaḥ tatra pūjyamāno maharṣabhaḥ / sa rāmaḥ parṇa śālāyām āsīnaḥ saha sītayā
ce_text: sa rāmaḥ parṇaśālāyām āsīnaḥ saha sītayā / virarāja mahābāhuś citrayā candramā iva / lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā cakāra vividhāḥ kathāḥ

vulgate_text: āgataḥ tvam imam deśam katham rākṣasa sevitam / kim āgamana kṛtyam te tat tvam ākhyātum arhasi
ce_text: jaṭī tāpasarūpeṇa sabhāryaḥ śaracāpadhṛk / āgatas tvam imaṃ deśaṃ kathaṃ rākṣasasevitam

vulgate_text: tvām tu veditum icchāmi kasya tvam kā asi kasya vā / tvam hi tāvanmanojñāṃgī rākṣasī pratibhāsi me
ce_text: tvāṃ tu veditum icchāmi kathyatāṃ kāsi kasya vā / iha vā kiṃnimittaṃ tvam āgatā brūhi tattvataḥ

vulgate_text: araṇyam vicarāmi idam ekā sarva bhayaṃkarā / rāvaṇo nāma me bhrātā yadi te śrotram āgataḥ
ce_text: ahaṃ śūrpaṇakhā nāma rākṣasī kāmarūpiṇī / araṇyaṃ vicarāmīdam ekā sarvabhayaṃkarā

vulgate_text: vīro viśravasaḥ putro yadi te śrotram āgataḥ / pravṛddha nidraḥ ca sadā kuṃbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ
ce_text: rāvaṇo nāma me bhrātā rākṣaso rākṣaseśvaraḥ / pravṛddhanidraś ca sadā kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ

vulgate_text: aham prabhāva saṃpannā svacchaṃda bala gāminī / cirāya bhava bhartā me sītayā kim kariṣyasi
ce_text: tān ahaṃ samatikrāntā rāma tvāpūrvadarśanāt / samupetāsmi bhāvena bhartāraṃ puruṣottamam / cirāya bhava bhartā me sītayā kiṃ kariṣyasi

vulgate_text: viniṣpetuḥ tadā bhūmau valmīkāt iva pannagāḥ / taiḥ bhagna hṛdayā būmau chinna mūlā iva drumāḥ
ce_text: te bhinnahṛdayā bhūmau chinnamūlā iva drumāḥ / nipetuḥ śoṇitārdrāṅgā vikṛtā vigatāsavaḥ

vulgate_text: bhaktāḥ caiva anuraktāḥ ca hitāḥ ca mama nityaśaḥ / hanyamānā api na hanyante na na kuryuḥ vaco mama
ce_text: bhaktāś caivānuraktāś ca hitāś ca mama nityaśaḥ / ghnanto 'pi na nihantavyā na na kuryur vaco mama

vulgate_text: anātha vat vilapasi kim nu nāthe mayi sthite / uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha mā maivam vaiklavyam tyajyatām iti
ce_text: anāthavad vilapasi kiṃ nu nāthe mayi sthite / uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha mā bhaiṣīr vaiklavyaṃ tyajyatām iha

vulgate_text: apayāhi jana sthānāt tvaritaḥ saha bāndhavaḥ / jahi tvam samare mūḍhān yathā tu kulapāṃsana
ce_text: apayāhi janasthānāt tvaritaḥ sahabāndhavaḥ / niḥsattvasyālpavīryasya vāsas te kīdṛśas tv iha

vulgate_text: bhrātā ca asya mahā vīryo yena ca asmi virūpitā / evam vilāpya bahuśo rākṣsī pradarodarī
ce_text: rāmatejo'bhibhūto hi tvaṃ kṣipraṃ vinaśiṣyasi / sa hi tejaḥsamāyukto rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ / bhrātā cāsya mahāvīryo yena cāsmi virūpitā

vulgate_text: kharaḥ tu tān mahat sainyām ratha carma āyudha dhvajān / niryāta iti abravīt prekṣya dūṣaṇaḥ sarva rākṣasān
ce_text: kharas tu tān maheṣvāsān ghoracarmāyudhadhvajān / niryātety abravīd dṛṣṭvā rathasthaḥ sarvarākṣasān

vulgate_text: tān tu nirdhāvato dṛṣṭvā rākṣasān bhīma darśanam / kharasya atha rathaḥ kiṃcit jagāma tat anantaram
ce_text: tāṃs tv abhidravato dṛṣṭvā rākṣasān bhīmavikramān / kharasyāpi rathaḥ kiṃ cij jagāma tadanantaram

vulgate_text: prabhinnagajasaṃkāśatoyaśoṇitadhāriṇaḥ / yadvā -prabhinna gaja saṃkāśa toya śoṇita dhāriṇaḥ / ākāśam tat anākāśam cakruḥ bhīma aṃbu vāhakāḥ
