ce_text: prabhinnagirisaṃkāśās toyaśoṣitadhāriṇaḥ / ākāśaṃ tad anākāśaṃ cakrur bhīmā balāhakāḥ

vulgate_text: kaṃka gomāyu gṛdhrāḥ ca cukruśuḥ bhaya saṃśinaḥ / nityā aśiva karā yuddhe śivā ghora nidarśanāḥ
ce_text: nityāśivakarā yuddhe śivā ghoranidarśanāḥ / nedur balasyābhimukhaṃ jvālodgāribhir ānanaiḥ

vulgate_text: neduḥ balasya abhimukham jvāla udgāribhiḥ ānanaiḥ / kabandhaḥ parigha ābhāso dṛśyate bhāskara aṃtike
ce_text: kabandhaḥ parighābhāso dṛśyate bhāskarāntike / jagrāha sūryaṃ svarbhānur aparvaṇi mahāgrahaḥ

vulgate_text: mṛtyum maraṇa dharmeṇa saṃkruddho yojayāmi aham / rāghavam tam bala utsiktam bhrātaram ca asya lakṣmaṇam
ce_text: tārā api śarais tīkṣṇaiḥ pātayeyaṃ nabhastalāt / mṛtyuṃ maraṇadharmeṇa saṃkruddho yojayāmy aham

vulgate_text: cakrahasto yathā viṣṇuḥ sarvān asura sattamān / etat ca anyat ca bahuśo bruvāṇāḥ parama ṛṣayaḥ
ce_text: etac cānyac ca bahuśo bruvāṇāḥ paramarṣayaḥ / dadṛśur vāhinīṃ teṣāṃ rākṣasānāṃ gatāyuṣām

vulgate_text: jāta kautūhalāt tatra vimānasthāḥ ca devatāḥ / dadṛśur vāhinīm teṣām rākṣasānām gata āyuṣām
ce_text: etac cānyac ca bahuśo bruvāṇāḥ paramarṣayaḥ / dadṛśur vāhinīṃ teṣāṃ rākṣasānāṃ gatāyuṣām

vulgate_text: svasti go brāhmaṇānām ca lokānām ca iti saṃsthitāḥ / jayatām rāghavo yuddhe paulastyān rajanī carān
ce_text: jayatāṃ rāghavo yuddhe paulastyān rajanīcarān / cakrā hasto yathā yuddhe sarvān asurapuṃgavān

vulgate_text: cakra hasto yathā yuddhe sarvān asura puṃgavān / evam uktvā punaḥ pra ūcuḥ ālokya ca parasparam
ce_text: jayatāṃ rāghavo yuddhe paulastyān rajanīcarān / cakrā hasto yathā yuddhe sarvān asurapuṃgavān

vulgate_text: iti saṃbhāṣyamāṇo tu deva gaṃdharva cāraṇaiḥ / tato gaṃbhīra nirhrādam ghora carma āyudha dhvajam
ce_text: tato gambhīranirhrādaṃ ghoravarmāyudhadhvajam / anīkaṃ yātudhānānāṃ samantāt pratyadṛśyata

vulgate_text: anīkam yātudhānānām samantāt pratyadṛśyata / vīra ālāpān visṛjatām anyonyam abhigacchatām
ce_text: tato gambhīranirhrādaṃ ghoravarmāyudhadhvajam / anīkaṃ yātudhānānāṃ samantāt pratyadṛśyata

vulgate_text: dudruvuḥ yatra niḥśabdam pṛṣṭhato na avalokayan / tat ca anīkam mahāvegam rāmam samanuvartata
ce_text: tena śabdena vitrastāḥ śvāpadā vanacāriṇaḥ / dudruvur yatra niḥśabdaṃ pṛṣṭhato nāvalokayan

vulgate_text: te valāhaka saṃkāśā mahākāyā mahābalāḥ / abhyadhāvanta kākutstham rathaiḥ vājibhiḥ eva ca
ce_text: te balāhakasaṃkāśā mahānādā mahābalāḥ / abhyadhāvanta kākutsthaṃ rāmaṃ yuddhe jighāṃsavaḥ

vulgate_text: gajaiḥ parvata kūṭa abhaiḥ rāmam yuddhe jiṃghāsavaḥ / te rāme śara varṣāṇi vyasṛjan rakṣasām gaṇāḥ
ce_text: te rāme śaravarṣāṇi vyasṛjan rakṣasāṃ guṇāḥ / śailendram iva dhārābhir varṣamāṇā mahādhanāḥ

vulgate_text: śailendram iva dhārābhir varṣamāṇā mahādhanāḥ / sarvaiḥ parivṛto rāmo rākṣasaiḥ kṝradarśinaiḥ
ce_text: te rāme śaravarṣāṇi vyasṛjan rakṣasāṃ guṇāḥ / śailendram iva dhārābhir varṣamāṇā mahādhanāḥ

vulgate_text: bahūn sa hasta ābharaṇān ūrūn kari kara upamān / cicheda rāmaḥ samare śataśaḥ atha sahasraśaḥ
ce_text: tair dhanūṃṣi dhvajāgrāṇi varmāṇi ca śirāṃsi ca / bahūn sahastābharaṇān ūrūn karikaropamān

vulgate_text: teṣām bāṇaiḥ mahābāhuḥ śastrāṇi āvārya vīryavān / jahāra samare prāṇān ciccheda ca śiro dharān
ce_text: tāni bāṇair mahābāhuḥ śastrāṇy āvārya rāghavaḥ / jahāra samare prāṇāṃś ciccheda ca śirodharān

vulgate_text: tān sarvān dhanur ādāya samāśvāsya ca dūṣaṇaḥ / abhyadhāvata susaṃkruddhaḥ kruddhaḥ rudram kruddha iva antakaḥ
ce_text: tān sarvān punar ādāya samāśvāsya ca dūṣaṇaḥ / abhyadhāvata kākutsthaṃ kruddho rudram ivāntakaḥ

vulgate_text: druma varṣāṇi muṃcantaḥ śilā varṣāṇi rākṣasāḥ / tad babhūva adbhutam yuddham tumulam roma harṣaṇam
ce_text: tad babhūvādbhutaṃ yuddhaṃ tumulaṃ romaharṣaṇam / rāmasyāsya mahāghoraṃ punas teṣāṃ ca rakṣasām

vulgate_text: rāmasya asya mahāghoram punaḥ teṣām ca rakṣasām / te samantāt abhikruddhā rāghavam punar ārdayan
ce_text: tad babhūvādbhutaṃ yuddhaṃ tumulaṃ romaharṣaṇam / rāmasyāsya mahāghoraṃ punas teṣāṃ ca rakṣasām

vulgate_text: śara varṣaiḥ vicchinnam vavarṣuḥ tam samantataḥ / tat drumāṇām śilānām ca varṣam prāṇa haram mahat
ce_text: tad drumāṇāṃ śilānāṃ ca varṣaṃ prāṇaharaṃ mahat / pratijagrāha dharmātmā rāghavas tīkṣṇasāyakaiḥ

vulgate_text: sa papāta hato bhūmau viṭapī iva mahādrumaḥ / dūṣaṇasya anugān paṃca sahasrān kupitaḥ kṣaṇāt
ce_text: sthūlākṣasyākṣiṇī tīkṣṇaiḥ pūrayām āsa sāyakaiḥ / sa papāta hato bhūmau viṭapīva mahādrumaḥ

vulgate_text: ciccheda rāmaḥ tam bāṇaiḥ hṛdaye so abhavat jaḍaḥ / sāyakaiḥ ca aprameya ātmā sāmarṣaḥ tasya rakṣasaḥ
ce_text: sāyakaiś cāprameyātmā sāmarṣas tasya rakṣasaḥ / śirāṃsy apātayat trīṇi vegavadbhis tribhiḥ śataiḥ

vulgate_text: kāmam bahu api vaktavyam tvayi vakṣyāmi na tu aham / astam prāpnoti savitā yuddha vighnaḥ tato bhavet
ce_text: kāmaṃ bahv api vaktavyaṃ tvayi vakṣyāmi na tv aham / astaṃ gacched dhi savitā yuddhavighras tato bhavet

vulgate_text: tām āpatantīm mahatīm mṛtyu pāśa upamām gadām / aṃtarikṣa gatām rāmaḥ ciccheda bahudhā śaraiḥ
ce_text: tām āpatantīṃ jvalitāṃ mṛtyupāśopamāṃ gadā / antarikṣagatāṃ rāmaś ciccheda bahudhā śaraiḥ

vulgate_text: catur daśa sahasrāṇi rakṣsām kāma rūpiṇām / khara dūṣaṇa mukhyānām nihatāni mahāmṛdhe
ce_text: caturdaśa sahasrāṇi rākṣasānāṃ hatāni te / tvadvināśāt karomy adya teṣām aśrupramārjanam

vulgate_text: iti evam uktvā te sarve yayuḥ devā yathā āgatam / tato rāja ṛṣayaḥ sarve samgatāḥ parama ṛṣayaḥ
ce_text: tato rājarṣayaḥ sarve saṃgatāḥ paramarṣayaḥ / sabhājya muditā rāmam idaṃ vacanam abruvan

vulgate_text: babhūva hṛṣṭā vaidehī bhartāram pariṣvaje / mudā paramayā yuktā dṛṣṭvā rakṣo gaṇān hatān / rāmam ca eva avyayam dṛṣṭā tutoṣa janaka ātmajā
ce_text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā śatruhantāraṃ maharṣīṇāṃ sukhāvaham / babhūva hṛṣṭā vaidehī bhartāraṃ pariṣasvaje

vulgate_text: evam ukto mahātejā mārīcena sa rāvaṇa / tataḥ paścāt idam vākyam abravīt vākya kovidaḥ
ce_text: sa rāvaṇaḥ samāgamya vidhivat tena rakṣasā / tataḥ paścād idaṃ vākyam abravīd vākyakovidaḥ

vulgate_text: viṣṇu cakra nipātaiḥ ca śataśo deva saṃyuge / anyaiḥ śastraiḥ prahāraiḥ ca mahāyuddheṣu tāḍitam
ce_text: viṣṇucakranipātaiś ca śataśo devasaṃyuge / āhatāṅgaṃ samastaiś ca devapraharaṇais tathā

vulgate_text: āsane sūpaviṣṭam tam kāle kālam iva udyatam / rākṣasendram mahābhāgam paulastya kula nandanam
ce_text: rākṣasī bhrātaraṃ krūraṃ sā dadarśa mahābalam / taṃ divyavastrābharaṇaṃ divyamālyopaśobhitam / rākṣasendraṃ mahābhāgaṃ paulastya kulanandanam

vulgate_text: āyudham kim ca rāmasya yena te rākṣasāḥ hatā / kharaḥ ca nihataḥ saṃkhye dūṣaṇaḥ triśirāḥ tathā
ce_text: āyudhaṃ kiṃ ca rāmasya nihatā yena rākṣasāḥ / kharaś ca nihataṃ saṃkhye dūṣaṇas triśirās tathā

vulgate_text: tat tvam brūhi manojñāngī kena tvam ca virūpitā / iti uktā rākṣasa indreṇa rākṣasī krodha mūrcchitā
ce_text: ity uktā rākṣasendreṇa rākṣasī krodhamūrchitā / tato rāmaṃ yathānyāyam ākhyātum upacakrame

vulgate_text: tapta kāṃcana varṇa ābhā rakta tuṃga nakhī śubhā / sītā nāma varārohā vaidehī tanu madhyamā
ce_text: rāmasya tu viśālākṣī dharmapatnī yaśasvinī / sītā nāma varārohā vaidehī tanumadhyamā

vulgate_text: kadalya aṭavi saṃśobham nālikera upaśobhitam / sālaiḥ tālaiḥ tamālaiḥ ca tarubhiḥ ca supuṣpitaiḥ
ce_text: kadaly āḍhakisaṃbādhaṃ nālikeropaśobhitam / sālais tālais tamālaiś ca tarubhiś ca supuṣpitaiḥ

vulgate_text: śailāni pravarān caiva pravāla nicayān tathā / kāṃcanāni ca śṛṃgāṇi rājatāni tathaiva ca
ce_text: śaṅkhānāṃ prastaraṃ caiva pravālanicayaṃ tathā / kāñcanāni ca śailāni rājatāni ca sarvaśaḥ

vulgate_text: sa rāvaṇaḥ samāgamya vidhivat tena rakṣasā / mārīcena arcito rājā sarva kāmaiḥ amānuṣaiḥ
ce_text: sa rāvaṇaḥ samāgamya vidhivat tena rakṣasā / tataḥ paścād idaṃ vākyam abravīd vākyakovidaḥ

vulgate_text: evam ukto mahātejā mārīcena sa rāvaṇa / tataḥ paścāt idam vākyam abravīt vākya kovidaḥ
ce_text: sa rāvaṇaḥ samāgamya vidhivat tena rakṣasā / tataḥ paścād idaṃ vākyam abravīd vākyakovidaḥ

vulgate_text: nānā śastra praharaṇāḥ khara pramukha rākṣasaḥ / tena saṃjāta roṣeṇa rāmeṇa raṇa mūrdhani
ce_text: tena saṃjātaroṣeṇa rāmeṇa raṇamūrdhani / anuktvā paruṣaṃ kiṃ cic charair vyāpāritaṃ dhanuḥ

vulgate_text: vīrye yuddhe ca darpe ca na hi asti sadṛśaḥ tava / upāyato mahān śūro mahā māya viśāradaḥ
ce_text: tat sahāyo bhava tvaṃ me samartho hy asi rākṣasa / vīrye yuddhe ca darpe ca na hy asti sadṛśas tava

vulgate_text: tasya vai nara siṃhasya siṃha uraskasya bhāminī / prāṇebhyo api priyatarā bhāryā nityam anuvratā
ce_text: prāṇebhyo 'pi priyatarā bhāryā nityam anuvratā / dīptasyeva hutāśasya śikhā sītā sumadhyamā

vulgate_text: na sā dharṣayitum śakyā maithilī ojasvinaḥ priyā / dīptasya iva huta āśasya śikhā sītā sumadhyamā
ce_text: prāṇebhyo 'pi priyatarā bhāryā nityam anuvratā / dīptasyeva hutāśasya śikhā sītā sumadhyamā

vulgate_text: kāmam tu mama yat sainyam mayā saha gamiṣyati / balena caturaṃgeṇa svayam etya niśācaram
ce_text: ūna ṣoḍaśa varṣo 'yam akṛtāstraś ca rāghavaḥ / kāmaṃ tu mama yat sainyaṃ mayā saha gamiṣyati / badhiṣyāmi muniśreṣṭha śatruṃ tava yathepsitam

vulgate_text: rāmāt na anyat balam loke paryāptam tasya rakṣasaḥ / devatānām api bhavān samareṣu abhipālakaḥ
ce_text: ity evam uktaḥ sa munī rājānaṃ punar abravīt / rāmān nānyad balaṃ loke paryāptaṃ tasya rakṣasaḥ

vulgate_text: na icchatā tāta mām hantum tadā vīreṇa rakṣitaḥ / rāmasya śara vegena nirasto bhrānta cetanaḥ
ce_text: rāmasya śaravegena nirasto bhrāntacetanaḥ / pātito 'haṃ tadā tena gambhīre sāgarāmbhasi / prāpya saṃjñāṃ cirāt tāta laṅkāṃ prati gataḥ purīm

vulgate_text: para dāra abhimarṣāt tu na anayat pāpa taram mahat / pramadānām sahasrāṇi tava rājan parigrahe
ce_text: pramadānāṃ sahasrāṇi tava rājan parigrahaḥ / bhava svadāranirataḥ svakulaṃ rakṣarākṣasa

vulgate_text: kalatrāṇi ca saumyāni mitra vargam tathaiva ca / yadi icchasi ciram bhoktum mā kṛthā rāma vipriyam
ce_text: mānaṃ vṛddhiṃ ca rājyaṃ ca jīvitaṃ ceṣṭam ātmanaḥ / yadīcchasi ciraṃ bhoktuṃ mā kṛthā rāma vipriyam

vulgate_text: aham tasya prabhāvajño na yuddham tena te kṣamam / balim vā namuciṃ vā api hanyaddhi raghunaṃaṃdana
ce_text: ahaṃ tasya prabhāvajño na yuddhaṃ tena te kṣamam / raṇe rāmeṇa yudhyasva kṣamāṃ vā kuru rākṣasa / na te rāmakathā kāryā yadi māṃ draṣṭum icchasi

vulgate_text: auṣṇyam tathā vikramam ca saumyam daṇḍam prasannatām / dhārayanti mahātāmno rājānaḥ kṣaṇadācara
ce_text: pañcarūpāṇi rājāno dhārayanty amitaujasaḥ / agner indrasya somasya yamasya varuṇasya ca / auṣṇyaṃ tathā vikramaṃ ca saumyaṃ daṇḍaṃ prasannatām

vulgate_text: mayā uktam api ca etāvat tvām prati amitavikrama / asmin tu sa bhavān kṛtye sāhāyyam kartum arhasi
ce_text: abhyāgataṃ māṃ daurātmyāt paruṣaṃ vadasīdṛśam / guṇadoṣau na pṛcchāmi kṣamaṃ cātmani rākṣasa / asmiṃs tu sa bhavān kṛtye sāhāyyaṃ kartum arhati

vulgate_text: śruṇu tat karma sāhāyye yat kāryam vacanāt mama / sauvarṇaḥ tvam mṛgo bhūtvā citro rajata bindubhiḥ
ce_text: sauvarṇas tvaṃ mṛgo bhūtvā citro rajatabindubhiḥ / pralobhayitvā vaidehīṃ yatheṣṭaṃ gantum arhasi

vulgate_text: āśrame tasya rāmasya sītāyāḥ pramukhe cara / pralobhayitvā vaidehīm yathā iṣṭam gantum arhasi
ce_text: sauvarṇas tvaṃ mṛgo bhūtvā citro rajatabindubhiḥ / pralobhayitvā vaidehīṃ yatheṣṭaṃ gantum arhasi

vulgate_text: gaccha saumya śivam mārgam kāryasya asya vivṛddhaye / aham tu anugamiṣyāmi sa ratho daṇḍakā vanam
ce_text: gaccha saumya śivaṃ mārgaṃ kāryasyāsya vivṛddhaye / prāpya sītām ayuddhena vañcayitvā tu rāghavam / laṅkāṃ prati gamiṣyāmi kṛtakāryaḥ saha tvayā

vulgate_text: ājñapto rāvaṇena ittham pratikūlam ca rājavat / abravīt paruṣam vākyam niḥśanko rākṣasādhipam
ce_text: ājñapto rājavad vākyaṃ pratikūlaṃ niśācaraḥ / abravīt paruṣaṃ vākyaṃ mārīco rākṣasādhipam

vulgate_text: tad idam kāka tālīyam ghoram āsāditam mayā / atra tvam śocanīyo asi sa sainyo vinaśiṣyasi
ce_text: tad idaṃ kākatālīyaṃ ghoram āsāditaṃ tvayā / atra kiṃ śobhanaṃ yat tvaṃ sasainyo vinaśiṣyasi

vulgate_text: etat śauṇḍīrya - cauttirya -nyuktam te mat cchaṃda vaśa vartinaḥ / idānīm asi mārīcaḥ pūrvam anyo niśācaraḥ
ce_text: etac chauṇḍīryayuktaṃ te macchandād iva bhāṣitam / idānīm asi mārīcaḥ pūrvam anyo niśācaraḥ

vulgate_text: tathā iti uvāca enam rāvaṇam tāṭakā sutaḥ / tato rāvaṇa mārīcau vimānam iva tam ratham
ce_text: tato rāvaṇamārīcau vimānam iva taṃ ratham / āruhya yayatuḥ śīghraṃ tasmād āśramamaṇḍalāt

vulgate_text: mṛgo bhūtvā āśrama dvāri rāmasya vicacāra ha / sa tu rūpam samāsthāya mahat adbhuta darśanam
ce_text: sa rāvaṇavacaḥ śrutvā mārīco rākṣasas tadā / mṛgo bhūtvāśramadvāri rāmasya vicacāra ha

vulgate_text: lobitaḥ tena rūpeṇa sītāyā ca pracoditaḥ / uvāca rāghavo hṛṣṭo bhrātaram lakṣmaṇam vacaḥ
ce_text: evaṃ sītāvacaḥ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā ca mṛgam adbhutam / uvāca rāghavo hṛṣṭo bhrātaraṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ vacaḥ

vulgate_text: utthāya bahavo anena mṛgayāyām janādhipāḥ / nihatāḥ parama iṣvāsāḥ tasmāt vadhyaḥ tu ayam mṛgaḥ
ce_text: utthāya bahavo yena mṛgayāyāṃ janādhipāḥ / nihatāḥ parameṣvāsās tasmād vadhyas tv ayaṃ mṛgaḥ

vulgate_text: darśana adarśanena eva saḥ apākarṣata rāghavam / sudūram āśramasya asya mārico mṛgatām gataḥ
ce_text: darśanādarśanenaiva so 'pākarṣata rāghavam / āsīt kruddhas tu kākutstho vivaśas tena mohitaḥ

vulgate_text: sa tam unmādayāmāsa mṛgarūpo niśācara / mṛgaiḥ parivṛto atha vanyaiḥ adūrāt pratyadṛśyata
ce_text: athāvatasthe suśrāntaś chāyām āśritya śādvale / mṛgaiḥ parivṛto vanyair adūrāt pratyadṛśyata

vulgate_text: punar eva tato dūrāt vṛkṣa khaṇḍāt viniḥsṛtaḥ / dṛṣṭvā rāmo mahātejāḥ tam hantum kṛta niścayaḥ
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā rāmo mahātejās taṃ hantuṃ kṛtaniścayaḥ / saṃdhāya sudṛḍhe cāpe vikṛṣya balavad balī

vulgate_text: mārīcasya eva hṛdayam vibheda aśani saṃnibhaḥ / tāla mātram atha utplutya nyapatat sa bhṛśa āturaḥ
ce_text: sa bhṛśaṃ mṛgarūpasya vinirbhidya śarottamaḥ / mārīcasyaiva hṛdayaṃ vibhedāśanisaṃnibhaḥ

vulgate_text: rāmo rudhira sikta aṃgam ceṣṭamānam mahītale / jagāma manasā sītām lakṣmaṇasya vacaḥ smaran
ce_text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā patitaṃ bhūmau rākṣasaṃ ghoradarśanam / jagāma manasā sītāṃ lakṣmaṇasya vacaḥ smaran

vulgate_text: lobhāt tu mat kṛtam nūnam na anugacchasi rāghavam / vyasanam te priyam manye sneho bhrātari na asti te
ce_text: vyasanaṃ te priyaṃ manye sneho bhrātari nāsti te / tena tiṣṭhasi visrabdhas tam apaśyan mahādyutim

vulgate_text: abravīt lakṣmaṇaḥ trastām sītām mṛga vadhūm iva / pannaga asura gandharva deva dānava rākṣasaiḥ
ce_text: iti bruvāṇaṃ vaidehīṃ bāṣpaśokapariplutām / abravīl lakṣmaṇas trastāṃ sītāṃ mṛgavadhūm iva

vulgate_text: aśakyaḥ tava vaidehī bhartā jetum na saṃśayaḥ / devi deva manuṣyeṣu gandharveṣu patatriṣu
ce_text: devi devamanuṣyeṣu gandharveṣu patatriṣu / rākṣaseṣu piśāceṣu kiṃnareṣu mṛgeṣu ca

vulgate_text: tribhiḥ lokaiḥ samuditaiḥ sa īśvaraiḥ sa amaraiḥ api / hṛdayam nirvṛtam te astu saṃtāpaḥ tyajyatām tava
ce_text: hṛdayaṃ nirvṛtaṃ te 'stu saṃtāpas tyajyatām ayam / āgamiṣyati te bhartā śīghraṃ hatvā mṛgottamam

vulgate_text: aham tava priyam manye rāmasya vyasanam mahat / rāmasya vyasanm dṛṣṭvā tena etāni prabhāṣase
ce_text: anārya karuṇārambha nṛśaṃsa kulapāṃsana / ahaṃ tava priyaṃ manye tenaitāni prabhāṣase

vulgate_text: tat na siddhyati saumitre tava api bharatasya vā / katham iṃdīvara śyāmam rāmam padma nibhekṣaṇam
ce_text: katham indīvaraśyāmaṃ rāmaṃ padmanibhekṣaṇam / upasaṃśritya bhartāraṃ kāmayeyaṃ pṛthag janam

vulgate_text: vimukta dharmāḥ capalāḥ tīkṣṇā bhedakarāḥ striyaḥ / na sahe hi īdṛśam vākyam vaidehī janaka ātmaje
ce_text: svabhāvas tv eṣa nārīṇām eṣu lokeṣu dṛśyate / vimuktadharmāś capalās tīkṣṇā bhedakarāḥ striyaḥ

vulgate_text: śrotrayoḥ ubhayoḥ madhye tapta nārāca sannibham / upaśṛṇvaṃtu me sarve sākṣino hi vanecarāḥ
ce_text: upaśṛṇvantu me sarve sākṣibhūtā vanecarāḥ / nyāyavādī yathā vākyam ukto 'haṃ paruṣaṃ tvayā

vulgate_text: atiṣṭhat prekṣya vaidehīm rāma patnīm yaśasvinīm / tiṣṭan saṃprekṣya ca tadā patnīm rāmasya rāvaṇa
ce_text: sa pāpo bhavyarūpeṇa tṛṇaiḥ kūpa ivāvṛtaḥ / atiṣṭhat prekṣya vaidehīṃ rāmapatnīṃ yaśasvinīm

vulgate_text: na evam rūpā mayā nārī dṛṣṭa pūrvā mahī tale / rūpam agryam ca lokeṣu saukumāryam vayaḥ ca te
ce_text: naivaṃrūpā mayā nārī dṛṣṭapūrvā mahītale / iha vāsaś ca kāntāre cittam unmāthayanti me

vulgate_text: uṣitvā dvā daśa samāḥ ikṣvākūṇām niveśane / bhuṃjānā mānuṣān bhogān sarva kāma samṛddhinī
ce_text: saṃvatsaraṃ cādhyuṣitā rāghavasya niveśane / bhuñjānā mānuṣān bhogān sarvakāmasamṛddhinī

vulgate_text: tatra trayo daśe varṣe rāja amaṃtryata prabhuḥ / abhiṣecayitum rāmam sameto rāja mantribhiḥ
ce_text: tataḥ saṃvatsarād ūrdhvaṃ samamanyata me patim / abhiṣecayituṃ rāmaṃ sameto rājamantribhiḥ

vulgate_text: viśālākṣo mahābāhuḥ sarva bhūta hite rataḥ / kāmārtaḥ ca mahārājaḥ pitā daśarathaḥ svayam
ce_text: mama bhartā mahātejā vayasā pañcaviṃśakaḥ / rāmeti prathito loke guṇavān satyavāk śuciḥ / viśālākṣo mahābāhuḥ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ

vulgate_text: kaikeyyāḥ priya kāmārtham tam rāmam na abhiṣecayat / abhiṣekāya tu pituḥ samīpam rāmam āgatam
ce_text: abhiṣekāya tu pituḥ samīpaṃ rāmam āgatam / kaikeyī mama bhartāram ity uvāca drutaṃ vacaḥ

vulgate_text: anvagacchat dhanuṣ pāṇiḥ pravrajaṃtam mayā saha / jaṭī tāpasa rūpeṇa mayā saha saha anujaḥ
ce_text: sa bhrātā lakṣmaṇo nāma dharmacārī dṛḍhavrataḥ / anvagacchad dhanuṣpāṇiḥ pravrajantaṃ mayā saha

vulgate_text: praviṣṭo daṃḍakāraṇyam dharma nityo dhṛḍha vrataḥ / te vayam pracyutā rājyāt kaikeyyāḥ tu kṛte trayaḥ
ce_text: te vayaṃ pracyutā rājyāt kaileyyās tu kṛte trayaḥ / vicarāma dvijaśreṣṭha vanaṃ gambhīram ojasā

vulgate_text: āgamiṣyati me bhartā vanyam ādāya puṣkalam / rurūn godhān varāhān ca hatvā ādāya amiṣān bahu
ce_text: samāśvasa muhūrtaṃ tu śakyaṃ vastum iha tvayā / āgamiṣyati me bhartā vanyam ādāya puṣkalam

vulgate_text: sarva lakṣaṇa saṃpannam nyagrodha pari maṇḍalam / satya saṃdham mahābhāgam rāmam anuvratā
ce_text: mahābāhuṃ mahoraskaṃ siṃhavikrāntagāminam / nṛsiṃhaṃ siṃhasaṃkāśam ahaṃ rāmam anuvratā

vulgate_text: saṃrakta nayanaḥ śrīmān tapta kāṃcana bhūṣaṇaḥ / krodhena mahatā āviṣṭo nīla jīmūta sannibhaḥ
ce_text: saṃraktanayanaḥ śrīmāṃs taptakāñcanakuṇḍalaḥ / daśāsyaḥ kārmukī bāṇī babhūva kṣaṇadācaraḥ

vulgate_text: daśa āsyo viṃśati bhujo babhūva kṣaṇadā caraḥ / sa parivrājaka cchadma mahākāyo vihāya tat
ce_text: sa parivrājakacchadma mahākāyo vihāya tat / pratipede svakaṃ rūpaṃ rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ

vulgate_text: abhigamya suduṣṭa ātmā rākṣasaḥ kāma mohitaḥ / jagrāha rāvaṇaḥ sītām budhaḥ khe rohiṇīm iva
ce_text: ity uktvā maithilīṃ vākyaṃ priyārhāṃ priyavādinīm / jagrāha rāvaṇaḥ sītāṃ budhaḥ khe rohiṇīm iva

vulgate_text: daśagrīva sthito dharme purāṇe satya saṃśrayaḥ / bhrātaḥ saḥ tvam ninditam karma kartum na arhasi saṃpratām
ce_text: daśagrīvasthito dharme purāṇe satyasaṃśrayaḥ / jaṭāyur nāma nāmnāhaṃ gṛdhrarājo mahābalaḥ

vulgate_text: vṛddho aham tvam yuvā dhanvī sa rathaḥ kavacī śarī / na ca api ādāya kuśalī vaidehīm na gamiṣyasi
ce_text: vṛddho 'haṃ tvaṃ yuvā dhanvī sarathaḥ kavacī śarī / tathāpy ādāya vaidehīṃ kuśalī na gamiṣyasi

vulgate_text: sa tāni śara jālāni pakṣābhyām tu vidhūya ha / caraṇābhyām mahātejā babhaṃja asya mahat dhanuḥ
ce_text: tato 'sya saśaraṃ cāpaṃ muktāmaṇivibhūṣitam / caraṇābhyāṃ mahātejā babhañja patageśvaraḥ

vulgate_text: pūrṇa candra pratīkāśam chatram ca vyajanaiḥ saha / pātayāmāsa vegena grāhibhī rākṣasaiḥ saha
ce_text: varaṃ triveṇusaṃpannaṃ kāmagaṃ pāvakārciṣam / maṇihemavicitrāṅgaṃ babhañja ca mahāratham / pūrṇacandrapratīkāśaṃ chatraṃ ca vyajanaiḥ saha

vulgate_text: tam prahṛṣṭam nidhāya aṃke rāvaṇam janaka ātmajām / gacchaṃtam khaḍga śeṣam ca praṇaṣṭa hata sādhanam
ce_text: taṃ prahṛṣṭaṃ nidhāyāṅke gacchantaṃ janakātmajām / gṛdhrarājaḥ samutpatya jaṭāyur idam abravīt

vulgate_text: gṛdhra rājaḥ samutpatya rāvaṇam samabhidravat / samāvāryam mahātejā jaṭāyuḥ idam abravīt
ce_text: taṃ prahṛṣṭaṃ nidhāyāṅke gacchantaṃ janakātmajām / gṛdhrarājaḥ samutpatya jaṭāyur idam abravīt

vulgate_text: tam gṛhītvā nakhaiḥ tīkṣṇaiḥ vidadāra samaṃtataḥ / adhirūḍho gaja āroho yathā syāt duṣṭa vāraṇam
ce_text: taṃ gṛhītvā nakhais tīkṣṇair virarāda samantataḥ / adhirūḍho gajārohi yathā syād duṣṭavāraṇam

vulgate_text: na vāti mārutaḥ tatra niṣ prabho abhūt divākaraḥ / dṛṣṭvā sītām parā mṛṣṭām devo divyena cakṣuṣā
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā sītāṃ parāmṛṣṭāṃ dīnāṃ divyena cakṣuṣā / kṛtaṃ kāryam iti śrīmān vyājahāra pitāmahaḥ

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā sītām parā mṛṣṭām daṇḍakāraṇya vāsinaḥ / rāvaṇasya vināśam ca prāptam buddhvā yadṛcchayā
ce_text: prahṛṣṭā vyathitāś cāsan sarve te paramarṣayaḥ / dṛṣṭvā sītāṃ parāmṛṣṭāṃ daṇḍakāraṇyavāsinaḥ

vulgate_text: yo hi mām udyataḥ trātum so api ayam vinipātitaḥ / gṛdhra rājaḥ purāṇo asau śvaśurasya sakhā mama
ce_text: tvayaiva nūnaṃ duṣṭātman bhīruṇā hartum icchatā / mamāpavāhito bhartā mṛgarūpeṇa māyayā / yo hi mām udyatas trātuṃ so 'py ayaṃ vinipātitaḥ

vulgate_text: vyaktam hiraṇmayān hi tvam saṃpaśyasi mahī ruhān / nadīm vaitaraṇīm ghorām rudhira ogha vivāhinīm
ce_text: yathā cāsmin bhayasthāne na bibheṣe daśānana / vyaktaṃ hiraṇmayān hi tvaṃ saṃpaśyasi mahīruhān

vulgate_text: yat yat icchet tat eva asyā deyam mat cchaṃdato yathā / yā ca vakṣyati vaidehīm vacanam kiṃcit apriyam
ce_text: yā ca vakṣyati vaidehīṃ vacanaṃ kiṃ cid apriyam / ajñānād yadi vā jñānān na tasyā jīvitaṃ priyam

vulgate_text: bahu sainyam mahāvīryam janasthāne niveśitam / sa dūṣaṇa kharam yuddhe nihatam rāma sāyakaiḥ
ce_text: balaṃ hi sumahad yan me janasthāne niveśitam / sadūṣaṇakharaṃ yuddhe hataṃ tad rāmasāyakaiḥ

vulgate_text: divya dundubhi nirghoṣam tapta kāṃcana bhūṣaṇam / sopānam kāṃcanam citram āruroha tayā saha
ce_text: divyadundubhinirhrādaṃ taptakāñcanatoraṇam / sopānaṃ kāñcanaṃ citram āruroha tayā saha

vulgate_text: darśayitvā tu vaidehīm kṛtsnam tat bhavana uttamam / uvāca vākyam pāpātmā sītām lobhitum icchayā
ce_text: darśayitvā tu vaidehīṃ kṛtsnaṃ tad bhavanottamam / uvāca vākyaṃ pāpātmā rāvaṇo janakātmajām

vulgate_text: bahvīnām uttama strīṇām mama yo asau parigrahaḥ / tāsām tvam īśvarī sīte mama bhāryā bhava priye
ce_text: bahūnāṃ strīsahasrāṇāṃ mama yo 'sau parigrahaḥ / tāsāṃ tvam īśvarī sīte mama bhāryā bhava priye

vulgate_text: laṃkāyām sumahat rājyam idam tvam anupālaya / tvat preṣyā mat vidhā caiva devāḥ ca api cara acaram
ce_text: laṅkāyāṃ sumahad rājyam idaṃ tvam anupālaya / abhiṣekodakaklinnā tuṣṭā ca ramayasva mām

vulgate_text: śoka ārtam tu varārohe na bhrājati vara ānane / evam vadati tasmin sā vastra antena vara aṃganā
ce_text: śokārtaṃ tu varārohe na bhrājati varānane / alaṃ vrīḍena vaidehi dharmalopa kṛtena te

vulgate_text: uvāca vacanam vīro rāvaṇo rajanī caraḥ / alam vrīḍena vaidehi dharma lopa kṛtena te
ce_text: śokārtaṃ tu varārohe na bhrājati varānane / alaṃ vrīḍena vaidehi dharmalopa kṛtena te

vulgate_text: yadi paśyet sa rāmaḥ tvām roṣa dīptena cakṣuṣā / rakṣaḥ tvam adya nirdagdho yathā rudreṇa manmadhaḥ
ce_text: yadi paśyet sa rāmas tvāṃ roṣadīptena cakṣuṣā / rakṣas tvam adya nirdagdho gaccheḥ sadyaḥ parābhavam

vulgate_text: nivartamānaḥ tvarito jagāma āśramam ātmavān / ātmanaḥ ca apanayanam mṛga rūpeṇa rakṣasā
ce_text: ity evaṃ cintayan rāmaḥ śrutvā gomāyuniḥsvanam / ātmanaś cāpanayanaṃ mṛgarūpeṇa rakṣasā / ājagāma janasthānaṃ rāghavaḥ pariśaṅkitaḥ

vulgate_text: savyam kṛtvā mahātmānam ghorām ca sasṛjuḥ svarān / tāni dṛṣṭvā nimittāni mahāghorāṇi rāghavaḥ / nyavartata atha tvarito javena āśramam ātmanaḥ
ce_text: taṃ dīnamānasaṃ dīnam āsedur mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ / savyaṃ kṛtvā mahātmānaṃ ghorāṃś ca sasṛjuḥ svarān

vulgate_text: api lakṣmaṇa sītāyāḥ sāmagryam prāpnuyāvahe / jīvantyāḥ puruṣavyāghra sutāyā janaksya vai
ce_text: aśubhāny eva bhūyiṣṭhaṃ yathā prādurbhavanti me / api lakṣmaṇa sītāyāḥ sāmagryaṃ prāpnuyāvahe

vulgate_text: rākṣasena īritam vākyam trasāt trāhi iti śobhane / na bhavatyā vyathā kāryā kunārī jana sevitā
ce_text: kiṃnimittaṃ tu kenāpi bhrātur ālambya me svaram / visvaraṃ vyāhṛtaṃ vākyaṃ lakṣmaṇa trāhi mām iti / na bhavatyā vyathā kāryā kunārījanasevitā

vulgate_text: jāto vā jāyamāno vā saṃyuge yaḥ parājayet / ajeyo rāghavo yuddhe devaiḥ śakra purogamaiḥ
ce_text: alaṃ vaiklavyam ālambya svasthā bhava nirutsukā / na cāsti triṣu lokeṣu pumān yo rāghavaṃ raṇe / jāto vā jāyamāno vā saṃyuge yaḥ parājayet

vulgate_text: nūnam tat śubha daṃta oṣṭham sunāsam śubha kuṇḍalam / pūrṇa caṃdra nibham grastam mukham niṣprabhatām gatam
ce_text: nūnaṃ tac chubhadantauṣṭhaṃ mukhaṃ niṣprabhatāṃ gatam / sā hi campakavarṇābhā grīvā graiveya śobhitā

vulgate_text: sītāyā rahito aham vai na hi jīvāmi lakṣmaṇa / vṛtam śokena mahatā sītā haraṇajena mām
ce_text: mṛtaṃ śokena mahatā sītāharaṇajena mām / paraloke mahārājo nūnaṃ drakṣyati me pitā

vulgate_text: na dadarśa suduḥkha ārto rāghavo janaka ātmajām / anāsādayamānam tam sītām śokaparāyaṇam
ce_text: itīva vilapan rāmaḥ sītādarśanalālasaḥ / na dadarśa suduḥkhārto rāghavo janakātmajām

vulgate_text: mā viṣādam mahābuddhe kuru yatnam mayā saha / idam giri varam vīra bahu kandara śobhitam
ce_text: mā viṣādaṃ mahābāho kuru yatnaṃ mayā saha / idaṃ ca hi vanaṃ śūra bahukandaraśobhitam

vulgate_text: eṣā godāvarī saumya kiṃcan na pratibhāṣate / kim nu lakṣmaṇa vakṣyāmi sametya janakam vacaḥ
ce_text: kiṃ nu lakṣmaṇa vakṣyāmi sametya janakaṃ vacaḥ / mātaraṃ caiva vaidehyā vinā tām aham apriyam

vulgate_text: manye dīrghā bhaviṣyanti rātrayo mama jāgrataḥ / maṃdākinīm janasthānam imam prasravaṇam girim
ce_text: jñātipakṣavihīnasya rājaputrīm apaśyataḥ / manye dīrghā bhaviṣyanti rātrayo mama jāgrataḥ

vulgate_text: sarvāṇi anucariṣyāmi yadi sītā hi labhyate / ete mahā mṛgā vīra mām īkṣante punaḥ punaḥ
ce_text: godāvarīṃ janasthānam imaṃ prasravaṇaṃ girim / sarvāṇy anucariṣyāmi yadi sītā hi dṛśyate

vulgate_text: lakṣmaṇa anugata śrīmān vīkṣyamāṇo vasundharām / evam saṃbhāṣamāṇau tau anyonyam bhrātarau ubhau
ce_text: evaṃ saṃbhāṣamāṇau tāv anyonyaṃ bhrātarāv ubhau / vasuṃdharāyāṃ patitaṃ puṣpamārgam apaśyatām

vulgate_text: apinaddhāni vaidehyā mayā dattāni kānane / manye sūryaḥ ca vāyuḥ ca medinī ca yaśaśivini
ce_text: abhijānāmi puṣpāṇi tānīmāmīha lakṣmaṇa / apinaddhāni vaidehyā mayā dattāni kānane

vulgate_text: abhirakṣanti puṣpāṇi prakurvanto mama priyam / evam uktvā mahābāhuḥ lakṣmaṇam puruṣarṣabham
ce_text: evam uktvā mahābāhur lakṣmaṇaṃ puruṣarṣabham / kruddho 'bravīd giriṃ tatra siṃhaḥ kṣudramṛgaṃ yathā

vulgate_text: rāmā ramye vanod deśe mayā virahitā tvayā / kruddho abravīt girim tatra siṃhaḥ kṣudra mṛgam yathā
ce_text: evam uktvā mahābāhur lakṣmaṇaṃ puruṣarṣabham / kruddho 'bravīd giriṃ tatra siṃhaḥ kṣudramṛgaṃ yathā

vulgate_text: tato dāśarathī rāma uvāca śiloccayam / mama bāṇa agni nirdagdho bhasmī bhūto bhaviṣyasi
ce_text: mama bāṇāgninirdagdho bhasmībhūto bhaviṣyasi / asevyaḥ satataṃ caiva nistṛṇadrumapallavaḥ

vulgate_text: dadarśa bhūmau niṣkrāṃtam rākṣasasya padam mahat / trastayā rāma kāṅkṣiṇyāḥ pradhāvantyā itaḥ tataḥ
ce_text: evaṃ sa ruṣito rāmo didhakṣann iva cakṣuṣā / dadarśa bhūmau niṣkrāntaṃ rākṣasasya padaṃ mahat

vulgate_text: rākṣasena anuvṛttayā vaidehyā ca pādāni tu / sa samīkṣya parikrāntam sītāyā rākṣasasya ca
ce_text: sa samīkṣya parikrāntaṃ sītāyā rākṣasasya ca / saṃbhrāntahṛdayo rāmaḥ śaśaṃsa bhrātaraṃ priyam

vulgate_text: bhaṃgam dhanuḥ ca tūṇī ca vikīrṇām bahudhā ratham / saṃbhrāṃta hṛdayo rāmaḥ śaśaṃsa bhrātaram priyam
ce_text: sa samīkṣya parikrāntaṃ sītāyā rākṣasasya ca / saṃbhrāntahṛdayo rāmaḥ śaśaṃsa bhrātaraṃ priyam

vulgate_text: rākṣasānām idam vasta surāṇām adhavā api / taruṇa āditya saṃkāśam vaidūrya gulikā citam
ce_text: taruṇādityasaṃkāśaṃ vaidūryagulikācitam / viśīrṇaṃ patitaṃ bhūmau kavacaṃ kasya kāñcanam

vulgate_text: saṃhṛtya eva śaśi jyotsnām mahān sūrya iva uditaḥ / saṃhṛtya eva guṇān sarvān mama tejaḥ prakāśte
ce_text: māṃ prāpya hi guṇo doṣaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ paśya lakṣmaṇa / adyaiva sarvabhūtānāṃ rakṣasām abhavāya ca / saṃhṛtyaiva śaśijyotsnāṃ mahān sūrya ivoditaḥ

vulgate_text: trai lokyam tu kariṣyāmi saṃyuktam kāla karmaṇā / na te kuśalinīm sītām pradāsyanti mama īśvarāḥ
ce_text: na tāṃ kuśalinīṃ sītāṃ pradāsyanti mameśvarāḥ / asmin muhūrte saumitre mama drakṣyanti vikramam

vulgate_text: ekasya na aparādhena lokān hantum tvam arhasi / na tu jānāmi kasya ayam bhagnaḥ sāṃgrāmiko rathaḥ
ce_text: na tu jānāmi kasyāyaṃ bhagnaḥ sāṃgrāmiko rathaḥ / kena vā kasya vā hetoḥ sāyudhaḥ saparicchadaḥ

vulgate_text: na alam te vipriyam kartum dīkṣitasya iva sādhavaḥ / yena rājan hṛtā sītā tam anveṣitum arhasi
ce_text: yena rājan hṛtā sītā tam anveṣitum arhasi / maddvitīyo dhanuṣpāṇiḥ sahāyaiḥ paramarṣibhiḥ

vulgate_text: guhāḥ ca vividhā ghorā padminyo vividhāḥ thathā / deva gandharva lokān ca viceṣyāmaḥ samāhitāḥ
ce_text: devagandharvalokāṃś ca viceṣyāmaḥ samāhitāḥ / yāvan nādhigamiṣyāmas tava bhāryāpahāriṇam

vulgate_text: yā ca iyam jagato mātā sarva loka namaskṛtā / asyāḥ ca calanam bhūmeḥ dṛśyate kosaleśvara
ce_text: yā ceyaṃ jagato mātā devī lokanamaskṛtā / asyāś ca calanaṃ bhūmer dṛśyate satyasaṃśrava

vulgate_text: ayam tu sārathiḥ tasya mat pakṣa nihato bhuviḥ / pariśrāntasya me pakṣau chittvā khaḍgena rāvaṇaḥ
ce_text: pariśrāntasya me pakṣau chittvā khaḍgena rāvaṇaḥ / sītām ādāya vaidehīm utpapāta vihāyasaṃ / rakṣasā nihataṃ pūrvma na māṃ hantuṃ tvam arhasi

vulgate_text: rājyam bhraṣṭam vane vāsaḥ sītā naṣṭā mṛte dvijaḥ / īdṛśī iyam mama alakṣmīḥ dahet api pāvakam
ce_text: rājyād bhraṃśo vane vāsaḥ sītā naṣṭā hato dvijaḥ / īdṛśīyaṃ mamālakṣmīr nirdahed api pāvakam

vulgate_text: kim nimitto jahāra āryām rāvaṇaḥ tasya kim mayā / aparādham tu yam dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇena hṛtā priyā
ce_text: kiṃnimitto 'harat sītāṃ rāvaṇas tasya kiṃ mayā / aparāddhaṃ tu yaṃ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇena hṛtā priyā

vulgate_text: tam udvīkṣya saḥ dharmātmā vilapantam anāthavat / vācā viklavayā rāmam idam vacanam abravīt
ce_text: tam udvīkṣyātha dīnātmā vilapantam anantaram / vācātisannayā rāmaṃ jaṭāyur idam abravīt

vulgate_text: vindo nāma muhūrto asau sa ca kākutstha na abudhat / tvat priyām jānakīm hṛtvā rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvara / jhaṣavat baḍiśam gṛhya kṣipram eva vinaśyati
ce_text: vindo nāma muhūrto 'sau sa ca kākutstha nābudhat / jhaṣavad baḍiśaṃ gṛhya kṣipram eva vinaśyati

vulgate_text: bhakṣayantīm mṛgān bhīmān vikaṭām mukta mūrdhajām / avaikṣatām tu tau tatra bhrātarau rāma lakṣmaṇau
ce_text: tau tu tatra sthitau dṛṣṭvā bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau / bāhupāśaparikṣiptau kabandho vākyam abravīt

vulgate_text: agni jvāla nikāśena lalāṭasthena dīpyatā / mahāpakṣeṇa piṃgena vipulena āyatena ca
ce_text: mahāpakṣmeṇa piṅgena vipulenāyatena ca / ekenorasi ghoreṇa nayanenāśudarśinā

vulgate_text: mahāntam dāruṇam bhīmam kabaṃdham bhuja saṃvṛtam / kabaṃdham iva saṃsthānat ati ghora pradaśanam
ce_text: atha tau samatikramya krośamātre dadarśatuḥ / mahāntaṃ dāruṇaṃ bhīmaṃ kabandhaṃ bhujasaṃvṛtam

vulgate_text: ghoram deśam imam prāptau daivena mama cākṣuṣau / vadatam kāryam iha vām kim artham ca āgatau yuvām
ce_text: ghoraṃ deśam imaṃ prāptau mama bhakṣāv upasthitau / vadataṃ kāryam iha vāṃ kimarthaṃ cāgatau yuvām

vulgate_text: mama tūrṇam upasaṃprāptau durlabham jīvitam vām / tasya tat vacanam śrutvā kabaṃdhasya durātmanaḥ
ce_text: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā kabandhasya durātmanaḥ / uvāca lakṣmaṇaṃ rāmo mukhena pariśuṣyatā

vulgate_text: tadā ca āsyam ca me kukṣau tīkṣṇa daṃṣṭram akalpayat / so aham bhujābhyām dīrghābhyām saṃkṛṣya asmin vane carān
ce_text: evam uktas tu me śakro bāhū yojanam āyatau / prādād āsyaṃ ca me kukṣau tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭram akalpayat

vulgate_text: chetsyate samare bāhū tadā svargam gamiṣyasi / anena vapuṣā tāta vane asmin rājasattama
ce_text: sa tu mām abravīd indro yadā rāmaḥ salakṣmaṇaḥ / chetsyate samare bāhū tadā svargaṃ gamiṣyasi

vulgate_text: imām buddhim puraskṛtya deha nyāsa kṛta śramaḥ / sa tvam rāmo asi bhadram te na aham anyena rāghava
ce_text: sa tvaṃ rāmo 'si bhadraṃ te nāham anyena rāghava / śakyo hantuṃ yathātattvam evam uktaṃ maharṣiṇā

vulgate_text: yaḥ tām jñāsyati tam vakṣye dagdhaḥ svam rūpam āsthitaḥ / yo abhijānāti tad rakṣaḥ tad vakṣye rāma tat param
ce_text: divyam asti na me jñānaṃ nābhijānāmi maithilīm / yas tāṃ jñāsyati taṃ vakṣye dagdhaḥ svaṃ rūpam āsthitaḥ

vulgate_text: gaccha śīghram ito vīra sugrīvam tam mahābalam / vayasyam tam kuru kṣipram ito gatvā adya rāghava
ce_text: vayasyaṃ taṃ kuru kṣipram ito gatvādya rāghava / adrohāya samāgamya dīpyamāne vibhāvasau

vulgate_text: diśo vicetum tām sītām tvat viyogena śocayatīm / anveṣyati varārohām maithilīm rāvaṇa ālaye
ce_text: vānarāṃś ca mahākāyān preṣayiṣyati rāghava / diśo vicetuṃ tāṃ sītāṃ tvadviyogena śocatīm

vulgate_text: agnimukhā aśokāḥ ca suraktāḥ paribhadrakāḥ / tān āruhya athavā bhūmau pātayitvā ca tān balāt
ce_text: tān āruhyātha vā bhūmau pātayitvā ca tān balāt / phalāny amṛtakalpāni bhakṣayantau gamiṣyathaḥ

vulgate_text: phalāni amṛta kalpāni bhakṣayitvā gamiṣyathaḥ / tat atikramya kākutstha vanam puṣita pādapam
ce_text: tān āruhyātha vā bhūmau pātayitvā ca tān balāt / phalāny amṛtakalpāni bhakṣayantau gamiṣyathaḥ

vulgate_text: śobante sarvataḥ tatra megha parvata saṃnibhāḥ / tān āruhya athavā bhūmau pātaitvā yathā sukham
ce_text: tān āruhyātha vā bhūmau pātayitvā ca tān balāt / phalāny amṛtakalpāni bhakṣayantau gamiṣyathaḥ

vulgate_text: phalāni amṛta kalpāni lakṣamaṇaḥ te pradāsyati / caṅkramaṃtau varān śailān śailāt śailam vanāt vanam
ce_text: caṅkramantau varān deśāñ śailāc chailaṃ vanād vanam / tataḥ puṣkariṇīṃ vīrau pampāṃ nāma gamiṣyathaḥ

vulgate_text: paṃpāyām iṣubhiḥ matsyān tatra rāma varān hatān / nistvakpakṣānayasataptānakṛśānnaikakaṇṭakān - yadvā -niḥ tvak pakṣān ayasa taptān akṛśān na aneka kaṇṭakān
ce_text: rohitān vakratuṇḍāṃś ca nalamīnāṃś ca rāghava / pampāyām iṣubhir matsyāṃs tatra rāma varān hatān

vulgate_text: sāya āhne vicaran rāma darśayiṣyati lakṣmaṇaḥ / apām lobhāta upāvṛttān vṛṣabhān iva nardataḥ
ce_text: sthūlān giriguhāśayyān varāhān vanacāriṇaḥ / apāṃ lobhād upāvṛttān vṛṣabhān iva nardataḥ / rūpānvitāṃś ca pampāyāṃ drakṣyasi tvaṃ narottama

vulgate_text: na ca vai mlānatām yānti na ca śīryanti rāghava / mataṃga śiṣyāḥ tatra āsan ṛṣayaḥ susamāhitaḥ
ce_text: na tāni kaś cin mālyāni tatrāropayitā naraḥ / mataṅgaśiṣyās tatrāsann ṛṣayaḥ susamāhitaḥ

vulgate_text: te tatra pītvā pānīyam vimalam cāru śobhanam / atyanta sukha saṃsparśam sarva gandha samanvitam
ce_text: te tatra pītvā pānīyaṃ vimalaṃ śītam avyayam / nivṛttāḥ saṃvigāhante vanāni vanagocarāḥ

vulgate_text: nivṛttāḥ samvigāhante vanāni vana gocarāḥ / ṛkṣām ca dvipinaḥ caiva nīla komalaka prabhān
ce_text: te tatra pītvā pānīyaṃ vimalaṃ śītam avyayam / nivṛttāḥ saṃvigāhante vanāni vanagocarāḥ

vulgate_text: rurūn apetā apajayān dṛṣṭvā śokam prahāsyasi / rāma tasya tu śailasya mahatī śobhate guhā
ce_text: rāma tasya tu śailasya mahatī śobhate guhā / śilāpidhānā kākutstha duḥkhaṃ cāsyāḥ praveśanam

vulgate_text: kadācit śikhare tasya parvatasya api tiṣṭhate / kabaṃdhaḥ tu anuśāsya evam tau ubhau rāma lakṣmaṇau
ce_text: tasyāṃ vasati sugrīvaś caturbhiḥ saha vānaraiḥ / kadā cic chikhare tasya parvatasyāvatiṣṭhate

vulgate_text: pādyam ācamanīyam ca sarvam pradadāt yathā vidhi / tām uvāca tato rāmaḥ śramaṇīm dharma saṃsthitām
ce_text: tām uvāca tato rāmaḥ śramaṇīṃ saṃśitavratām / kaccit te nirjitā vighnāḥ kaccit te vardhate tapaḥ

vulgate_text: evam uktā mahābhāgaiḥ tadā aham puruṣarṣabha / mayā tu vividham vanyam saṃcitam puruṣarṣabha
ce_text: mayā tu vividhaṃ vanyaṃ saṃcitaṃ puruṣarṣabha / tavārthe puruṣavyāghra pampāyās tīrasaṃbhavam

vulgate_text: dharmiṣṭham tu vacaḥ śrutvā rāghavaḥ saha lakṣmaṇaḥ / praharsam atulam lebhe āścaryam idam ca abravīt
ce_text: dharmiṣṭhaṃ tu vacaḥ śrutvā rāghavaḥ sahalakṣmaṇaḥ / anujānāmi gaccheti prahṛṣṭavadano 'bravīt

vulgate_text: iti evam uktā jaṭilā cīra kṛṣṇa ajina aṃbarā / anujñātā tu rāmeṇa hutvā ātmānam huta aśane
ce_text: anujñātā tu rāmeṇa hutvātmānaṃ hutāśane / jvalatpāvakasaṃkāśā svargam eva jagāma sā

vulgate_text: jvalat pāvaka saṃkāśā svargam eva jagāma sā / divyam ābharaṇa saṃyuktā divya mālya anulepanā
ce_text: anujñātā tu rāmeṇa hutvātmānaṃ hutāśane / jvalatpāvakasaṃkāśā svargam eva jagāma sā

vulgate_text: koyaṣṭibhiḥ ca arjunakaiḥ śata patraiḥ ca kīrakaiḥ / etaiḥ ca anyaiḥ ca bahubhiḥ nāditam tat vanam mahat
ce_text: samīkṣamāṇaḥ puṣpāḍhyaṃ sarvato vipuladrumam / koyaṣṭibhiś cārjunakaiḥ śatapatraiś ca kīcakaiḥ / etaiś cānyaiś ca vividhair nāditaṃ tad vanaṃ mahat

vulgate_text: tatra jagmatuḥ avyagrau rāghavau hi samāhitau / sa tu śoka samāviṣṭo rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ
ce_text: sa tu śokasamāviṣṭo rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ / viveśa nalinīṃ pampāṃ paṅkajaiś ca samāvṛtām

vulgate_text: iti uvāca punaḥ vākyam lakṣmaṇam satya vikramam / katham mayā vinā sītām śakyam lakṣmaṇa jīvitum
ce_text: sugrīvam abhigaccha tvaṃ vānarendraṃ nararṣabha / ity uvāca punar vākyaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ satyavikramam

vulgate_text: sa eva sukha saṃsparśo vāti candana śītalaḥ / gandham abhyavahan puṇyam śrama apanayo anilaḥ
ce_text: mārutaḥ sukhaṃ saṃsparśe vāti candanaśītalaḥ / ṣaṭpadair anukūjadbhir vaneṣu madhugandhiṣu

vulgate_text: amī pavana vikṣiptā vinandantī iva pādapāḥ / ṣaṭpadaiḥ anukūjadbhiḥ vaneṣu madhu gandhiṣu
ce_text: mārutaḥ sukhaṃ saṃsparśe vāti candanaśītalaḥ / ṣaṭpadair anukūjadbhir vaneṣu madhugandhiṣu

vulgate_text: dṛśyamāno vasantaḥ ca sveda saṃsarga dūṣakaḥ / mām hi sā mṛgaśābākṣī cintā śoka balātkṛtam
ce_text: māṃ hi sā mṛgaśāvākṣī cintāśokabalātkṛtam / saṃtāpayati saumitre krūraś caitravanānilaḥ

vulgate_text: saṃtāpayati saumitre kṛiraḥ caitra vanānilaḥ / amī mayūrāḥ śobhante pranṛtyantaḥ tataḥ tataḥ
ce_text: māṃ hi sā mṛgaśāvākṣī cintāśokabalātkṛtam / saṃtāpayati saumitre krūraś caitravanānilaḥ

vulgate_text: śikhinī manmatha ārtaiḥ eṣā bhartāram giri sānuni / tām eva manasā rāmām mayuro'pi anudhāvati
ce_text: paśya lakṣṇama nṛtyantaṃ mayūram upanṛtyati / śikhinī manmathārtaiṣā bhartāraṃ girisānuṣu

vulgate_text: vitatya rucirau pakṣau rutaiḥ upahasan iva / mayūrasya vane nūnam rakṣasā na hṛtā priyā
ce_text: mayūrasya vane nūnaṃ rakṣasā na hṛtā priyā / mama tv ayaṃ vinā vāsaḥ puṣpamāse suduḥsahaḥ

vulgate_text: tasmāt nṛtyati ramyeṣu vaneṣu saha kāntayā / mama tvayam vinā vāsaḥ puṣpamāse suduḥsahaḥ
ce_text: mayūrasya vane nūnaṃ rakṣasā na hṛtā priyā / mama tv ayaṃ vinā vāsaḥ puṣpamāse suduḥsahaḥ

vulgate_text: vasanto yadi tatra api yatra me vasati priyā / nūnam paravaśā sītā sā api śocyati aham yathā
ce_text: nūnaṃ paravaśā sītā sāpi śocaty ahaṃ yathā / śyāmā padmapalāśākṣī mṛdubhāṣā ca me priyā

vulgate_text: śyāmā padma palāśākṣī mṛdu bhāṣā ca mem priyā / nūnam vasantam āsādya parityakṣyati jīvitam
ce_text: nūnaṃ paravaśā sītā sāpi śocaty ahaṃ yathā / śyāmā padmapalāśākṣī mṛdubhāṣā ca me priyā

vulgate_text: saumitre paśya pampāyāḥ citrāsu vana rājiṣu / kiṃnarā naraśārdūla vicaranti tataḥ tataḥ
ce_text: saumitre paśya pampāyāś citrāsu vanarājiṣu / nalināni prakāśante jale taruṇasūryavat

vulgate_text: imāni śubha gandhīni paśya lakṣmaṇa sarvaśaḥ / nalināni prakāśante jale taruṇa sūrya vat
ce_text: saumitre paśya pampāyāś citrāsu vanarājiṣu / nalināni prakāśante jale taruṇasūryavat

vulgate_text: mucukuṃda arjunāḥ ca eva dṛśyante girisānuṣuketaka uddālakāḥ / ca eva śirīṣāḥ śiṃśupā dhavāḥ
ce_text: cūtāḥ pāṭalayaś caiva kovidārāś ca puṣpitāḥ / mucukundārjunāś caiva dṛśyante girisānuṣu

vulgate_text: paśya sānuṣu citreṣu mṛgībhiḥ sahitān mṛgān / mām punaḥ mṛga śabākṣī vaidehyā virahīkṛtam / vyadhayantīva me cittam saṃcarantaḥ tataḥ tataḥ
ce_text: paya sānuṣu citreṣu mṛgībhiḥ sahitān mṛgān / māṃ punar mṛgaśāvākṣyā vaidehyā virahīkṛtam

vulgate_text: tam āśramam puṇya sukham śaraṇyam sadaiva śākhā mṛga sevitāntam / trastāḥ ca dṛṣṭvā harayoḥ abhijagmuḥ mahaujasau rāghava lakṣmaṇau tau
ce_text: tāv ṛṣyamūkaṃ sahitau prayātau sugrīvaśākhāmṛgasevitaṃ tam / trastās tu dṛṣṭvā harayo babhūvur mahaujasau rāghavalakṣmaṇau tau

vulgate_text: ababhāṣe ca tau vīrau yathāvat praśaśaṃsa ca / saṃpūjya vidhivad vīrau hanumān vānarottamaḥ
ce_text: svakaṃ rūpaṃ parityajya bhikṣurūpeṇa vānaraḥ / ābabhāṣe ca tau vīrau yathāvat praśaśaṃsa ca

vulgate_text: uvāca kāmato vākyam mṛdu satya parākramau / rājarṣi deva pratimau tāpasau saṃśita vratau
ce_text: rājarṣidevapratimau tāpasau saṃśitavratau / deśaṃ katham imaṃ prāptau bhavantau varavarṇinau

vulgate_text: dhairyavantau suvarṇābhau kau yuvām cīra vāsasau / niḥśvasantau vara bhujau pīḍayantau imāḥ prajāḥ
ce_text: imāṃ nadīṃ śubhajalāṃ śobhayantau tarasvinau / dhairyavantau suvarṇābhau kau yuvāṃ cīravāsasau

vulgate_text: siṃha viprekṣitau vīrau mahābala parākramau / śakra cāpa nibhe cāpe gṛhītvā śatru nāśanau
ce_text: siṃhaviprekṣitau vīrau siṃhātibalavikramau / śakracāpanibhe cāpe pragṛhya vipulair bhujaiḥ

vulgate_text: evam uktaḥ tu soumitriḥ sugrīva sacivam kapim / abhyabhāṣata vākyajño vākyajñam pavanātmajam
ce_text: tam abhyabhāṣa saumitre sugrīvasacivaṃ kapim / vākyajñaṃ madhurair vākyaiḥ snehayuktam ariṃdamam

vulgate_text: rājā daśaratho nāma dyutimān dharma vatsalaḥ / cātur varṇyam sva dharmeṇa nityam eva abhipālayan
ce_text: rājā daśaratho nāma dyutimān dharmavatsalaḥ / tasyāyaṃ pūrvajaḥ putro rāmo nāma janaiḥ śrutaḥ

vulgate_text: agniṣṭomādibhiḥ yajñaiḥ iṣṭavān āpta dakṣiṇaiḥ / tasya ayam pūrvajaḥ putro rāmo nāma janaiḥ śrutaḥ
ce_text: rājā daśaratho nāma dyutimān dharmavatsalaḥ / tasyāyaṃ pūrvajaḥ putro rāmo nāma janaiḥ śrutaḥ

vulgate_text: danuḥ nāma diteḥ putraḥ śāpāt rākṣasatām gataḥ / ākhyātaḥ tena sugrīvaḥ samartho vānarādhipaḥ
ce_text: danur nāma śriyaḥ putraḥ śāpād rākṣasatāṃ gataḥ / ākhyātas tena sugrīvaḥ samartho vānarādhipaḥ

vulgate_text: bhikṣu rūpam parityajya vānaram rūpam āsthitaḥ / pṛṣṭam āropya tau vīrau jagāma kapikuṅjaraḥ
ce_text: svakaṃ rūpaṃ parityajya bhikṣurūpeṇa vānaraḥ / ābabhāṣe ca tau vīrau yathāvat praśaśaṃsa ca

vulgate_text: anyonyam abhivīkṣantau na tṛptim abhijagmatuḥ / tvam vayasyo'si hṛdyaḥ me hi ekam duḥkham sukham ca nau
ce_text: tataḥ suprīta manasau tāv ubhau harirāghavau / anyonyam abhivīkṣantau na tṛptim upajagmatuḥ

vulgate_text: sālasya āstīrya sugrīvaḥ niṣasāda sa rāghavaḥ / lakṣmanāya atha saṃhṛṣṭo hanumān mārutātmajaḥ
ce_text: prasannamukhavarṇaś ca vyaktaṃ hṛṣṭaś ca bhāṣate / nānṛtaṃ vakṣyate vīro hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ

vulgate_text: vālinā nikṛto bhrātrā kṛta vairaḥ ca rāghava / vālino me mahābhāga bhaya ārtasya abhayam kuru
ce_text: sa hi rājyāc ca vibhraṣṭaḥ kṛtavairaś ca vālinā / hṛtadāro vane trasto bhrātrā vinikṛto bhṛśam

vulgate_text: antaram prepsunā tena hatvā gṛdhram jaṭāyuṣam / bhāryā viyogajam duḥkham prāpitaḥ tena rakṣsā
ce_text: tvayā viyuktā rudatī lakṣmaṇena ca dhīmatā / antaraṃ prepsunā tena hatvā gṛdhraṃ jaṭāyuṣam

vulgate_text: idam tathyam mama vacaḥ tvam avehi ca rāghava / na śakyā sā jarayitum api saḥ indraiḥ sura asuraiḥ
ce_text: idaṃ tathyaṃ mama vacas tvam avehi ca rāghava / tyaja śokaṃ mahābāho tāṃ kāntām ānayāmi te

vulgate_text: tava bhāryā mahābāho bhakṣyam viṣa kṛtam yathā / tyaja śokam mahābāho tām kāntām ānayāmi te
ce_text: idaṃ tathyaṃ mama vacas tvam avehi ca rāghava / tyaja śokaṃ mahābāho tāṃ kāntām ānayāmi te

vulgate_text: tat tathā iti abravīt rāmaḥ sugrīvam priya darśanam / lakṣmaṇasya agrataḥ lakṣmyā vāsavasya iva dhīmataḥ
ce_text: tat tathety abravīd rāmaḥ sugrīvaṃ priyavādinam / lakṣmaṇasyāgrato lakṣmyā vāsavasyeva dhīmataḥ

vulgate_text: so'ham trastaḥ bhaye magnaḥ vane saṃbrānta cetanaḥ / vālinā nikṛtaḥ bhrātrā kṛta vairaḥ ca rāghava
ce_text: so 'haṃ trasto bhaye magno vasāmy udbhrāntacetanaḥ / vālinā nikṛto bhrātrā kṛtavairaś ca rāghava

vulgate_text: aham tu avagataḥ buddhyā cihnaiḥ taiḥ bhrātaram hatam / pidhāya ca bila dvāram śilayā giri mātrayā
ce_text: ahaṃ tv avagato buddhyā cihnais tair bhrātaraṃ hatam / pidhāya ca biladvāraṃ śilayā girimātrayā / śokārtaś codakaṃ kṛtvā kiṣkindhām āgataḥ sakhe

vulgate_text: ājagāma ripum hatvā dānavam sa tu vānaraḥ / abhiṣiktam tu mām dṛṣṭvā kopāt saṃrakta locanaḥ
ce_text: abhiṣiktaṃ tu māṃ dṛṣṭvā krodhāt saṃraktalocanaḥ / madīyān mantriṇo baddhvā paruṣaṃ vākyam abravīt

vulgate_text: na prāvartata me buddhiḥ bhrātṛ gaurava yaṃtritā / hatvā śatrum saḥ me bhrātā praviveśa puram tadā
ce_text: nigrahe 'pi samarthasya taṃ pāpaṃ prati rāghava / na prāvartata me buddhir bhrātṛgauravayantritā

vulgate_text: ārtasya atha bilā dvāri sthitaḥ saṃvatsaram nṛpa / dṛṣṭvā ca śoṇitam dvāri bilāt ca api samutthitam
ce_text: tasya praviṣṭasya bilaṃ sāgraḥ saṃvatsaro gataḥ / sthitasya ca mama dvāri sa kālo vyatyavartata

vulgate_text: abhiṣikto na kāmena tanme kṣantum tvam arhasi / tvam eva rājā mānārhaḥ sadā ca aham yathā purā
ce_text: tvam eva rājā mānārhaḥ sadā cāhaṃ yathāpurā / nyāsabhūtam idaṃ rājyaṃ tava niryātayāmy aham

vulgate_text: nyāsa bhūtam idam rājyam tava niryātayāmi aham / mā ca roṣam kṛthāḥ saumya mama śatru niṣūdana
ce_text: tvam eva rājā mānārhaḥ sadā cāhaṃ yathāpurā / nyāsabhūtam idaṃ rājyaṃ tava niryātayāmy aham

vulgate_text: prādravat bhaya saṃtrasto vīkṣya āvām samupāgatau / abhidrutaḥ tu vegena viveśa sa mahābilam
ce_text: sa tu dṛṣṭvaiva māṃ rātrau sadvitīyaṃ mahābalaḥ / prādravad bhayasaṃtrasto vīkṣyāvāṃ tam anudrutau / anudrutas tu vegena praviveśa mahābilam

vulgate_text: sa tu dṛṣṭo mayā śatruḥ anirvedāt bhayāavahaḥ / nihataḥ ca mayā sadyaḥ saḥ sarvaiḥ saha bandhubhiḥ
ce_text: sa tu dṛṣṭo mayā śatrur anirvedād bhayāvahaḥ / nihataś ca mayā tatra so 'suro bandhubhiḥ saha

vulgate_text: pāda prahāraiḥ tu mayā bahubhiḥ paripātitam / tataḥ aham tena niṣkramya pathā puram upāgataḥ
ce_text: pādaprahārais tu mayā bahuśas tad vidāritam / tato 'haṃ tena niṣkramya yathā punar upāgataḥ

vulgate_text: tena aham apaviddhaḥ ca hṛta dāraḥ ca rāghava / tat bhayāt ca mahīm sarvān krāntavān sa vana arṇavām
ce_text: tenāham apaviddhaś ca hṛtadāraś ca rāghava / tadbhayāc ca mahīkṛtsnā krānteyaṃ savanārṇavā

vulgate_text: tasya tat vacanam śrutvā harṣa pauruṣa vardhanam / sugrīvaḥ parama prītaḥ su mahat vākyam abravīt
ce_text: rāmasya vacanaṃ śrutvā harṣapauruṣavardhanam / sugrīvaḥ pūjayāṃ cakre rāghavaṃ praśaśaṃsa ca

vulgate_text: viṣāṇayorgṛhītvā taṃ dundubhiṃ girisannibham / āvidhyata tadā vālī vinadankapikuñjaraḥ
ce_text: viṣāṇayor gṛhītvā taṃ dundubhiṃ girisaṃnibham / vālī vyāpātayāṃ cakre nanarda ca mahāsvanam

vulgate_text: tāndṛṣṭvā patitāṃstasya muniśśoṇitavipruṣaḥ / kruddhastatra mahābhāgaścintayāmāsa konvayam
ce_text: tān dṛṣṭvā patitāṃs tatra muniḥ śoṇitavipruṣaḥ / utsasarja mahāśāpaṃ kṣeptāraṃ vālinaṃ prati / iha tenāpraveṣṭavyaṃ praviṣṭasya badho bhavet

vulgate_text: sa tu vijñāya tapasā vānareṇa kṛtaṃ hi tat / utsasarja mahāśāpaṃ kṣeptāraṃ vālinaṃ prati
ce_text: tān dṛṣṭvā patitāṃs tatra muniḥ śoṇitavipruṣaḥ / utsasarja mahāśāpaṃ kṣeptāraṃ vālinaṃ prati / iha tenāpraveṣṭavyaṃ praviṣṭasya badho bhavet

vulgate_text: iha tenāpraveṣṭavyaṃ praviṣṭasya vadho bhavet / vanaṃ matsaṃśrayaṃ yena dūṣitaṃ rudhirasravaiḥ
ce_text: tān dṛṣṭvā patitāṃs tatra muniḥ śoṇitavipruṣaḥ / utsasarja mahāśāpaṃ kṣeptāraṃ vālinaṃ prati / iha tenāpraveṣṭavyaṃ praviṣṭasya badho bhavet

vulgate_text: etacchrutvā tadā vālī vacanaṃ vānareritam / sa maharṣiṃtadā'sādya yācate sma kṛtāñjaliḥ
ce_text: sa maharṣiṃ samāsādya yācate sma kṛtāñjaliḥ

vulgate_text: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sugrīvasya mahātmanaḥ / smitapūrvamatho rāmaḥ pratyuvāca hariṃ prabhuḥ
ce_text: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā sugrīvasya mahātmanaḥ / rāghavo dundubheḥ kāyaṃ pādāṅguṣṭhena līlayā / tolayitvā mahābāhuś cikṣepa daśayojanam

vulgate_text: evamuktvā tu sugrīvaṃ sāntvaṃ lakṣmaṇapūrvajaḥ / rāghavo dundubheḥ kāyaṃ pādāṅguṣṭhena līlayā
ce_text: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā sugrīvasya mahātmanaḥ / rāghavo dundubheḥ kāyaṃ pādāṅguṣṭhena līlayā / tolayitvā mahābāhuś cikṣepa daśayojanam

vulgate_text: tolayitvā mahābāhuścikṣepa daśayojanam / asurasya tanuṃ śuṣkaṃ pādāṅguṣṭhena vīryavān
ce_text: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā sugrīvasya mahātmanaḥ / rāghavo dundubheḥ kāyaṃ pādāṅguṣṭhena līlayā / tolayitvā mahābāhuś cikṣepa daśayojanam

vulgate_text: laghussamprati nirmāṃsa stṛṇabhūtaśca rāghava / pariśrāntena mattena bhrātrā me vālinā tadā / kṣiptamevaṃ praharṣeṇa bhavatā raghunandana
ce_text: ārdraḥ samāṃsapratyagraḥ kṣiptaḥ kāyaḥ purā sakhe / laghuḥ saṃprati nirmāṃsas tṛṇabhūtaś ca rāghava / nātra śakyaṃ balaṃ jñātuṃ tava vā tasya vādhikam

vulgate_text: nātra śakyaṃ balaṃ jñātuṃ tava vā tasya vā'dhikam / ārdraṃ śuṣkamiti hyetatsumahadrāghavāntaram
ce_text: ārdraḥ samāṃsapratyagraḥ kṣiptaḥ kāyaḥ purā sakhe / laghuḥ saṃprati nirmāṃsas tṛṇabhūtaś ca rāghava / nātra śakyaṃ balaṃ jñātuṃ tava vā tasya vādhikam

vulgate_text: sāyakaḥ tu muhūrtena sālān bhittvā mahājavaḥ / niṣpatya ca punaḥ tūrṇam tam eva praviveśa ha
ce_text: praviṣṭas tu muhūrtena rasāṃ bhittvā mahājavaḥ / niṣpatya ca punas tūrṇaṃ svatūṇīṃ praviveśa ha

vulgate_text: garjan iva mahāmegho vāyu vega purassaraḥ / atha bālārka sadṛśo dṛpta simha gatiḥ tataḥ
ce_text: atha bālārkasadṛśo dṛptasiṃhagatis tadā / dṛṣṭvā rāmaṃ kriyādakṣaṃ sugrīvo vākyam abravīt

vulgate_text: tato vetsi balena adya vālinam nihatam mayā / anṛtam na ukta pūrvam me ciram kṛcchre api tiṣṭhatā
ce_text: pratyakṣaṃ sapta te sālā mayā bāṇena dāritāḥ / tato vetsi balenādya bālinaṃ nihataṃ mayā

vulgate_text: niṣpatiṣyati asaṃgena vālī sa priyasamyugaḥ / ripūṇām dharṣitam śrutvā marṣayanti na saṃyuge
ce_text: jitakāśī jayaślāghī tvayā cādharṣitaḥ purāt / niṣpatiṣyaty asaṃgena vālī sa priyasaṃyugaḥ

vulgate_text: sugrīva priya kāmārtham prāptau tatra durāsadau / sa te bhrātur hi vikhyātaḥ sahāyo raṇa karmaṇi
ce_text: tava bhrātur hi vikhyātaḥ sahāyo raṇakarkaśaḥ / rāmaḥ parabalāmardī yugāntāgnir ivotthitaḥ

vulgate_text: tatra vā sannihastho vā sarvathā bandhuḥ eva te / nahi tena samam bandhum bhuvi paśyāmi kiṃcana
ce_text: lālanīyo hi te bhrātā yavīyān eṣa vānaraḥ / tatra vā sann ihastho vā sarvathā bandhur eva te

vulgate_text: sa tu vṛkṣeṇa nirbhagnaḥ sāla tāḍana vihvalaḥ / guru bhāra bhara ākrāntā nauḥ sasārthā iva sāgare
ce_text: sa tu vālī pracaritaḥ sālatāḍanavihvalaḥ / gurubhārasamākrāntā sāgare naur ivābhavat

vulgate_text: sūrya putro mahāvīryaḥ sugrīvaḥ parihīyata / vālinā bhagna darpaḥ tu sugrīvo manda vikramaḥ
ce_text: vālinā bhagnadarpas tu sugrīvo mandavikramaḥ / vālinaṃ prati sāmarṣo darśayām āsa lāghavam

vulgate_text: vālinam prati sāmarṣo darśayāmāsa rāghavam / vṛkṣaiḥ sa śākhaiḥ śikharaiḥ vajra koṭi nibhaiḥ nakhaiḥ
ce_text: vālinā bhagnadarpas tu sugrīvo mandavikramaḥ / vālinaṃ prati sāmarṣo darśayām āsa lāghavam

vulgate_text: tato dhanuṣi saṃdhāya śaram āśī viṣa upamam / pūrayāmāsa tat cāpam kāla cakram iva antakaḥ
ce_text: tato dhanuṣi saṃdhāya śaram āśīviṣopamam / rāghaveṇa mahābāṇo vālivakṣasi pātitaḥ

vulgate_text: muktastu vajra nirghoṣaḥ pradīpta aśani saṃnibhaḥ / rāghaveṇa mahā bāṇo vāli vakṣasi pātitaḥ
ce_text: tato dhanuṣi saṃdhāya śaram āśīviṣopamam / rāghaveṇa mahābāṇo vālivakṣasi pātitaḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ tena mahātejā vīrya yuktaḥ kapīśvaraḥ / vegena abhihato vālī nipapāta mahī tale
ce_text: vegenābhihato vālī nipapāta mahītale

vulgate_text: lakṣmaṇa anucaro rāmo dadarśa upasasarpa ca / tam tathā patitam vīram gata arciṣmatam iva analam
ce_text: mahendraputraṃ patitaṃ vālinaṃ hemamālinam / siṃhoraskaṃ mahābāhuṃ dīptāsyaṃ harilocanam / lakṣmaṇānugato rāmo dadarśopasasarpa ca

vulgate_text: damaḥ śamaḥ kṣamā dharmo dhṛti satyam parākramaḥ / parthivānām guṇā rājan daṇḍaḥ ca apakāriṣu
ce_text: sāma dānaṃ kṣamā dharmaḥ satyaṃ dhṛtiparākramau / pārthivānāṃ guṇā rājan daṇḍaś cāpy apakāriṣu

vulgate_text: sugrīva priya kāmena yad aham nihataḥ tvayā / mām eva yadi pūrvam tvam etad artham acodayaḥ / maithilim aham eka āhnā tava ca ānītavān bhaveḥ
ce_text: sugrīvapriyakāmena yad ahaṃ nihatas tvayā / kaṇṭhe baddhvā pradadyāṃ te 'nihataṃ rāvaṇaṃ raṇe

vulgate_text: rākṣasam ca durātmānām tava bhārya apahāriṇam / kaṇṭhe baddhvā pradadyām te anihatam rāvaṇam raṇe
ce_text: sugrīvapriyakāmena yad ahaṃ nihatas tvayā / kaṇṭhe baddhvā pradadyāṃ te 'nihataṃ rāvaṇaṃ raṇe

vulgate_text: tasmin nṛpati śārdūla bharate dharma vatsale / pālayati akhilām pṛthvīm kaḥ caret dharma vipriyam
ce_text: tasmin nṛpatiśārdūla bharate dharmavatsale / pālayaty akhilāṃ bhūmiṃ kaś cared dharmanigraham

vulgate_text: na ca te marṣaye pāpam kṣtriyo aham kulodgataḥ / aurasīm bhaginīm vā api bhāryām vā api anujasya yaḥ
ce_text: aurasīṃ bhaginīṃ vāpi bhāryāṃ vāpy anujasya yaḥ / pracareta naraḥ kāmāt tasya daṇḍo vadhaḥ smṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: bharataḥ kāma yuktānām nigrahe paryavasthitaḥ / vayam tu bharata ādeśam vidhim kṛtvā harīśvara / tvat vidhān bhinna maryādān nigrahītum vyavasthitāḥ
ce_text: gurudharmavyatikrāntaṃ prājño dharmeṇa pālayan / bharataḥ kāmavṛttānāṃ nigrahe paryavasthitaḥ

vulgate_text: na me tatra manastāpo na manyuḥ haripuṃgava / vāgurābhiḥ ca pāśaiḥ ca kūṭaiḥ ca vividhaiḥ narāḥ
ce_text: vāgurābhiś ca pāśaiś ca kūṭaiś ca vividhair narāḥ / praticchannāś ca dṛśyāś ca gṛhṇanti subahūn mṛgān / pradhāvitān vā vitrastān visrabdhān ativiṣṭhitān

vulgate_text: evam uktaḥ tu rāmeṇa vālī pravyathito bhṛśam / na doṣam rāghave dadhyau dharme adhigata niścayaḥ
ce_text: evam uktas tu rāmeṇa vālī pravyathito bhṛśam / pratyuvāca tato rāmaṃ prāñjalir vānareśvaraḥ

vulgate_text: sa tam āśvāsayat rāmo vālinam vyakta darśanam / sādhu sammatayā vācā dharma tattvārtdha yuktayā
ce_text: sa tam āśvāsayad rāmo vālinaṃ vyaktadarśanam

vulgate_text: na saṃtāpaḥ tvayā kāryam etat artham plavaṃgama / na vayam bhavatā ciṃtyā na api ātmā harisattama / vayam bhavat viśeṣeṇa dharmataḥ kṛta niścayāḥ
ce_text: na vayaṃ bhavatā cintyā nāpy ātmā harisattama / vayaṃ bhavadviśeṣeṇa dharmataḥ kṛtaniścayāḥ

vulgate_text: sā saputra apriyam śrutvā vadham bhartuḥ sudāruṇam / niṣpapāta bhṛśam tasmāt udvignā giri kaṃdarāt
ce_text: sā saputrāpriyaṃ śrutvā vadhaṃ bhartuḥ sudāruṇam / niṣpapāta bhṛśaṃ trastā vividhād girigahvarāt

vulgate_text: abhāryāḥ saha bhāryāḥ ca santi atra vana cāriṇaḥ / lubdhebhyo vipralabdheyaḥ tebhyo naḥ sumahad bhayam
ce_text: abhāryāḥ saha bhāryāś ca santy atra vanacāriṇaḥ / lubdhebhyo viprayuktebhyaḥ svebhyo nas tumulaṃ bhayam

vulgate_text: suptā iva punar utthāya ārya putra iti vādinī / ruroda sā patim dṛṣṭvā samvītam mṛtyu dāmabhiḥ
ce_text: ruroda sā patiṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃditaṃ mṛtyudāmabhiḥ / tām avekṣya tu sugrīvaḥ krośantīṃ kurarīm iva

vulgate_text: kim mām evam pralapatīm priyām tvam na abhibhāṣase / imāḥ paśya varā bahvayaḥ bhāryāḥ te vānareśvara
ce_text: kiṃ mām evaṃ vilapatīṃ preṃṇā tvaṃ nābhibhāṣase / imāḥ paśya varā bahvīr bhāryās te vānareśvara

vulgate_text: sugrīvasya vaśam prāpto vidhiḥ eṣa bhavatya aho / sugrīva eva vikrāṃto vīra sāhasika priya
ce_text: sugrīva eva vikrānto vīra sāhasika priya / ṛkṣavānaramukhyās tvāṃ balinaṃ paryupāsate

vulgate_text: mama ca imā giraḥ śrutvā kim tvam na pratibudhyase / idam tat vīra śayanam tatra śeṣe hato yudhi
ce_text: idaṃ tac chūraśayanaṃ yatra śeṣe hato yudhi / śāyitā nihatā yatra tvayaiva ripavaḥ purā

vulgate_text: dhana dhānya samṛddhā api vidhavā iti ucyate janaiḥ / sva gātra prabhave vīra śeṣe rudhira maṇḍale
ce_text: svagātraprabhave vīra śeṣe rudhiramaṇḍale / kṛmirāgaparistome tvam evaṃ śayane yathā

vulgate_text: yā dattā deva rājena tava tuṣṭena saṃyuge / śāta kaumbhīm priyām mālām tām te paśyāmi na iha kim
ce_text: yā dattā devarājena tava tuṣṭena saṃyuge / śātakumbhamayīṃ mālāṃ tāṃ te paśyāmi neha kim

vulgate_text: rājñām ṛddhi viśeṣā hi dṛśyante bhuvi yādṛśāḥ / tādṛśaiḥ iha kurvantu vānarā bhratṛu sat kriyām
ce_text: rājñām ṛddhiviśeṣā hi dṛśyante bhuvi yādṛśāḥ / tādṛśaṃ vālinaḥ kṣipraṃ prākurvann aurdhvadehikam

vulgate_text: krośantaḥ prayayuḥ sarve vānarā hata bāndhavāḥ / tataḥ praṇihitāḥ sarvā vānaryo asya vaśānugāḥ
ce_text: aṅgadam aprigṛhyāśu tāraprabhṛtayas tathā / krośantaḥ prayayuḥ sarve vānarā hatabāndhavāḥ

vulgate_text: cukruśuḥ vīra vīra iti bhūyaḥ krośantī tāḥ priyam / tārā prabhṛtayaḥ sarvā vānaryo hata bāndhava
ce_text: tārāprabhṛtayaḥ sarvā vānaryo hatayūthapāḥ / anujagmur hi bhartāraṃ krośantyaḥ karuṇasvanāḥ

vulgate_text: āropya aṃke śiraḥ tasya vilalāpa suduḥkhitā / hā vānara mahārāja hā nātha mām vatsala
ce_text: tatas tārā patiṃ dṛṣṭvā śibikātalaśāyinam / āropyāṅke śiras tasya vilalāpa suduḥkhitā

vulgate_text: tava iṣṭā nanu caiva imā bhāryāḥ candra nibha ānanāḥ / idānīm na īkṣase kasmāt sugrīvam plavaga īśvaram
ce_text: taveṣṭā nanu nāmaitā bhāryāś candranibhānanāḥ / idānīṃ nekṣase kasmāt sugrīvaṃ plavageśvaram

vulgate_text: visarjaya enān sacivān yathā ucitam arindama / tataḥ krīḍāmahe sarvā vaneṣu madanotkaṭāḥ
ce_text: visarjayainān pravalān yathocitam ariṃdama / tataḥ krīḍāmahe sarvā vaneṣu madirotkaṭāḥ

vulgate_text: saṃskṛtya vālinam tam tu vidhivat plavagarṣabhāḥ / ājagmuḥ udakam kartum nadīm śubha jalām śivām
ce_text: saṃskṛtya vālinaṃ te tu vidhipūrvaṃ plavaṃgamāḥ / ājagmur udakaṃ kartuṃ nadīṃ śītajalāṃ śubhām

vulgate_text: bhavat prasādāt kākutstha pitṛ paitāmaham mahat / vānarāṇām sudaṃṣṭrāṇām saṃpanna balaśālinām
ce_text: bhavatprasādāt sugrīvaḥ pitṛpaitāmahaṃ mahat / vānarāṇāṃ suduṣprāpaṃ prāpto rājyam idaṃ prabho

vulgate_text: vṛttajño vṛtta saṃpannam udāra bala vikramam / imam api aṃgadam vīram yauvarājye abhiṣecaya
ce_text: evam uktvā hanūmantaṃ rāmaḥ sugrīvam abravīt / imam apy aṅgadaṃ vīra yauvarājye 'bhiṣecaya

vulgate_text: akṣatam jāta rūpam ca priyaṃgu madhu sarpiṣī / dadhi carma ca vaiyāghram parārdhye ca api upānahau
ce_text: candanāni ca divyāni gandhāṃś ca vividhān bahūn / akṣataṃ jātarūpaṃ ca priyaṅgumadhusarpiṣī

vulgate_text: vinītam bhrātaram bhrātā lakṣmaṇam lakṣmi vardhanam / iyam giri guhā ramyā viśālā yukta mārutā
ce_text: iyaṃ giriguhā ramyā viśālā yuktamārutā / prabhūtasalilā saumya prabhūtakamalotpalā

vulgate_text: samunmūlaya śokam tvam vyavasāyam sthirī kuru / tataḥ saparivāram tam rākṣasam hantum arhasi
ce_text: samunmūlaya śokaṃ tvaṃ vyavasāyaṃ sthiraṃ kuru / tataḥ saparivāraṃ taṃ nirmūlaṃ kuru rākṣasaṃ

vulgate_text: śarat kālam pratīkṣiṣye sthito asmi vacane tava / sugrīvasya nadīnām ca prasādam anupālayan
ce_text: tasmāt kālapratīkṣo 'haṃ sthito 'smi śubhalakṣaṇa / sugrīvasya nadīnāṃ ca prasādam anupālayan

vulgate_text: tat idam mitrakāryam naḥ kāla atītam ariṃdama / kriyatām rāghavasya etat vaidehyāḥ parimārgaṇam
ce_text: kriyatāṃ rāghavasyaitad vaidehyāḥ parimārgaṇam / tad idaṃ vīra kāryaṃ te kālātītam ariṃdama

vulgate_text: tat ājñāpaya kaḥ kim te kuto vā api vyavasyatu / harayo hi apradhṛṣyāḥ te santi koṭi agrato anagha
ce_text: tad ājñāpaya kaḥ kiṃ te kṛte vasatu kutra cit / harayo hy apradhṛṣyās te santi koṭyagrato 'nagha

vulgate_text: tasya mūrdhnā praṇamya tvam sa putra saha bāndhavaḥ / gaccha śīghram mahārāja roṣo hi adya upaśamyatām
ce_text: tasya mūrdhnā praṇamya tvaṃ saputraḥ saha bandhubhiḥ / rājaṃs tiṣṭha svasamaye bhava satyapratiśravaḥ

vulgate_text: yathā āha rāmo dharmātmā tat kuruṣva samāhitaḥ / rājan tiṣṭha sva samaye bhava satya pratiśravaḥ
ce_text: tasya mūrdhnā praṇamya tvaṃ saputraḥ saha bandhubhiḥ / rājaṃs tiṣṭha svasamaye bhava satyapratiśravaḥ

vulgate_text: divya ābharaṇa mālyābhiḥ pramadābhiḥ samāvṛtam / saṃrabdhatara raktākṣo babhūva aṃtaka saṃnibhaḥ
ce_text: divyābharaṇacitrāṅgaṃ divyarūpaṃ yaśasvinam / divyamālyāmbaradharaṃ mahendram iva durjayam / divyābharaṇamālyābhiḥ pramadābhiḥ samāvṛtam

vulgate_text: kṛtam cet na abhijānīṣe rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ / sadyaḥ tvam niśitair bāṇair hato drakṣyasi vālinam
ce_text: kṛtaṃ cen nābhijānīṣe rāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ / sadyas tvaṃ niśitair bāṇair hato drakṣyasi vālinam

vulgate_text: rumām mām ca aṃgadam rājyam dhana dhānya paśūni ca / rāma priyārtham sugrīvaḥ tyajet iti matir mama
ce_text: rumāṃ māṃ kapirājyaṃ ca dhanadhānyavasūni ca / rāmapriyārthaṃ sugrīvas tyajed iti matir mama

vulgate_text: kaḥ śaktaḥ tasya devasya khyātasya svena karmaṇā / tādṛśam pratikurvīta aṃśena api nṛpātmaja
ce_text: kaḥ śaktas tasya devasya khyātasya svena karmaṇā / tādṛśaṃ vikramaṃ vīra pratikartum ariṃdama

vulgate_text: yat ca śoka abhibhūtasya śrutvā rāmasya bhāṣitam / mayā tvam paruṣāṇi uktaḥ tat kṣamasva sakhe mama
ce_text: yac ca śokābhibhūtasya śrutvā rāmasya bhāṣitam / mayā tvaṃ paruṣāṇy uktas tac ca tvaṃ kṣantum arhasi

vulgate_text: tasmin giri vare puṇye yajño māheśvaraḥ purā / sarva deva manaḥ toṣo babhūva su manoramaḥ
ce_text: tasmin girivare ramye yajño maheśvaraḥ purā / sarvadevamanastoṣo babhau divyo manoharaḥ

vulgate_text: trivarga phala bhoktā ca rājā dharmeṇa yujyate / udyoga samayaḥ tu eṣa prāptaḥ śatru niṣūdana
ce_text: amitrāṇāṃ vadhe yukto mitrāṇāṃ saṃgrahe rataḥ / trivargaphalabhoktā tu rājā dharmeṇa yujyate

vulgate_text: yat indro varṣate varṣam na tat citram bhaviṣyati / ādityo asau sahasrāṃśuḥ kuryāt vitimiram nabhaḥ
ce_text: yad indro varṣate varṣaṃ na tac citraṃ bhaved bhuvi / ādityo vā sahasrāṃśuḥ kuryād vitimiraṃ nabhaḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ kāṃcana ābho gavayo nāma yūthapaḥ / ājagāma mahāvīryaḥ koṭibhiḥ paṃcabhiḥ vṛtaḥ
ce_text: mahācalanibhair ghoraiḥ panaso nāma yūthapaḥ / ājagāma mahāvīryas tisṛbhiḥ koṭibhir vṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: āvṛtya pṛthivīm sarvām parvatān ca vanāni ca / yūthapāḥ samanuprāptā eṣām saṃkhyā na vidyate
ce_text: āvṛtya pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ parvatāṃś ca vanāni ca / āplavantaḥ plavantaś ca garjantaś ca plavaṃgamāḥ / abhyavartanta sugrīvaṃ sūryam abhragaṇā iva

vulgate_text: sarvam ca tat vicetavyam mārgayadbhiḥ tataḥ tataḥ / rāmasya dayitām bhāryām sītām daśarathaḥ snuṣām
ce_text: rāmasya dayitāṃ bhāryāṃ sītāṃ daśarataḥ snuṣām / samudram avagāḍhāṃś ca parvatān pattanāni ca

vulgate_text: eteṣām giri durgeṣu prapāteṣu vaneṣu ca / mārgadhvam sahitāḥ sarve rāma patnīm yaśasvinīm
ce_text: divaṃ spṛśati śṛṅgeṇa devadānavasevitaḥ / eteṣāṃ giridurgeṣu pratāpeṣu vaneṣu ca

vulgate_text: tasya tīrtheṣu ramyeṣu vicitreṣu vaneṣu ca / rāvaṇaḥ saha vaidehyā mārgitavyaḥ tataḥ tataḥ
ce_text: śailasya tasya kuñjeṣu kandareṣu vaneṣu ca / rāvaṇaḥ saha vaidehyā mārgitavyas tatas tataḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ samudra dvīpān ca subhīmān draṣṭum arhatha / ūrmimaṃtam mahāraudram krośaṃtam anila uddhitam
ce_text: rāvaṇaḥ saha vaidehyā mārgitavyas tatas tataḥ / tataḥ samudradvīpāṃś ca subhīmān draṣṭum arhatha

vulgate_text: nihatā brahma tejobhiḥ ahani ahani rākṣasāḥ / tataḥ pāṇḍura meghābham kṣīraudam nāma sāgaram
ce_text: tataḥ pāṇḍurameghābhaṃ kṣīraudaṃ nāma sāgaram / gatā drakṣyatha durdharṣā mukhā hāram ivormibhiḥ

vulgate_text: tasya śalasya pṛṣṭheṣu nirjhareṣu guhāsu ca / rāvaṇaḥ saha vaidehyā mārgatavyā tataḥ tataḥ
ce_text: śailasya tasya kuñjeṣu kandareṣu vaneṣu ca / rāvaṇaḥ saha vaidehyā mārgitavyas tatas tataḥ

vulgate_text: suhotram ca śarārim ca śaragulmam tathā eva ca / gajam gavākṣam gavayam suṣeṇam vṛṣabham tathā
ce_text: suhotraṃ ca śarīraṃ ca śaragulmaṃ tathaiva ca / gajaṃ gavākṣaṃ gavayaṃ suṣeṇam ṛṣabhaṃ tathā

vulgate_text: tāmraparṇīm grāha juṣṭām tariṣyatha mahānadīm / sā candana vanaiḥ citraiḥ pracchannā dvīpa vāriṇī
ce_text: tatas tenābhyanujñātāḥ prasannena mahātmanā / tāmraparṇīṃ grāhajuṣṭāṃ tariṣyatha mahānadīm

vulgate_text: tatra ca aṃtaroddeśā ye kecana samāvṛtāḥ / tam ca deśam atikramya mahān ṛṣabha saṃsthitiḥ
ce_text: taṃ ca deśam atikramya mahān ṛṣabhasaṃsthitaḥ / sarvaratnamayaḥ śrīmān ṛṣabho nāma parvataḥ

vulgate_text: śailūṣo grāmaṇīḥ śikṣaḥ śuko babhruḥ tathaiva ca / ravi soma agni vapuṣā nivāsaḥ puṇya karmaṇām
ce_text: tatra gandharvapatayaḥ pañcasūryasamaprabhāḥ / śailūṣo grāmaṇīr bhikṣuḥ śubhro babhrus tathaiva ca

vulgate_text: tataḥ prasthāpya sugrīvaḥ tān harīn dakṣiṇām diśam / abravit megha saṃkāśam suśeṣaṇam nāma vānaram
ce_text: tataḥ prasthāpya sugrīvas tān harīn dakṣiṇāṃ diśam / buddhivikramasaṃpannān vāyuvegasamāñjave

vulgate_text: tāpasānām araṇyāni kāṃtārā girayaḥ ca ye / tatra sthalīḥ maruprāyā ati ucca śikharāḥ śilāḥ
ce_text: pratyak srotogamāś caiva nadyaḥ śītajalāḥ śivāḥ / tāpasānām araṇyāni kāntārā girayaś ca ye

vulgate_text: timi nakra ākula jalam gatvā drakṣyatha vānarāḥ / tataḥ ketaka khaṃḍeṣu tamāla gahaneṣu ca
ce_text: tataḥ ketakaṣaṇḍeṣu tamālagahaneṣu ca / kapayo vihariṣyanti nārikelavaneṣu ca

vulgate_text: velātala niveṣṭeṣu parvateṣu vaneṣu ca / muracī pattanam caiva ramyam caiva jaṭā puram
ce_text: tatra sītāṃ ca mārgadhvaṃ nilayaṃ rāvaṇasya ca / marīcipattanaṃ caiva ramyaṃ caiva jaṭīpuram

vulgate_text: vasanti agni nikāśānām ghorāṇām kāma rūpiṇām / pāvaka arciḥ pratīkāśāḥ samavetāḥ samantataḥ
ce_text: koṭyas tatra caturviṃśad gandharvāṇāṃ tarasvinām / vasanty agninikāśānāṃ ghorāṇāṃ kāmarūpiṇām

vulgate_text: viśvedevāḥ ca vasavo marutaḥ ca diva okasaḥ / āgatya paścimām saṃdhyām merum uttama parvatam
ce_text: ādityā vasavo rudrā marutaś ca divaukasaḥ / āgamya paścimāṃ saṃdhyāṃ merum uttamaparvatam

vulgate_text: kāṃboja yavanān caiva śakān pattanāni ca / anvīkṣya daradān caiva himavantam vicinvatha
ce_text: cīnān paramacīnāṃś ca nīhārāṃś ca punaḥ punaḥ / anviṣya daradāṃś caiva himavantaṃ vicinvatha

vulgate_text: mahatsu tasya śaileṣu parvateṣu guhāsu ca / vicinvata mahābhāgām rāma patnīm aninditām
ce_text: mahatsu tasya śṛṅgeṣu nirdareṣu guhāsu ca / vicinudhvaṃ mahābhāgāṃ rāmapatnīṃ yaśasvinīm

vulgate_text: avṛkṣam kāma śailam ca mānasam vihaga ālayam / na gatiḥ tatra bhūtānām devānām na ca rakṣasām
ce_text: krauñcasya śikharaṃ cāpi nirīkṣya ca tatas tataḥ / avṛkṣaṃ kāmaśailaṃ ca mānasaṃ vihagālayam

vulgate_text: tejasā vā api te bhūtam na samam bhuvi vidyate / tat yathā labhyate sītā tat tvam eva anuciṃtaya
ce_text: tejasā vāpi te bhūtaṃ samaṃ bhuvi na vidyate / tad yathā labhyate sītā tattvam evopapādaya

vulgate_text: evam etat vicetavyam bhavadbhiḥ vānarottamaiḥ / tat ugra śāsanam bhartur vijñāya hari puṃgavāḥ
ce_text: tad ugraśāsanaṃ bhartur vijñāya haripuṃgavāḥ / śalabhā iva saṃchādya medinīṃ saṃpratasthire

vulgate_text: nadantaḥ ca unnadantaḥ ca garjantaḥ ca plavaṃgamāḥ / kṣvelanto dhāvamānāḥ ca vinadanto mahābalāḥ
ce_text: nadantaś connadantaś ca garjantaś ca plavaṃgamāḥ / kṣvelanto dhāvamānāś ca yayuḥ plavagasattamāḥ / ānayiṣyāmahe sītāṃ haniṣyāmaś ca rāvaṇam

vulgate_text: tato mām buddhi saṃpanno hanumān vākyam abravīt / idānīm me smṛtam rājan yathā vālī harīśvaraḥ
ce_text: idānīṃ me smṛtaṃ rājan yathā vālī harīśvaraḥ / mataṅgena tadā śapto hy asminn āśramamaṇḍale

vulgate_text: na viveśa tadā vālī mataṃgasya bhayāt tadā / evam mayā tadā rājan pratyakṣam upalakṣitam / pṛthivī maṇḍalam sarvam guhām asmi āgataḥ tataḥ
ce_text: tataḥ parvatam āsādya ṛśyamūkaṃ nṛpātmaja / na viveśa tadā vālī mataṅgasya bhayāt tadā

vulgate_text: sa tu deśo duranveṣo guhā gahanavān mahān / nirjalam nirjanam śūnyam gahanam ghora darśanam
ce_text: te bhakṣayanto mūlāni phalāni vividhāni ca / anveṣamāṇā durdharṣā nyavasaṃs tatra tatra ha / sa tu deśo duranveṣo guhāgahanavān mahān

vulgate_text: tā dṛśāni anyā api araṇyāni vicitya bhṛiśa pīḍitāḥ / sa deśaḥ ca duranveṣyo guhā gahanavān mahān
ce_text: te bhakṣayanto mūlāni phalāni vividhāni ca / anveṣamāṇā durdharṣā nyavasaṃs tatra tatra ha / sa tu deśo duranveṣo guhāgahanavān mahān

vulgate_text: na ca atra vṛkṣā na oṣadhyo na vallyo na api vīrudhaḥ / snigdha patrāḥ sthale yatra padminyaḥ phulla paṃkajāḥ
ce_text: snigdhapatrāḥ sthale yatra padminyaḥ phullapaṅkajāḥ / prekṣaṇīyāḥ sugandhāś ca bhramaraiś cāpi varjitāḥ

vulgate_text: vyacinvan prāyaśaḥ tatra sarvam tat giri gahvaram / vicitam tu tataḥ sarvam sarve te kānana okasaḥ
ce_text: te tu tasmin nirucchvāse vānarā jitakāśinaḥ / vyacinvan prāyaśas tatra sarvaṃ tad girigahvaram

vulgate_text: tatra tatra saha asmābhiḥ jānakī na ca dṛśyate / tathā rakṣaḥ apahartā ca sītāyāḥ caiva duṣkṛtī
ce_text: tatra tatra sahāsmābhir jānakī na ca dṛśyate / tad vā rakṣo hṛtā yena sītā surasutopamā

vulgate_text: anirvedam ca dākṣyam ca manasaḥ ca aparājayam / kārya siddhi karāṇi āhuḥ tasmāt etat bravīmi aham
ce_text: anirvedaṃ ca dākṣyaṃ ca manasaś cāparājayam / kāryasiddhikarāṇy āhus tasmād etad bravīmy aham

vulgate_text: avaśyam kurvatām dṛśyate karmaṇaḥ phalam / param nirvedam āgamya na hi naḥ mīlanam kṣamam
ce_text: avaśyaṃ kriyamāṇasya dṛśyate karmaṇaḥ phalam / alaṃ nirvedam āgamya na hi no malinaṃ kṣamam

vulgate_text: āseduḥ tasya śailasya koṭim dakṣiṇa pascimām / teṣām tatra eva vasatām sa kālo vyatyavartata
ce_text: teṣāṃ tatraiva vasatāṃ sa kālo vyatyavartata

vulgate_text: giri jāla āvṛtān deśān mārgitvā dakṣiṇām diśam / vicinvantaḥ tataḥ tatra dadṛśuḥ vivṛtam bilam
ce_text: girijālāvṛtān deśān mārgitvā dakṣiṇāṃ diśam / kṣutpipāsā parītāś ca śrāntāś ca salilārthinaḥ / avakīrṇaṃ latāvṛkṣair dadṛśus te mahābilam

vulgate_text: durgam ṛkṣa bilam nāma dānavena abhirakṣitam / kṣut pipāsā parītāḥ tu śrāntāḥ tu salila arthinaḥ
ce_text: girijālāvṛtān deśān mārgitvā dakṣiṇāṃ diśam / kṣutpipāsā parītāś ca śrāntāś ca salilārthinaḥ / avakīrṇaṃ latāvṛkṣair dadṛśus te mahābilam

vulgate_text: abhyapadyanta saṃhṛṣṭāḥ tejovanto mahābalāḥ / nānā sattva samākīrṇām daitya indra nilaya upamam
ce_text: saṃjātapariśaṅkās te tad bilaṃ plavagottamāḥ / abhyapadyanta saṃhṛṣṭās tejovanto mahābalāḥ

vulgate_text: durdarśam iva ghoram ca durvigāhyam ca sarvaśaḥ / tataḥ parvata kūṭa ābho hanumān māruta ātmajaḥ
ce_text: tataḥ parvatakūṭābho hanumān mārutātmajaḥ / abravīd vānarān sarvān kāntāra vanakovidaḥ

vulgate_text: acandra sūryam harayo dadṛśū roma harṣaṇam / niśamya tasmāt siṃhāḥ ca tān tān ca mṛga pakṣiṇaḥ
ce_text: ity uktās tad bilaṃ sarve viviśus timirāvṛtam / acandrasūryaṃ harayo dadṛśū romaharṣaṇam

vulgate_text: prakāśam ca abhirāmam ca dadṛśuḥ deśam uttamam / tataḥ tasmin bile bhīme nānā pādapa saṃkule
ce_text: tatas tasmin bile durge nānāpādapasaṃkule / anyonyaṃ saṃpariṣvajya jagmur yojanam antaram

vulgate_text: caṃpakān nāga vṛkṣān ca karṇikārān ca puṣpitān / stabakaiḥ kāṃcanaiḥ citraiḥ raktaiḥ kisalayaiḥ tathā
ce_text: sālāṃs tālāṃś ca puṃnāgān kakubhān vañjulān dhavān / campakān nāgavṛkṣāṃś ca karṇikārāṃś ca puṣpitān

vulgate_text: āpīḍaiḥ ca latābhiḥ ca hema ābharaṇa bhūṣitaiḥ / taruṇa āditya saṃkāśān vaidūryamaya vedikān
ce_text: taruṇādityasaṃkāśān vaidūryamayavedikān / nīlavaidūryavarṇāś ca padminīḥ patagāvṛtāḥ

vulgate_text: vibhrājamānān vapuṣā pādapān ca hiraṇmayān / nīla vaidūrya varṇāḥ ca padminīḥ patagaiḥ āvṛtāḥ
ce_text: taruṇādityasaṃkāśān vaidūryamayavedikān / nīlavaidūryavarṇāś ca padminīḥ patagāvṛtāḥ

vulgate_text: mahadbhiḥ kāṃcanaiḥ vṛkṣaiḥ vṛtā bāla arka saṃnibhaiḥ / jātarūpamayaiḥ matsyaiḥ mahadbhiḥ ca atha pankajaiḥ
ce_text: mahadbhiḥ kāñcanair vṛkṣair vṛtaṃ bālārka saṃnibhaiḥ / jātarūpamayair matsyair mahadbhiś ca sakacchapaiḥ

vulgate_text: vividhāni viśālāni dadṛśuḥ te samantataḥ / hema rajata kāṃsyānām bhājanānām ca rāśayaḥ
ce_text: mahārhāṇi ca yānāni dadṛśus te samantataḥ / haimarājatakāṃsyānāṃ bhājanānāṃ ca saṃcayān

vulgate_text: dadṛśuḥ vānarāḥ śubhrān jātarūpasya saṃcayān / tatra tatra vicinvanto bile tatra mahā prabhāḥ
ce_text: tatra tatra vicinvanto bile tatra mahāprabhāḥ / dadṛśur vānarāḥ śūrāḥ striyaṃ kāṃ cid adūrataḥ

vulgate_text: dadṛśuḥ vānarāḥ śūrāḥ striyam kāṃcit adūrataḥ / tām ca te dadṛśuḥ tatra cīra kṛṣṇa ajina ambarām
ce_text: tatra tatra vicinvanto bile tatra mahāprabhāḥ / dadṛśur vānarāḥ śūrāḥ striyaṃ kāṃ cid adūrataḥ

vulgate_text: tāpasīm niyata āhārām jvalaṃtīm iva tejasā / vismitā harayaḥ tatra vyavatiṣṭanta sarvaśaḥ / prapaccha hanumān tatra kā asi tvam kasya vā bilam
ce_text: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhṛśasaṃtrastāś cīrakṛṣṇājināmbarām / tāpasīṃ niyatāhārāṃ jvalantīm iva tejasā

vulgate_text: katham matsyāḥ ca sauvarṇā dṛśyante saha kacchapaiḥ / ātmānaḥ anubhāvāt vā kasya vai etat tapo balam
ce_text: kāñcanāni ca padmāni jātāni vimale jale / kathaṃ matsyāś ca sauvarṇā caranti saha kacchapaiḥ

vulgate_text: yena idam kāṃcanam divyam nirmitam bhavana uttamam / sa tu varṣa sahasrāṇi tapaḥ taptvā mahat vane
ce_text: sa tu varṣasahasrāṇi tapas taptvā mahāvane / pitāmahād varaṃ lebhe sarvam auśasanaṃ dhanam

vulgate_text: asmin nipatitāḥ sarve api atha kārya tvarānvitāḥ / tato gāḍham nipatitā gṛhya hastau parasparam
ce_text: tato gāḍhaṃ nipatitā gṛhya hastau parasparam / idaṃ praviṣṭāḥ sahasā bilaṃ timirasaṃvṛtam

vulgate_text: uvāca hanumān vākyam tām anindita locanām / śaraṇam tvām prapannāḥ smaḥ sarve vai dharmacāriṇim
ce_text: śaraṇaṃ tvāṃ prapannāḥ smaḥ sarve vai dharmacāriṇi / yaḥ kṛtaḥ samayo 'smākaṃ sugrīveṇa mahātmanā / sa tu kālo vyatikrānto bile ca parivartatām

vulgate_text: tyaktvā putran ca dārān ca dhanāni ca gṛhāṇi ca / dhruvam naḥ hiṃsate rājā sarvān pratigatān itaḥ
ce_text: tyaktvā putrāṃś ca dārāṃś ca dhanāni ca gṛhāṇi ca / yāvan na ghātayed rājā sarvān pratigatān itaḥ / vadhenāpratirūpeṇa śreyān mṛtyur ihaiva naḥ

vulgate_text: tīkṣṇaḥ prakṛtyā sugrīvaḥ priyā raktaḥ ca rāghavaḥ / samīkṣya akṛta kāryān tu tasmin ca samaye gate
ce_text: tīkṣṇaḥ prakṛtyā sugrīvaḥ priyāsaktaś ca rāghavaḥ / adṛṣṭāyāṃ ca vaidehyāṃ dṛṣṭvāsmāṃś ca samāgatān

vulgate_text: na kṣamam ca aparāddhānām gamanam svāmi pārśvataḥ / pradhānabūtāḥ ca vayam sugrīvasya samāgatāḥ
ce_text: rāghavapriyakāmārthaṃ ghātayiṣyaty asaṃśayam / na kṣamaṃ cāparāddhānāṃ gamanaṃ svāmipārśvataḥ

vulgate_text: lakṣmaṇasya ca nārācā bahavaḥ santi tat vidhāḥ / vajra aśani sama sparśā girīṇām api dārakāḥ
ce_text: svalpaṃ hi kṛtam indreṇa kṣipatā hy aśaniṃ purā / lakṣmaṇo niśitair bāṇair bhindyāt patrapuṭaṃ yathā / lakṣmaṇasya ca nārācā bahavaḥ santi tadvidhāḥ

vulgate_text: ati ugra vegā niśitā ghorā lakṣmaṇa sāyakāḥ / apavṛttam jighāṃsanto mahāvegā durāsadāḥ
ce_text: na ca jātu na hiṃsyus tvāṃ ghorā lakṣmaṇasāyakāḥ / apavṛttaṃ jighāṃsanto mahāvegā durāsadāḥ

vulgate_text: dharma rājaḥ pitṛvyaḥ te prīti kāmo dṛḍha vrataḥ / śuciḥ satya pratijñaḥ ca sa tvām jātu na nāśayet
ce_text: dharmakāmaḥ pitṛvyas te prītikāmo dṛḍhavrataḥ / śuciḥ satyapratijñaś ca nā tvāṃ jātu jighāṃsati

vulgate_text: abhivādana pūrvam tu rājā kuśalam eva ca / abhivādana pūrvam tu rāghavau balaśālinau
ce_text: abhivādanapūrvaṃ tu rājā kuśalam eva ca / vācyas tato yavīyān me sugrīvo vānareśvaraḥ

vulgate_text: sa saṃviśadbhiḥ bahubhiḥ mahīdharomahāadri kūṭa pramitaiḥ plavaṃgamaiḥ / babhūva sannādita nirdara antarobhṛśam nadadbhiḥ jaladaiḥ iva aṃbaram
ce_text: sa saṃviśadbhir bahubhir mahīdharo mahādrikūṭapramitaiḥ plavaṃgamaiḥ

vulgate_text: priyam kṛtvā hi rāmasya dharmajñena jaṭāyuṣā / rāghava arthe pariśrāntā vayam saṃtyakta jīvitāḥ
ce_text: rāghavārthe pariśrāntā vayaṃ saṃtyaktajīvitāḥ / kāntārāṇi prapannāḥ sma na ca paśyāma maithilīm

vulgate_text: iccheyam giri durgāt ca bhavadbhiḥ avatāritum / yavīyaso guṇajñasya ślāghanīyasya vikramaiḥ
ce_text: yavīyaso guṇajñasya ślāghanīyasya vikramaiḥ / tad iccheyam ahaṃ śrotuṃ vināśaṃ vānararṣabhāḥ

vulgate_text: ati dīrghasya kālasya parituṣṭo asmi kīrtitanāt / tat iccheyam aham śrotum vināśam vānara ṛṣabhāḥ
ce_text: yavīyaso guṇajñasya ślāghanīyasya vikramaiḥ / tad iccheyam ahaṃ śrotuṃ vināśaṃ vānararṣabhāḥ

vulgate_text: etām buddhim tataḥ cakruḥ sarve te hari yūthapāḥ / avatārya gireḥ śṛṃgāt gṛdhram āha aṃgadaḥ tadā
ce_text: etāṃ buddhiṃ tataś cakruḥ sarve te vānararṣabhāḥ / avatārya gireḥ śṛṅgād gṛdhram āhāṅgadas tadā

vulgate_text: prākāreṇa arka varṇena mahatā ca samanvitā / tasyām vasati vaidehī dīnā kauśeya vāsinī
ce_text: tasyāṃ vasati vaidehī dīnā kauśeyavāsinī / rāvaṇāntaḥpure ruddhā rākṣasībhiḥ surakṣitā

vulgate_text: garhitam tu kṛtam karma yena sma piśita aśanāḥ / pratikāryam ca me tasya vairam bhrātṛ kṛtam bhavet
ce_text: garhitaṃ tu kṛtaṃ karma yena sma piśitāśanāḥ / ihastho 'haṃ prapaśyāmi rāvaṇaṃ jānakīṃ tathā

vulgate_text: iha sthaḥ aham prapaśyāmi rāvaṇam jānakīm tathā / asmākam api sauparṇam divyam cakṣur balam tathā
ce_text: garhitaṃ tu kṛtaṃ karma yena sma piśitāśanāḥ / ihastho 'haṃ prapaśyāmi rāvaṇaṃ jānakīṃ tathā

vulgate_text: saumya vaikalyatām dṛṣṭvā romṇām te na avagamyate / agni dagdhau imau pakṣau prāṇāḥ cāpi śarīrake
ce_text: saumya vaikalyatāṃ dṛṣṭvā roṃṇāṃ te nāvagamyate / agnidagdhāv imau pakṣau tvak caiva vraṇitā tava

vulgate_text: jyeṣṭho avita stvam tu saṃpāte jaṭāyuḥ anujaḥ tava / mānuṣam rūpam āsthāya gṛhṇītām caraṇau mama
ce_text: jyeṣṭhas tvaṃ tu ca saṃpātir jaṭāyur anujas tava / mānuṣaṃ rūpam āsthāya gṛhṇītāṃ caraṇau mama

vulgate_text: aham caiva jaṭāyuḥ ca saṃgharṣāt darpa mohitau / ākāśam patitau dūrāt jijñāsantau parākramam
ce_text: ahaṃ caiva jaṭāyuś ca saṃgharṣād darpamohitau / ākāśaṃ patitau vīrau jighāsantau parākramam

vulgate_text: kvacit vāditra ghoṣaḥ ca kvacit bhūṣaṇa niḥsvanaḥ / gāyantīḥ sma aṃganā bahvīḥ paśyāvo rakta vāsasaḥ
ce_text: kva cid vāditraghoṣāṃś ca brahmaghoṣāṃś ca śuśruva / gāyantīś cāṅganā bahvīḥ paśyāvo raktavāsasaḥ

vulgate_text: yadi jīvati me bhartā lakṣmaṇo vā api devaraḥ / devatvam gatayoḥ vā api tayoḥ annam idam tu iti
ce_text: yadi jīvati me bhartā lakṣmaṇena saha prabhuḥ / devatvaṃ gatayor vāpi tayor annam idaṃ tv iti

vulgate_text: icchāmi aham api draṣṭum bhrātarau rāma lakṣmaṇau / na icche ciram dhārayitum prāṇān tyakṣye kalevaram / maharṣi tu tat abravīt idam dṛṣṭa tattva artha darśinaḥ
ce_text: icchāmy aham api draṣṭuṃ bhrātaru rāmalakṣmaṇau / necche ciraṃ dhārayituṃ prāṇāṃs tyakṣye kalevaram

vulgate_text: praharṣam atulam lebhe vānarān ca idam abravīt / niśākarasya rājarṣeḥ prabhāvāt amita ojasaḥ
ce_text: sa dṛṣṭvā svāṃ tanuṃ pakṣair udgatair aruṇacchadaiḥ / praharṣam atulaṃ lebhe vānarāṃś cedam abravīt

vulgate_text: suṣeṇaḥ tu mahātejāḥ sattvavān kapi sattamaḥ / aśītim pratijāne aham yojanānām parākrame
ce_text: suṣeṇas tu hariśreṣṭhaḥ proktavān kapisattamān / aśītiṃ yojanānāṃ tu plaveyaṃ plavagarṣabhāḥ

vulgate_text: sāṃpratam kālam asmākam yā gatiḥ tām nibodhata / navatim yojanānām tu gamiṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ
ce_text: sāmprataṃ kālabhedena yā gatis tāṃ nibodhata / navatiṃ yojanānāṃ tu gamiṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ

vulgate_text: mayā vairocane yajñe prabhaviṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ / pradakṣiṇī kṛtaḥ pūrvam kramamāṇaḥ trivikramaḥ
ce_text: mayā mahābalaiś caiva yajñe viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ / pradakṣiṇīkṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ kramamāṇas trivikramaḥ

vulgate_text: saṃprati etāvat eva adya śakyam me gamane svataḥ / na etāvatā ca saṃsiddhiḥ kāryasya asya bhaviṣyati
ce_text: saṃpraty etāvatīṃ śaktiṃ gamane tarkayāmy aham / naitāvatā ca saṃsiddhiḥ kāryasyāsya bhaviṣyati

vulgate_text: tvām api upagatam tūrṇam aṃtarīkṣam mahākape / kṣiptam indreṇa te vajram kopa āviṣṭena tejasā
ce_text: tāvad āpatatas tūrṇam antarikṣaṃ mahākape / kṣiptam indreṇa te vajraṃ krodhāviṣṭena dhīmatā

vulgate_text: tathā ca oṣadhayo asmābhiḥ saṃcitā deva śāsanāt / nirmathyam amṛtam yābhiḥ tadā tadānīm no mahat balam
ce_text: tadā cauṣadhayo 'smābhiḥ saṃcitā devaśāsanāt / niṣpannam amṛtaṃ yābhis tadāsīn no mahad balam

vulgate_text: tataḥ kapīnām ṛṣabheṇa coditaḥpratīta vegaḥ pavana ātmajaḥ kapiḥ / praharṣayan tām hari vīra vāhinīmcakāra rūpam mahat ātmanaḥ tadā
ce_text: tatas tu vai jāmbavatābhicoditaḥ pratītavegaḥ pavanātmajaḥ kapiḥ / praharṣayaṃs tāṃ harivīra vāhinīṃ cakāra rūpaṃ mahad ātmanas tadā

vulgate_text: ko api loke na me vegam plavane dhārayiṣyati / etāni hi nagasya asya śilā saṃkaṭa śālinaḥ
ce_text: etāni hi nagasyāsya śilāsaṃkaṭaśālinaḥ / śikharāṇi mahendrasya sthirāṇi ca mahānti ca

vulgate_text: śikharāṇi mahendrasya sthirāṇi ca mahānti ca / yeṣu vegam gamiṣyāmi mahendra śikhareṣu aham
ce_text: etāni hi nagasyāsya śilāsaṃkaṭaśālinaḥ / śikharāṇi mahendrasya sthirāṇi ca mahānti ca

vulgate_text: mumoca ca śilāḥ śailo viśālāḥ samanaḥśilāḥ / madhyamenārciṣā juṣṭo dhūmarājīrivānalaḥ
ce_text: pīḍyamānas tu balinā mahendras tena parvataḥ / rītir nirvartayām āsa kāñcanāñjanarājatīḥ / mumoca ca śilāḥ śailo viśālāḥ samanaḥśilāḥ

vulgate_text: utpapātātha vegena vegavānavicārayan / suparṇamiva cātmānaṃ mene sa kapikuñjaraḥ
ce_text: evam uktvā tu hanumān vānarān vānarottamaḥ / utpapātātha vegena vegavān avicārayan

vulgate_text: tārācitamivākāśaṃ prababhau ca mahārṇavaḥ / puṣpaughenānubaddhena nānāvarṇena vānaraḥ / babhau megha ivākāśe vidyudgaṇavibhūṣitaḥ
ce_text: puṣpaugheṇānubaddhena nānāvarṇena vānaraḥ / babhau megha ivodyan vai vidyudgaṇavibhūṣitaḥ

vulgate_text: vikarṣannūrmijālāni bṛhanti lavaṇāmbhasi / pupluve kapiśārdūlo vikiranniva rodasī
ce_text: vikarṣann ūrmijālāni bṛhanti lavaṇāmbhasi / atyakrāman mahāvegas taraṅgān gaṇayann iva

vulgate_text: merumandarasaṃkāśānuddhatān sa mahārṇave / atyakrāmanmahāvegastaraṅgān gaṇayanniva
ce_text: vikarṣann ūrmijālāni bṛhanti lavaṇāmbhasi / atyakrāman mahāvegas taraṅgān gaṇayann iva

vulgate_text: yathā jaladharaṃ bhittvā dīptaraśmirdivākaraḥ / sa mahātmā muhūrtena sarvataḥ salilāvṛtaḥ
ce_text: sa sāgarajalaṃ bhittvā babhūvātyutthitas tadā / yathā jaladharaṃ bhittvā dīptaraśmir divākaraḥ

vulgate_text: drśayāmāsa śṛṅgāṇi sāgareṇa niyojitaḥ / śātakumbhamayaiḥ śṛṅgaiḥ sakinnaramahoragaiḥ
ce_text: śātakumbhamayaiḥ śṛṅgaiḥ sakiṃnaramahoragaiḥ / ādityodayasaṃkāśair ālikhadbhir ivāmbaram

vulgate_text: vyādāya vipulaṃ vaktraṃ sthitā sā māruteḥ puraḥ / evamuktaḥ surasayā kruddho vānarapuñgavaḥ
ce_text: evam uktaḥ surasayā kruddho vānarapuṃgavaḥ / abravīt kuru vai vaktraṃ yena māṃ viṣahiṣyase

vulgate_text: abravītkuru vai vaktraṃ yena māṃ viṣahiṣyase / praviśya vadanaṃ me'dya gntavyaṃ vānarottama / vara eṣa purā datto mamam dhrātreti satvarā
ce_text: evam uktaḥ surasayā kruddho vānarapuṃgavaḥ / abravīt kuru vai vaktraṃ yena māṃ viṣahiṣyase
