vulgate_text: vyādāya vipulaṃ vaktraṃ sthitā sā maruteḥ puraḥ / taṃ dṛṣhṭvā meghasaṃkāśaṃ daśayojanamāyatam
ce_text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā meghasaṃkāśaṃ daśayojanam āyatam / cakāra surasāpy āsyaṃ viṃśadyojanam āyatam

vulgate_text: bahuśaḥ sevite vīrairvidyādharagaṇairvaraiḥ / jagāma vāyumārge tu garutmāniva mārutiḥ
ce_text: bahuśaḥ sevite vīrair vidyādharagaṇair varaiḥ / kapinā kṛṣyamāṇāni mahābhrāṇi cakāśire

vulgate_text: chāytaddhṛṣṭvā cintayāmāsa mārutirvikṛtānanam / kapirājena kathitaṃ sattvamadbhutadarśanam
ce_text: kapirājñā yad ākhyātaṃ sattvam adbhutadarśanam / chāyāgrāhi mahāvīryaṃ tad idaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ

vulgate_text: vaktraṃ prasārayāmāsa pātālāntarasannibham / ghanarājīva garjantī vānaraṃ sambhidravat
ce_text: tasya sā kāyam udvīkṣya vardhamānaṃ mahākapeḥ / vaktraṃ prasārayām āsa pātālāmbarasaṃnibham

vulgate_text: hṛtahṛtsā hanumatā papāta vidhurāmbhasi / tāṃ hatāṃ vānareṇāśu patitāṃ vīkṣya siṃhikām
ce_text: tāṃ hatāṃ vānareṇāśu patitāṃ vīkṣya siṃhikām / bhūtāny ākāśacārīṇi tam ūcuḥ plavagarṣabham

vulgate_text: punaḥ prakṛtimāpede vītamoha ivātmavān / tadrūpamatisaṃkṣipya hanumān prakṛtau sthitaḥ
ce_text: tataḥ śarīraṃ saṃkṣipya tan mahīdharasaṃnibham / punaḥ prakṛtim āpede vītamoha ivātmavān

vulgate_text: kāñcanenāvṛtāṃ ramyāṃ prākāreṇa mahāpurīm / gṛhaiśca grahasaṃkāśaiḥ śāradāmbudasannibhaiḥ
ce_text: kāñcanenāvṛtāṃ ramyāṃ prākāreṇa mahāpurīm / aṭṭālakaśatākīrṇāṃ patākādhvajamālinīm

vulgate_text: pāṇḍurābhiḥ pratolībhiruccābhirabhisaṃvṛtām / aṭṭālakaśatākīrṇāṃ patākādhvajamālinīm
ce_text: kāñcanenāvṛtāṃ ramyāṃ prākāreṇa mahāpurīm / aṭṭālakaśatākīrṇāṃ patākādhvajamālinīm

vulgate_text: manseva kṛtāṃ laṅkāṃ nirmitāṃ viśvakarmaṇā / dvāramuttaramāsādya cintayāmāsa vānaraḥ
ce_text: dvāram uttaram āsādya cintayām āsa vānaraḥ / kailāsaśikharaprakhyam ālikhantam ivāmbaram / dhriyamāṇam ivākāśam ucchritair bhavanottamaiḥ

vulgate_text: iti saṃcintya hanumān sūryasyāstamayaṃ kapiḥ / ācakāṃkṣe tato vīro vaidehyā draśanotusakaḥ
ce_text: iti saṃcintya hanumān sūryasyāstamayaṃ kapiḥ / ācakāṅkṣe tadā vīrā vaidehyā darśanotsukaḥ / pṛṣadaṃśakamātraḥ san babhūvādbhutadarśanaḥ

vulgate_text: sūrye cāstaṃ gate rātrau dehaṃ saṃkṣipya mārutiḥ / vṛṣadaṃśakamātraḥ san babhūvādbhutadarśanaḥ
ce_text: iti saṃcintya hanumān sūryasyāstamayaṃ kapiḥ / ācakāṅkṣe tadā vīrā vaidehyā darśanotsukaḥ / pṛṣadaṃśakamātraḥ san babhūvādbhutadarśanaḥ

vulgate_text: cakreṇā'tha padam savyam śatrūṇām sa tu mūrdhani / praviṣṭaḥ sattvasaṃpanno viśāyām mārutātmajaḥ
ce_text: praviṣṭaḥ sattvasaṃpanno niśāyāṃ mārutātmajaḥ / sa mahāpatham āsthāya muktāpuṣpavirājitam

vulgate_text: sa mahāpathamāsthāya muktāpuṣpavirājitam / tatastu tām purīm laṅkām ramyāmabhiyayau kapiḥ
ce_text: praviṣṭaḥ sattvasaṃpanno niśāyāṃ mārutātmajaḥ / sa mahāpatham āsthāya muktāpuṣpavirājitam

vulgate_text: āsphoṭita ninādāmaḥ ca kṣveḍitāmaḥ ca tataḥ tataḥ / śuśrāva japatām tatra mantran rakṣogṛheṣu vai
ce_text: śuśrāva kāñcīninādaṃ nūpurāṇāṃ ca niḥsvanam / sopānaninadāṃś caiva bhavaneṣu mahātmanam / āsphoṭitaninādāṃś ca kṣveḍitāṃś ca tatas tataḥ

vulgate_text: nātigaurānnātikṛṣṇānnātikubjānna vāmanān / virūpān bahu rūpāmaḥ ca surūpāmaḥ ca suvarcasaḥ
ce_text: nātiṣṭhūlān nātikṛśān nātidīrghātihrasvakān / virūpān bahurūpāṃś ca surūpāṃś ca suvarcasaḥ

vulgate_text: dhvajīn patākinaścaiva dadarśa vividhāyudhān / śakti vṛkṣa āyudhāmaḥ caiva paṭṭiśa aśani dhāriṇaḥ
ce_text: śaktivṛkṣāyudhāṃś caiva paṭṭiśāśanidhāriṇaḥ / kṣepaṇīpāśahastāṃś ca dadarśa sa mahākapiḥ

vulgate_text: nānāveṣasamāyuktānyathāsvairagatān bahūn / tīkṣṇa śūla dharāmaḥ caiva vajriṇaḥ ca mahā balān
ce_text: sragviṇas tv anuliptāṃś ca varābharaṇabhūṣitān / tīkṣṇaśūladharāṃś caiva vajriṇaś ca mahābalān

vulgate_text: śata sāhasram avyagram ārakṣam madhyamam kapiḥ / rakṣodhipatinirdiṣṭam dadarśāntaḥpurāgrataḥ
ce_text: śatasāhasram avyagram ārakṣaṃ madhyamaṃ kapiḥ / prākārāvṛtam atyantaṃ dadarśa sa mahākapiḥ

vulgate_text: puṇḍarīkāvatamsābhiḥ parikhābhiralamkṛtam / prākāra āvṛtam atyantam dadarśa sa mahā kapiḥ
ce_text: śatasāhasram avyagram ārakṣaṃ madhyamaṃ kapiḥ / prākārāvṛtam atyantaṃ dadarśa sa mahākapiḥ

vulgate_text: dadarśa kāntāśca samālabhantya / stathā parāstatra punaḥ svapantyaḥ / surūpavaktrāśca tathā hasantyaḥ / kruddhāḥ parāścapi viniḥśvasantyaḥ
ce_text: rakṣāṃsi vakṣāṃsi ca vikṣipanti gātrāṇi kāntāsu ca vikṣipanti / dadarśa kāntāś ca samālapanti tathāparās tatra punaḥ svapanti

vulgate_text: lankā ābharaṇam iti eva so amanyata mahā kapiḥ / cacāra hanumāmstatra rāvaṇasya samīpataḥ
ce_text: virājamānaṃ vapuṣā gajāśvarathasaṃkulam / laṅkābharaṇam ity eva so 'manyata mahākapiḥ

vulgate_text: śūla mudgala hastāḥ ca śakto tomara dhāriṇīḥ / dadarśa vividhān gulmāmaḥ tasya rakṣaḥ pater gṛhe / rākṣasāṃśca mahākāyānnānāpraharaṇodyatān
ce_text: rāvaṇasyopaśāyinyo dadarśa harisattamaḥ / vicaran hariśārdūlo rākṣasīr vikṛtekṣaṇāḥ / śūlamudgarahastāś ca śakto tomaradhāriṇīḥ

vulgate_text: kūṭāgārairvarākārairvividhaiḥ samalamkṛtam / vimānam puṣpakam divyam āruroha mahā kapiḥ
ce_text: jālavātāyanair yuktaṃ kāñcanaiḥ sthāṭikair api / indranīlamahānīlamaṇipravaravedikam / vimānaṃ puṣpakaṃ divyam āruroha mahākapiḥ

vulgate_text: anyonyasya anga samsparśāt prīyamāṇāḥ sumadhyamāḥ / ekī kṛta bhujāḥ sarvāḥ suṣupuḥ tatra yoṣitaḥanyonya bhuja sūtreṇa strī mālā grathitā hi sā / mālā iva grathitā sūtre śuśubhe matta ṣaṭpadā
ce_text: anyonyasyāṅgasaṃsparśāt prīyamāṇāḥ sumadhyamāḥ / ekīkṛtabhujāḥ sarvāḥ suṣupus tatra yoṣitaḥ

vulgate_text: kācid amśam pariṣvajya suptā kamala locanā / rahaḥ priyatamam gṛhya sakāmeva ca kāminī
ce_text: kā cid aṃśaṃ pariṣvajya suptā kamalalocanā / nidrāvaśam anuprāptā sahakānteva bhāminī

vulgate_text: vipañcaiim parigṛhyānyā niyatā nṛttaśālinī / nidrā vaśam anuprāptā saha kāntā iva bhāminī
ce_text: kā cid aṃśaṃ pariṣvajya suptā kamalalocanā / nidrāvaśam anuprāptā sahakānteva bhāminī

vulgate_text: apakramya tadā vīraḥ pradhyātum upacakrame / sa bhūyastu param śrīmān mārutiryatnamāsthitaḥ
ce_text: tām apaśyan kapis tatra paśyaṃś cānyā varastriyaḥ / apakramya tadā vīraḥ pradhyātum upacakrame

vulgate_text: kāñcanīm śimśupām ekām dadarśa sa mahā kapiḥ / vṛtām hemamayūbhistu vedikābhiḥ samantataḥ
ce_text: latāpratānair bahubhiḥ parṇaiś ca bahubhir vṛtām / kāñcanīṃ śiṃśupām ekāṃ dadarśa sa mahākapiḥ

vulgate_text: nīla nāga ābhayā veṇyā jaghanam gatayā ekayā / nīlayā nīradāpāye vanarājyā mahīmiva
ce_text: nīlanāgābhayā veṇyā jaghanaṃ gatayaikayā / sukhārhāṃ duḥkhasaṃtaptāṃ vyasanānām akodivām

vulgate_text: kinnu me na guṇāḥ kecit kiṃvā bhāgyakṣayo mama / yā 'haṃ sīdāmi rāmeṇa hīnā mukhyena bhāminī
ce_text: kiṃ nu me na guṇāḥ ke cit kiṃ vā bhāgya kṣayo hi me / yāhaṃ sītā varārheṇa hīnā rāmeṇa bhāminī

vulgate_text: pāṇḍurarṣabhayuktena rathenāṣṭayujā svayam / ihopayātaḥ kākutsthaḥ sītayā saha bhāryayā
ce_text: pāṇḍurarṣabhayuktena rathenāṣṭayujā svayam / śuklamālyāmbaradharo lakṣmaṇena samāgataḥ / lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā sītayā saha bhāryayā

vulgate_text: evaṃ svapne mayā dṛṣṭo rāmo viṣṇuparākramaḥ / lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā sītayā saha bhāryayā
ce_text: pāṇḍurarṣabhayuktena rathenāṣṭayujā svayam / śuklamālyāmbaradharo lakṣmaṇena samāgataḥ / lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā sītayā saha bhāryayā

vulgate_text: rathena kharayuktena raktamālyānulepanaḥ / pibaṃstailaṃ hasan nṛtyan bhrāntacittākulendriyaḥ / gardabhena yayau śīghraṃ dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāsthitaḥ
ce_text: rathena kharayuktena raktamālyānulepanaḥ / prayāto dakṣiṇām āśāṃ praviṣṭaḥ kardamaṃ hradam

vulgate_text: rājarṣīṇāṃ guṇaśreṣṭastapasā carṣibhiḥ samaḥ / cakravartikule jātaḥ purandarasamo bale
ce_text: rājā daśaratho nāma rathakuñjaravājinām / puṇyaśīlo mahākīrtir ṛjur āsīn mahāyaśāḥ / cakravartikule jātaḥ puraṃdarasamo bale

vulgate_text: tena tatra mahāraṇye mṛgayāṃ paridhāvatā / rākṣasā nihatāḥ śūrā bahavaḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ
ce_text: tena tatra mahāraṇye mṛgayāṃ paridhāvatā / janasthānavadhaṃ śrutvā hatau ca kharadūṣaṇau / tatas tv amarṣāpahṛtā jānakī rāvaṇena tu

vulgate_text: tataḥ śākhāntare līnaṃ dṛṣṭvā calitamānasā / veṣṭitārjunavastraṃ taṃ vidyutsaṅghātapiṅgalam
ce_text: tataḥ śākhāntare līnaṃ dṛṣṭvā calitamānasā / sā dadarśa kapiṃ tatra praśritaṃ priyavādinam

vulgate_text: sā dadarśa kapiṃ tatra praśritaṃ priyavādinam / phullāśokotkarābhāsaṃ taptacāmīkarekṣaṇam
ce_text: tataḥ śākhāntare līnaṃ dṛṣṭvā calitamānasā / sā dadarśa kapiṃ tatra praśritaṃ priyavādinam

vulgate_text: sā vīkṣamāṇā pṛthubhugnavaktraṃ śākhāmṛgendrasya yathoktakāram / dadarśa piṅgadhipateramātyaṃ vātātmajaṃ buddhimatāṃ variṣṭham
ce_text: sā tiryag ūrdhvaṃ ca tathāpy adhastān nirīkṣamāṇā tam acintya buddhim / dadarśa piṅgādhipater amātyaṃ vātātmajaṃ sūryam ivodayastham

vulgate_text: tristhirastripralambaśca trisamastriṣu connataḥ / tritāmrastriṣu ca snigdho gambhīrastriṣu nityaśaḥ
ce_text: tristhiras tripralambaś ca trisamas triṣu connataḥ / trivalīvāṃs tryavaṇataś caturvyaṅgas triśīrṣavān

vulgate_text: caturdaśasamadvandvaścaturdaṃṣṭraścaturvargatiḥ / mahoṣṭhahanunāsaśca pañcasnigdho 'ṣṭavaṃśavān
ce_text: mahauṣṭhahanunāsaś ca pañcasnigdho 'ṣṭavaṃśavān / daśapadmo daśabṛhat tribhir vyāpto dviśuklavān / ṣaḍunnato navatanus tribhir vyāpnoti rāghavaḥ

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā prāyopaviṣṭāṃśca sarvān vānarapuṅgavān / bhṛśaṃ śokārṇave magnaḥ paryadevayadaṅgadaḥ
ce_text: bhṛśaṃ śokārṇave magnaḥ paryadevayad aṅgadaḥ / tava nāśaṃ ca vaidehi vālinaś ca tathā vadham / prāyopaveśam asmākaṃ maraṇaṃ ca jaṭāyuṣaḥ

vulgate_text: vindhyādutthāya saṃprāptāḥ sāgarasyāntamuttaram / tvaddarśanakṛtotsāhā hṛṣṭāstuṣṭāḥ plavaṅgamāḥ
ce_text: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā saṃpāteḥ prītivardhanam / aṅgadapramukhāḥ sarve tataḥ saṃprasthitā vayam / tvaddarśanakṛtotsāhā hṛṣṭās tuṣṭāḥ plavaṃgamāḥ

vulgate_text: viśvāsārthaṃ tu vaidehi bharturuktā mayā guṇāḥ / acirād rāghavo devi tvāmito nayitā 'naghe
ce_text: tasyāhaṃ hariṇaḥ kṣetre jāto vātena maithili / hanūmān iti vikhyāto loke svenaiva karmaṇā / viśvāsārthaṃ tu vaidehi bhartur uktā mayā guṇāḥ

vulgate_text: pratyayārthaṃ tavānītaṃ tena dattaṃ mahātmanā / samāśvasihi bhadraṃ te kṣīṇaduḥkhaphalā hyasi
ce_text: vānaro 'haṃ mahābhāge dūto rāmasya dhīmataḥ / rāmanāmāṅkitaṃ cedaṃ paśya devy aṅgulīyakam / samāśvasihi bhadraṃ te kṣīṇaduḥkhaphalā hy asi

vulgate_text: na tvāmihasthāṃ jānīte rāmaḥ kamalalocane / tena tvāṃ nānayatyāśu śacīmiva purandaraḥ
ce_text: na tvām ihasthāṃ jānīte rāmaḥ kamalalocanaḥ / śrutvaiva tu vaco mahyaṃ kṣipram eṣyati rāghavaḥ

vulgate_text: bhartṛmaktiṃ puraskṛtya rāmādanyasya vānara / na spṛśāmi śarīraṃ tu puṃso vārarapuṅgavaḥ
ce_text: bhartur bhaktiṃ puraskṛtya rāmād anyasya vānara / nāhaṃ spraṣṭuṃ padā gātram iccheyaṃ vānarottama

vulgate_text: pariśramāt prasuptā ca rāghavāṅke 'pyahaṃ ciram / paryāyeṇa prasuptaśca mamāṅke bharatāgrajaḥ / sa tatra punarevātha vāyasaḥ samupāgamat
ce_text: paryāyeṇa prasuptaś ca mamāṅke bharatāgrajaḥ

vulgate_text: sa māṃ dṛṣṭvā mahābāhurvitunnāṃ stanayostadā / āśīviṣa iva kruddhaḥ śvasan vākyamabhāṣata
ce_text: āśīviṣa iva kruddhaḥ śvasān vākyam abhāṣathāḥ / kena te nāganāsoru vikṣataṃ vai stanāntaram / kaḥ krīḍati saroṣeṇa pañcavaktreṇa bhoginā

vulgate_text: hinastu dakṣiṇākṣi tvacchara ityatha so 'bravīt / tatastasyākṣi kākasya hinasti sma sa dakṣiṇam / dattvā sa dakṣiṇaṃ netraṃ prāṇebhyaḥ parirakṣitaḥ
ce_text: tatas tasyākṣi kākasya hinasti sma sa dakṣiṇam

vulgate_text: sa kuruṣva mahotsāhaḥ kṛpāṃ mayi nararṣabha / tvayā nāthavatī nātha hyanāthā iva dṛśyate
ce_text: sa kuruṣva mahotsāhaṃ kṛpāṃ mayi nararṣabha / ānṛśaṃsyaṃ paro dharmas tvatta eva mayā śrutaḥ

vulgate_text: yathā hi vānaraśreṣṭha duḥkhakṣayakaro bhavet / tvamasmin kāryaniryoge pramāṇaṃ harisattama
ce_text: tvam asmin kāryaniryoge pramāṇaṃ harisattama / tasya cintaya yo yatno duḥkhakṣayakaro bhavet

vulgate_text: sugrīvaṃ ca sahāmātyaṃ vṛddhān sarvāṃśca vārarān / brūyāstvaṃ vānaraśreṣṭha kuśalaṃ dharmasaṃhitam
ce_text: kuśalaṃ hanuman brūyāḥ sahitau rāmalakṣmaṇau / sugrīvaṃ ca sahāmātyaṃ vṛddhān sarvāṃś ca vānarān

vulgate_text: tasyāsphoṭitaśabdena mahatā śrotraghātinā / peturvihaṅgamāstatra caityapālāśca mohitāḥ
ce_text: tasyāsphoṭitaśabdena mahatā śrotraghātinā / petur vihaṃgā gaganād uccaiś cedam aghoṣayat

vulgate_text: tavāstrabalamāsādya nāsurā na marudgaṇāḥ / na śekuḥ samare sthātuṃ sureśvarasamāśritāḥ
ce_text: tavāstrabalam āsādya nāsurā na marudgaṇāḥ / na kaś cit triṣu lokeṣu saṃyuge na gataśramaḥ

vulgate_text: balāni susamṛddhāni sāśvanāgarathāni ca / sahodaraste dayitaḥ kumāro 'kṣaśca sūditaḥ
ce_text: sahodaras te dayitaḥ kumāro 'kṣaś ca sūditaḥ / na tu teṣv eva me sāro yas tvayy ariniṣūdana

vulgate_text: asya krūrairnṛśaṃsaiśca karmabhirlokakutsitaiḥ / tena bibhyati khalvasmāllokāḥ sāmaradānavāḥ
ce_text: tena bibhyati khalv asmāl lokāḥ sāmaradānavāḥ / ayaṃ hy utsahate kruddhaḥ kartum ekārṇavaṃ jagat

vulgate_text: yadi vaiśravaṇasya tvaṃ yamasya varuṇasya ca / cārarūpamidaṃ kṛtvā praviṣṭo naḥ purīmimām / viṣṇunā preṣito vāpi dūto vijayakāṅkṣiṇā
ce_text: yadi vaiśravaṇasya tvaṃ yamasya varuṇasya ca / cārurūpam idaṃ kṛtvā yamasya varuṇasya ca

vulgate_text: vimukto hyahamastreṇa rākṣasaistvabhipīḍitaḥ / kenacidrājakāryeṇa saṃprāpto 'smi tavāntikam
ce_text: rājānaṃ draṣṭukāmena mayāstram anuvartitam / vimukto aham astreṇa rākṣasais tv atipīḍitaḥ

vulgate_text: samudraṃ laṅghayitvaiva tāṃ didṛkṣurihāgataḥ / bhramatā ca mayā dṛṣṭā gṛhe te janakātmajā
ce_text: ahaṃ tu hanumān nāma mārutasyaurasaḥ sutaḥ / sītāyās tu kṛte tūrṇaṃ śatayojanam āyatam / samudraṃ laṅghayitvaiva tāṃ didṛkṣur ihāgataḥ

vulgate_text: anvīyamāno rakṣobhiryayau sukhamarindamaḥ / hanumāṃścārayāmāsa rākṣasānāṃ mahāpurīm
ce_text: hanumāṃś cārayām āsa rākṣasānāṃ mahāpurīm / athāpaśyad vimānāni vicitrāṇi mahākapiḥ

vulgate_text: vīthīśca gṛhasaṃbādhāḥ kapiḥ śrṛṅgāṭakāni ca / tathā rathyoparathyāśca tathaiva gṛhakāntarān / gṛhāṃśca meghasaṅkāśān dadarśa pavanātmajaḥ
ce_text: saṃvṛtān bhūmibhāgāṃś ca suvibhaktāṃś ca catvarān / rathyāś ca gṛhasaṃbādhāḥ kapiḥ śṛṅgāṭakāni ca

vulgate_text: tato 'nyat pupluve veśma mahāpārśvasya vīryavān / mumoca hanumānagniṃ kālānalaśikhopamam
ce_text: mumoca hanumān agniṃ kālānalaśikhopamam

vulgate_text: nāgnistṛpyati kāṣṭhānāṃ tṛṇānāṃ hariyūthapaḥ / nāgnernāpi viśastānāṃ rākṣasānāṃ vasundharā
ce_text: nāgnis tṛpyati kāṣṭhānāṃ tṛṇānāṃ ca yathā tathā / hanūmān rākṣasendrāṇāṃ vadhe kiṃ cin na tṛpyati

vulgate_text: trikūṭaśṛṅgāgratale vicitre pratiṣṭhito vānararājasiṃhaḥ / pradīptalāṅgūlakṛtārcimālī vyarājatāditya ivāṃśumālī
ce_text: sa tān nihatvā raṇacaṇḍavikramaḥ samīkṣamāṇaḥ punar eva laṅkām / pradīptalāṅgūlakṛtārcimālī prakāśatāditya ivāṃśumālī

vulgate_text: tuṅgapadmakajuṣṭābhirnīlābhirvanarājibhiḥ / sottarīyamivāmbhodaiḥ śrṛṅgāntaravilambibhiḥ
ce_text: tuṅgapadmakajuṣṭābhir nīlābhir vanarājibhiḥ / sālatālāśvakarṇaiś ca vaṃśaiś ca bahubhir vṛtam

vulgate_text: kūṭaiśca bahudhākīrṇaiḥ śobhitaṃ bahukandaraiḥ / sālatālāśvakarṇaiśca vaṃśaiśca bahubhirvṛtam
ce_text: tuṅgapadmakajuṣṭābhir nīlābhir vanarājibhiḥ / sālatālāśvakarṇaiś ca vaṃśaiś ca bahubhir vṛtam

vulgate_text: tamāruroha hanumān parvataṃ pavanātmajaḥ / rāmadarśanaśīghreṇa praharṣeṇābhicoditaḥ
ce_text: tam ārurohātibalaḥ parvataṃ plavagottamaḥ / rāmadarśanaśīghreṇa praharṣeṇābhicoditaḥ

vulgate_text: nadannādena mahatā meghasvanamahāsvanaḥ / pravarān rākṣasān hatvā nāma viśrāvya cātmanaḥ
ce_text: nadan nādena mahatā meghasvanamahāsvanaḥ / ājagāma mahātejāḥ punar madhyena sāgaram

vulgate_text: sa pūrayāmāsa kapirdiśo daśa samantataḥ / nadannādena mahatā meghasvanamahāsvanaḥ
ce_text: nadan nādena mahatā meghasvanamahāsvanaḥ / ājagāma mahātejāḥ punar madhyena sāgaram

vulgate_text: aho svāmini te bhaktiraho vīryamaho dhṛtiḥ / diṣṭyā dṛṣṭā tvayā devī rāmapatnī yaśasvinī
ce_text: diṣṭyā dṛṣṭā tvayā devī rāmapatnī yaśasvinī / diṣṭyā tyakṣyati kākutsthaḥ śokaṃ sītā viyogajam

vulgate_text: tena cāhamanujñāto mainākena mahātmanā / sa cāpyantarhitaḥ śailo mānuṣeṇa vapuṣmatā / śarīreṇa mahāśailaḥ śailena ca mahodadhau
ce_text: tena cāham anujñāto mainākena mahātmanā / uttamaṃ javam āsthāya śeṣam adhvānam āsthitaḥ

vulgate_text: tadekavāsaḥsaṃvītāṃ rajodhvastaśiroruhām / śokasantāpadīnāṅgīṃ sītāṃ bhartṛhite sthitām
ce_text: tad ekavāsaḥsaṃvītā rajodhvastā tathaiva ca / śokasaṃtāpadīnāṅgī sītā bhartṛhite ratā

vulgate_text: tataḥ prahastasya sutaṃ jambumālinamādiśat / rākṣasairbahubhiḥ sārdhaṃ ghorarūpairbhayānakaiḥ
ce_text: tataḥ prahastasya sutaṃ jambumālinam ādiśat

vulgate_text: so 'viṣahyaṃ hi māṃ buddhvā svabalaṃ cāvamarditam / brāhmeṇāstreṇa sa tu māṃ prābadhnāccātivegitaḥ
ce_text: brāhmeṇāstreṇa sa tu māṃ prabadhnāc cātivegataḥ / rajjūbhir abhibadhnanti tato māṃ tatra rākṣasāḥ

vulgate_text: sugrīvaśca mahātejāḥ sa tvāṃ kuśalamabravīt / dharmārthakāmasahitaṃ hitaṃ pathyamuvāca ca
ce_text: śṛṇu cāpi samādeśaṃ yad ahaṃ prabravīmi te / rākṣaseśa harīśas tvāṃ vākyam āha samāhitam / dharmārthakāmasahitaṃ hitaṃ pathyam ivāśanam

vulgate_text: mayā ca kathitaṃ tasmai vālinaśca vadhaṃ prati / tatra sāhāyyahetorme samayaṃ kartumarhasi
ce_text: tena me kathitaṃ rājan bhāryā me rakṣasā hṛtā / tatra sāhāyyahetor me samayaṃ kartum arhasi

vulgate_text: tena vadhyo 'hamājñapto rakṣasā raudrakarmaṇā / matprabhāvamavijñāya rāvaṇena durātmanā
ce_text: tena vadhyo 'ham ājñapto rakṣasā raudrakarmaṇā

vulgate_text: dahatā ca mayā laṅkāṃ dagdhā sītā na saṃśayaḥ / rāmasya hi mahat kāryaṃ mayedaṃ vitathīkṛtam
ce_text: dagdhvā laṅkāṃ punaś caiva śaṅkā mām abhyavartata / dahatā ca mayā laṅkāṃ dagdhā sītā na saṃśayaḥ

vulgate_text: tato me buddhirutpannā śrutvā tāmadbhutāṃ giram / adagddhā jānakītyevaṃ nimittaiścopalakṣitā
ce_text: tato me buddhir utpannā śrutvā tām adbhutāṃ giram / punar dṛṣṭā ca vaidehī visṛṣṭaś ca tayā punaḥ

vulgate_text: aśviputrau mahābhāgāvetau plavagasattamau / etayoḥ pratiyoddhāraṃ na paśyāmi raṇājire
ce_text: aśviputrau mahāvegāv etau plavagasattamau / pitāmahavarotsekāt paramaṃ darpam āsthitau

vulgate_text: pitāmahavarotsekāt paramaṃ darpamāsthitau / amṛtaprāśināvetau sarvavānarasattamau
ce_text: aśviputrau mahāvegāv etau plavagasattamau / pitāmahavarotsekāt paramaṃ darpam āsthitau

vulgate_text: aṅgadenānumatāssantastato muditāḥ tatpreritāḥ pranṛtyanto 'bhavan
ce_text: tataś cānumatāḥ sarve saṃprahṛṣṭā vanaukasaḥ / muditāś ca tatas te ca pranṛtyanti tatas tataḥ

vulgate_text: atisargācca paṭavo dṛṣṭvā śrutvā ca maithilīm / papuḥ sarve madhu tadā rasavat phalamādaduḥ
ce_text: te prahṛṣṭā madhuvanaṃ pālān ākramya vīryataḥ / atisargāc ca paṭavo dṛṣṭvā śrutvā ca maithilīm

vulgate_text: kāryasiddhirmatiścaiva tasmin vānarapuṅgave / vyavasāyaśca vīryaṃ ca śrutaṃ cāpi pratiṣṭhitam
ce_text: kāryasiddhir hanumati matiś ca haripuṃgava / vyavasāyaś ca vīryaṃ ca śrutaṃ cāpi pratiṣṭhitam

vulgate_text: eṣa cūḍāmaṇiḥ śrīmān mayā suparirakṣitaḥ / manaḥśilāyāstilako gaṇḍapārśve niveśitaḥ
ce_text: eṣa cūḍāmaṇiḥ śrīmān mayā te yatnarakṣitaḥ / manaḥśilāyās tikalas taṃ smarasveti cābravīt

vulgate_text: tvayā pranaṣṭe tilake taṃ kila smartumarhasi / eṣa niryātitaḥ śrīmān mayā te vārisambhavaḥ
ce_text: eṣa niryātitaḥ śrīmān mayā te vārisaṃbhavaḥ / etaṃ dṛṣṭvā pramodiṣye vyasane tvām ivānagha

vulgate_text: punarevāgatastrastastvakāśamarindama / sa taṃ nipatitaṃ bhūmau śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇāgatam
ce_text: taṃ tvaṃ nipatitaṃ bhūmau śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇāgatam / vadhārham api kākutstha kṛpayā paripālayaḥ

vulgate_text: na nāgā nāpi gandharvā nāsurā na marudgaṇāḥ / na ca sarve raṇe śaktā rāmaṃ pratisamāsitum
ce_text: na nāgā nāpi gandharvā nāsurā na marudgaṇāḥ / tava rāma mukhe sthātuṃ śaktāḥ pratisamādhitum

vulgate_text: aśrupūrṇamukhī dīnā bāṣpasandigdhabhāṣiṇī / mamotpatanasambhrāntā śokavegasamāhatā
ce_text: gamane ca kṛtotsāham avekṣya varavarṇinī / vivardhamānaṃ ca hi mām uvāca janakātmajā / aśrupūrṇamukhī dīnā bāṣpasaṃdigdhabhāṣiṇī

vulgate_text: kuryāttadunurāgeṇa tamahuḥ puruṣottamam / yo niyuktaḥ param kāryam na kuryānnaṛpateḥ priyam
ce_text: yo hi bhṛtyo niyuktaḥ san bhartrā karmaṇi duṣkare / kuryāt tadanurāgeṇa tam āhuḥ puruṣottamam

vulgate_text: mayā kālamimam prāpya dattastasya mahātmanaḥ / ityuktvā prītihṛṣṭāṅgo rāmastam pariṣsvaje
ce_text: eṣa sarvasvabhūtas tu pariṣvaṅgo hanūmataḥ / mayā kālam imaṃ prāpya dattas tasya mahātmanaḥ

vulgate_text: harīnāmīśvarasyāpi sugrīvasyopaśṛṇvataḥ / sarvathā sukṛtam tāvatsītāyāḥ parimārgaṇam
ce_text: sarvathā sukṛtaṃ tāvat sītāyāḥ parimārgaṇam / sāgaraṃ tu samāsādya punar naṣṭaṃ mano mama

vulgate_text: rāvanam pāpakrmāṇam tathā tvam kartumarhasi / seturatra yathā baddhyethā paśyema tām purīm
ce_text: setur atra yathā vadhyed yathā paśyema tāṃ purīm / tasya rākṣasarājasya tathā tvaṃ kuru rāghava

vulgate_text: hatam ca rāvaṇam uddhe darśanādavadhāraya / abaddhvā sāgare setum ghore ca varuṇālaye
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā tāṃ hi purīṃ laṅkāṃ trikūṭaśikhare sthitām / hataṃ ca rāvaṇaṃ yuddhe darśanād upadhāraya

vulgate_text: laṅkā na marditum śakyā sendrairapi surāsuraiḥ / seturbaddhaḥ samudre ca yāvallaṅkāsamīpataḥ
ce_text: setubaddhaḥ samudre ca yāval laṅkā samīpataḥ / sarvaṃ tīrṇaṃ ca vai sainyaṃ jitam ity upadhāryatām

vulgate_text: sarvam tīrṇam ca me sainyam jitamityupadhāraya / ime hi samare vīrā harayaḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ
ce_text: ime hi samare śūrā harayaḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ / tad alaṃ viklavā buddhī rājan sarvārthanāśanī

vulgate_text: yattu kāryam manuṣyeṇa śauṇḍīryamavalambyatām / tadalamkaraṇāyaiva karturbhavati satvaram
ce_text: puruṣasya hi loke 'smiñ śokaḥ śauryāpakarṣaṇaḥ / yat tu kāryaṃ manuṣyeṇa śauṇḍīryam avalambatā / śūrāṇāṃ hi manuṣyāṇāṃ tvadvidhānāṃ mahātmanām

vulgate_text: asmin kāle mahāprājñ sattvamātiṣṭha te jasā / śūrāṇām hi manuṣyāṇām tvadvidhānām mahātmanām
ce_text: puruṣasya hi loke 'smiñ śokaḥ śauryāpakarṣaṇaḥ / yat tu kāryaṃ manuṣyeṇa śauṇḍīryam avalambatā / śūrāṇāṃ hi manuṣyāṇāṃ tvadvidhānāṃ mahātmanām

vulgate_text: sahāsmābhirihoopetaḥ sūkṣmabuddhirvicāraya / laṅghite tatra taiḥ sainyairjitamityeva niścinu
ce_text: sahāsmābhir ihopetaḥ sūkṣmabuddhir vicāraya / ime hi samare śūrā harayaḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ

vulgate_text: sarvam tīrṇam ca me sainyam jitamityavadhāryatām / ime hi harayaḥ śūrāḥ samare kāmarūpiṇaḥ
ce_text: ime hi samare śūrā harayaḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ / tad alaṃ viklavā buddhī rājan sarvārthanāśanī

vulgate_text: hatamityeva tam manye yuddhe śatrunibarhaṇa / kimuktvā bahudhā cāpi sarvathā vijayā bhavān
ce_text: kim uktvā bahudhā cāpi sarvathā vijayī bhavān

vulgate_text: rākṣasāśca yathā snigdhā rāvaṇasya ca tejasā / parām samṛddhim laṃkāyāḥ sāgarasya ca bhīmatām
ce_text: parāṃ samṛddhiṃ laṅkāyāḥ sāgarasya ca bhīmatām / vibhāgaṃ ca balaughasya nirdeśaṃ vāhanasya ca

vulgate_text: vibhāgam ca bala oghasya nirdeśam vāhanasya ca / evamuktvā kapiśreṣṭhaḥ kathayāmāsa tatvavit
ce_text: parāṃ samṛddhiṃ laṅkāyāḥ sāgarasya ca bhīmatām / vibhāgaṃ ca balaughasya nirdeśaṃ vāhanasya ca

vulgate_text: balaikadeśaḥ kṣapito rākṣasānām mahātmanām / yena kena tu mārgeṇa tarāma varuṇa ālayam
ce_text: yena kena tu mārgeṇa tarāma varuṇālayam / hateti nagarī laṅkāṃ vānarair avadhāryatām

vulgate_text: jīvitānte' mṛtam spṛṣṭvā pītvā viṣamivāturaḥ / uttarā phalgunī hi adya śvas tu hastena yokṣyate
ce_text: uttarā phalgunī hy adya śvas tu hastena yokṣyate / abhiprayāma sugrīva sarvānīkasamāvṛtāḥ

vulgate_text: vijayam samanuprāptam śamsati iva mano ratham / tato vābararāheba kajśmaṇena supūjitaḥ
ce_text: upariṣṭād dhi nayanaṃ sphuramāṇam idaṃ mama / vijayaṃ samanuprāptaṃ śaṃsatīva manoratham

vulgate_text: uvāca rāmo dharmātmā punarapyarthakovidaḥ / agre yātu balasya asya nīlo mārgam avekṣitum
ce_text: agre yātu balasyāsya nīlo mārgam avekṣitum / vṛtaḥ śatasahasreṇa vānarāṇāṃ tarasvinām

vulgate_text: abhiplutya abhipaśyeyuḥ pareṣām nihatam balam / yattu phalgu balam kimcittadatraivopapadyatām
ce_text: nimneṣu vanadurgeṣu vaneṣu ca vanaukasaḥ / abhiplutyābhipaśyeyuḥ pareṣāṃ nihataṃ balam

vulgate_text: etaddhi kṛtyam ghoram no vikrameṇa prayujyatām / sāgara ogha nibham bhīmam agra anīkam mahābalāḥ
ce_text: sāgaraughanibhaṃ bhīmam agrānīkaṃ mahābalāḥ / kapisiṃhā prakarṣantu śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ

vulgate_text: madhyena ca samantācca vanāni phalavanti ca / samāvṛtya mahīm kṛtsnām jagāma mahatī camūḥ
ce_text: athāvṛtya mahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ jagāma mahatī camūḥ / ṛkṣavānaraśārdūlair nakhadaṃṣṭrāyudhair vṛtā

vulgate_text: tataḥ śatasahasraiśca koṭibhiśca sahasraśaḥ / vānarāṇām sughorāṇām śrīmatparivṛtā mahī
ce_text: śataiḥ śatasahasraiś ca koṭībhir ayutair api / vāraṇābhiś ca haribhir yayau parivṛtas tadā

vulgate_text: aśokāmśca karañjāmśca plakṣanygrodhapādapān / jambūkāmalakānnāgān bhajanti sma plavaṅgamāḥ
ce_text: campakāṃs tilakāṃś cūtān aśokān sinduvārakān / karavīrāṃś ca timiśān bhañjanti sma plavaṃgamāḥ

vulgate_text: sarvāḥ senā niveśyantām velāyām haripuṅgava / samprāpto mantra kālo naḥ sāgarasya iha langhane
ce_text: saṃprāpto mantrakālo naḥ sāgarasyeha laṅghane / svāṃ svāṃ senāṃ samutsṛjya mā ca kaś cit kuto vrajet / gacchantu vānarāḥ śūrā jñeyaṃ channaṃ bhayaṃ ca naḥ

vulgate_text: sā mahāarṇavam āsādya hṛṣṭā vānara vāhinī / tridhā niviṣṭā mahatī rāmasyārthaparābhavat
ce_text: sā mahārṇavam āsādya hṛṣṭā vānaravāhinī / vāyuvegasamādhūtaṃ paśyamānā mahārṇavam

vulgate_text: caṇḍa nakra graham ghoram kṣapā ādau divasa kṣaye / hasantamiva phenaughairnṛtyantamiva cormibhiḥ
ce_text: caṇḍanakragrahaṃ ghoraṃ kṣapādau divasakṣaye / candrodaye samādhūtaṃ praticandrasamākulam

vulgate_text: anila uddhūtam ākāśe pravalgatam iva ūrmibhiḥ / tato vismayāmāpannā harayo dadṛśuḥ sthitāḥ
ce_text: dadṛśus te mahātmāno vātāhatajalāśayam / aniloddhūtam ākāśe pravalgatam ivormibhiḥ / bhrāntormijalasaṃnādaṃ pralolam iva sāgaram

vulgate_text: kadā vikṣobhya rakṣāmsi sā vidhūya utpatiṣyati / rākṣasīmadhyagā śete snuṣā daśarathasya ca
ce_text: kadā vikṣobhya rakṣāṃsi sā vidhūyotpatiṣyati / vidhūya jaladān nīlāñ śaśilekhā śaratsv iva

vulgate_text: tarasā yukta rūpeṇa sānujaḥ sabala anugaḥ / samudramucchoṣayati vīryeṇānyatkaroti vā
ce_text: tariṣyati ca suvyaktaṃ rāghavaḥ sāgaraṃ sukham / tarasā yuktarūpeṇa sānujaḥ sabalānugaḥ

vulgate_text: dviṣtpakṣhmavijñāya nītibāhyāstvabuddhayaḥ / rājan parigha śakti ṛṣṭi śūla paṭṭasa samkulam
ce_text: rājan parighaśaktyṛṣṭiśūlapaṭṭasasaṃkulam / sumahan no balaṃ kasmād viṣādaṃ bhajate bhavān

vulgate_text: sumahan no balam kasmād viṣādam bhajate bhavān / tvayā bhogavatīm gatvā nirjatāḥ pannagā yudhi
ce_text: rājan parighaśaktyṛṣṭiśūlapaṭṭasasaṃkulam / sumahan no balaṃ kasmād viṣādaṃ bhajate bhavān

vulgate_text: mṛtyu daṇḍa mahāgrāham śālmali dvīpa maṇḍitam / kālapāśamahāīcim yamakimkarapannagam
ce_text: mṛtyudaṇḍamahāgrāhaṃ śālmalidvīpamaṇḍitam / avagāhya tvayā rājan yamasya balasāgaram

vulgate_text: mahājvareṇa durdharṣam yamalokamahārṇavam / avagāhya tvayā rājan yamasya bala sāgaram
ce_text: mṛtyudaṇḍamahāgrāhaṃ śālmalidvīpamaṇḍitam / avagāhya tvayā rājan yamasya balasāgaram

vulgate_text: sugrīvam sahanūmantam sarvāmścaivātra vānarān / tato vajrahanurnāma rākṣasaḥ parvatopamaḥ
ce_text: tato vajrahanur nāma rākṣasaḥ parvatopamaḥ / kruddhaḥ parilihan vaktraṃ jihvayā vākyam abravīt

vulgate_text: tasya kāmaparītasya niśamya paridevitam / kumbhakarṇaḥ pracukrodha vacanam cedamabravīt
ce_text: tasya rākṣasarājasya niśamya paridevitam / kumbhakarṇo babhāṣe 'tha vacanaṃ prajahāsa ca

vulgate_text: anupāyena karmāṇi viparītāni yāni ca / kriyamāṇāni duṣyanti havīmṣyaprayateṣvina
ce_text: deśakālavihīnāni karmāṇi viparītavat / kriyamāṇāni duṣyanti havīṃṣy aprayateṣv iva

vulgate_text: yaḥ paścātpūrvakāryāṇi karmāṇyabhicikīrṣati / pūrvam cāparakaryāṇi na sa veda nayānayau
ce_text: yaḥ paścāt pūrvakāryāṇi kuryād aiśvaryam āsthitaḥ / pūrvaṃ cottarakāryāṇi na sa veda nayānayau

vulgate_text: capalasya tu kṛtyeṣu prasamīksyādhikam balam / cidramanye prapadyante krauñcasya khamiva dvijāḥ
ce_text: capalasyeha kṛtyāni sahasānupradhāvataḥ / chidram anye prapadyante krauñcasya kham iva dvijāḥ

vulgate_text: ahamutsādayiṣyāmi śatrūmstava niśācara / yadi śakravivasvantau yadi pāvakamārutau
ce_text: na paraḥ preṣaṇīyas te yuddhāyātula vikrama / aham utsādayiṣyāmi śatrūṃs tava mahābala

vulgate_text: tāvaham yodhayiṣyāmi kuberavaruṇāvapi / girimātraśarīrasya mahāparighayodhinaḥ
ce_text: yadi śakro yadi yamo yadi pāvakamārutau / tān ahaṃ yodhayiṣyāmi kubera varuṇāv api

vulgate_text: nardatastīkṣṇadamṣṭrasya bibhīyādvai purandaraḥ / punarmām sadvitīyena śareṇa nihaniṣyati
ce_text: girimātraśarīrasya śitaśūladharasya me / nardatas tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrasya bibhīyāc ca puraṃdaraḥ

vulgate_text: tato'ham tasya pāsyāmi rudhiram kāmamāśvasa / vadheva vai dāśaratheḥ sukhāvaham / jayam tavāhartumaham tayiṣye / hatvā ca rāmam saha lakṣmaṇena / khādāmi sarvān hariyūthamukhyān
ce_text: vadhena te dāśaratheḥ sukhāvahaṃ sukhaṃ samāhartum ahaṃ vrajāmi / nihatya rāmaṃ sahalakṣmaṇena khādāmi sarvān hariyūthamukhyān

vulgate_text: sa tvam bhrātā asi me rājan brūhi mām yad yad iccasi / jyeṣṭho mānyaḥ pitṛsamo na ca dharmapathe sthitaḥ
ce_text: sa tvaṃ bhrātāsi me rājan brūhi māṃ yad yad icchasi / idaṃ tu paruṣaṃ vākyaṃ na kṣamāmy anṛtaṃ tava

vulgate_text: idam tu paruṣam vākyam na kṣamāmi anṛtam tava / sunītam hita kāmena vākyam uktam daśa ānana
ce_text: sunītaṃ hitakāmena vākyam uktaṃ daśānana / na gṛhṇanty akṛtātmānaḥ kālasya vaśam āgatāḥ

vulgate_text: kāla abhipannā sīdanti yathā vāluka setavaḥ / tanarṣayatu yaccoktam gurutvāddhitamiccatā
ce_text: śūrāś ca balavantaś ca kṛtāstrāś ca raṇājire / kālābhipannā sīdanti yathā vālukasetavaḥ

vulgate_text: rāghavena abhaye datte samnato rāvaṇa anujaḥ / vibhīṣaṇo mahāprājño bhūmim samavalokayat
ce_text: rāghaveṇābhaye datte saṃnato rāvaṇānujaḥ / khāt papātāvaniṃ hṛṣṭo bhaktair anucaraiḥ saha

vulgate_text: bhavad gatam hi me rājyam ca jīvitam ca sukhāni ca / tasya tadvacanam śrutvā rāmo vacanamabravīt
ce_text: parityaktā mayā laṅkā mitrāṇi ca dhanāni ca / bhavadgataṃ me rājyaṃ ca jīvitaṃ ca sukhāni ca

vulgate_text: sainyaiḥ parivṛtāḥ sarve vānarāṇām mahaujasām / upāyair abhigaccāmo yathā nada nadī patim
ce_text: upāyair abhigacchāmo yathā nadanadīpatim / tarāma tarasā sarve sasainyā varuṇālayam

vulgate_text: sugrīvo vipulagrīvaḥ sāgarasyopaveśanam / prakṛtyā dharma śīlasya rāghavasya api arocata
ce_text: evaṃ vibhīṣaṇenokte rākṣasena vipaścitā / prakṛtyā dharmaśīlasya rāghavasyāpy arocata

vulgate_text: alam kāla atyayam kṛtvā samudro ayam niyujyatām / yathā kālātyayam kṛtvā sāgarāya niyujyatām
ce_text: vibhīṣaṇasya śūrasya yathārthaṃ kriyatāṃ vacaḥ / alaṃ kālātyayaṃ kṛtvā samudro 'yaṃ niyujyatām

vulgate_text: kathaṃ sāgaramakṣobhyaṃ tarāma varuṇālayam / sainyaiḥ parivṛtāḥ sarve vānarāṇāṃ mahaujasām
ce_text: abravīc ca hanūmāṃś ca sugrīvaś ca vibhīṣaṇam / kathaṃ sāgaram akṣobhyaṃ tarāma varuṇālayam

vulgate_text: evaṃ vibhīṣaṇenokto rākṣasena vipaścitā / ājagāmātha sugrīvo yatra rāmaḥ salakṣmaṇaḥ
ce_text: evaṃ vibhīṣaṇenokte rākṣasena vipaścitā / prakṛtyā dharmaśīlasya rāghavasyāpy arocata

vulgate_text: asamartham vijānāti dhik kṣamām īdṛśe jane / sa darśayati sāmnā me sāgaro rūpamātmanaḥ
ce_text: kṣamayā hi samāyuktaṃ mām ayaṃ makarālayaḥ / asamarthaṃ vijānāti dhik kṣamām īdṛśe jane

vulgate_text: cāpam ānaya saumitre śarāmaḥ ca āśī viṣa upamān / samudram śoṣayiṣyāmi padbhyām yāntu plavaṅgamāḥ
ce_text: cāpam ānaya saumitre śarāṃś cāśīviṣopamān / adyākṣobhyam api kruddhaḥ kṣobhayiṣyāmi sāgaram

vulgate_text: nirmaryādam kariṣyāmi sāyakair varuṇa ālayam / mahārṇavam kṣohayiṣye mahādānavasamkulam
ce_text: velāsu kṛtamaryādaṃ sahasormisamākulam / nirmaryādaṃ kariṣyāmi sāyakair varuṇālayam

vulgate_text: ratna mālya ambara dharaḥ padma patra nibha īkṣaṇaḥ / sarvapuṣpamayīm divyām śirasā dhārayan srajam
ce_text: snigdhavaidūryasaṃkāśo jāmbūnadavibhūṣitaḥ / raktamālyāmbaradharaḥ padmapatranibhekṣaṇaḥ

vulgate_text: vidhāsye yena gantāsi viṣahiṣye hyaham tathā / na grāhā vidhamiṣyanti yāvatsenā tariṣyati
ce_text: vidhāsye rāma yenāpi viṣahiṣye hy ahaṃ tathā / grāhā na prahariṣyanti yāvat senā tariṣyati

vulgate_text: aurasastasya putro'ham sadṛśo viśvakarmaṇā / smārito'smyahametena tattvamāha mahodadhiḥ
ce_text: mama mātur varo datto mandare viśvakarmaṇā / aurasas tasya putro 'haṃ sadṛśo viśvakarmaṇā

vulgate_text: na ca api aham anukto vai prabrūyām ātmano guṇān / samarthścāpyaham setum kartum vai varuṇālaye
ce_text: na cāpy aham anukto vai prabrūyām ātmano guṇān / kāmam adyaiva badhnantu setuṃ vānarapuṃgavāḥ

vulgate_text: indra ketūn iva udyamya prajahrur harayas tarūn / tālān dāḍimagulmāmśca nārikelavibhītakān
ce_text: samūlāṃś ca vimūlāṃś ca pādapān harisattamāḥ / indraketūn ivodyamya prajahrur harayas tarūn

vulgate_text: parvatāmśca samutpāṭya yantraiḥ parivahanti ca / prakṣipyamāṇair acalaiḥ sahasā jalam uddhatam
ce_text: prakṣipyamāṇair acalaiḥ sahasā jalam uddhatam / samutpatitam ākāśam apāsarpat tatas tataḥ

vulgate_text: samutpatitam ākāśam apāsarpat tatas tataḥ / samudram kṣobhayāmāsurnipatantaḥ samantataḥ
ce_text: prakṣipyamāṇair acalaiḥ sahasā jalam uddhatam / samutpatitam ākāśam apāsarpat tatas tataḥ

vulgate_text: sūtrāṇyanye pragṛhṇanti hyāyatam śatayojanam / nalaḥ cakre mahāsetum madhye nada nadī pateḥ
ce_text: daśayojanavistīrṇaṃ śatayojanam āyatam / nalaś cakre mahāsetuṃ madhye nadanadīpateḥ

vulgate_text: dṛśyante paridhāvanto gṛhya dānavasamnibhāḥ / śilānām kṣipyamāṇānām śailānām tatra pātyatām
ce_text: śilānāṃ kṣipyamāṇānāṃ śailānāṃ tatra pātyatām / babhūva tumulaḥ śabdas tadā tasmin mahodadhau

vulgate_text: babhūva tumulaḥ śabdas tadā tasmin mahāudadhau / kṛtāni prathamenāhnā yojanāni caturdaśa
ce_text: śilānāṃ kṣipyamāṇānāṃ śailānāṃ tatra pātyatām / babhūva tumulaḥ śabdas tadā tasmin mahodadhau

vulgate_text: babandha sāgare setum yathā cāsya tathā pitā / sa nalena kṛtaḥ setuḥ sāgare makara ālaye
ce_text: sa nalena kṛtaḥ setuḥ sāgare makarālaye / śuśubhe subhagaḥ śrīmān svātīpatha ivāmbare

vulgate_text: āgamya gagane tasthurdraṣṭukāmāstadadbhutam / daśayojanavistīrṇam śatayojana māyatam
ce_text: daśayojanavistīrṇaṃ śatayojanam āyatam / nalaś cakre mahāsetuṃ madhye nadanadīpateḥ

vulgate_text: dadṛśurdevagandharvā nalasetum suduṣkaram / āplavantaḥ plavantaḥ ca garjantaḥ ca plavam gamāḥ
ce_text: āplavantaḥ plavantaś ca garjantaś ca plavaṃgamāḥ / tam acintyam asahyaṃ ca adbhutaṃ lomaharṣaṇam / dadṛśuḥ sarvabhūtāni sāgare setubandhanam

vulgate_text: nimittāni nimittajño dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇapūrvajaḥ / saumitrim sampariṣvajya idam vacanambravīt
ce_text: atha tasmin nimittāni dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇapūrvajaḥ / lakṣmaṇaṃ lakṣmisaṃpannam idaṃ vacanam abravīt

vulgate_text: dīnā dīnasvarāḥ krūrāḥ sarvato mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ / pratyādityam vinardanti janayanto mahadbhayam
ce_text: ādityam abhivāśyante janayanto mahad bhayam / dīnā dīnasvarā ghorā apraśastā mṛgadvijāḥ

vulgate_text: rajasā mahatā cāpi nakṣatrāṇi hatāni ca / yugāntamiva lokānām paśya śasanti lakṣmaṇa
ce_text: dṛśyante na yathāvac ca nakṣatrāṇy abhivartate / yugāntam iva lokasya paśya lakṣmaṇa śaṃsati

vulgate_text: kākāḥ śyenāstathā nīcā gṛdhrāḥ paripatanti ca / śivāścāpyaśubhānnādānnadanti sumahābhayān
ce_text: kākāḥ śyenās tathā gṛdhrā nīcaiḥ paripatanti ca / śivāś cāpy aśivā vācaḥ pravadanti mahāsvanāḥ

vulgate_text: na te sambhāṣitum śakyāḥ sampraśno'tra na vidyate / prakṛtyā kopanāstīkṣiṇā vānarā rākṣasādhipa
ce_text: nāpi saṃbhāṣituṃ śakyāḥ saṃpraśno 'tra na labhyate / sarvato rakṣyate panthā vānaraiḥ parvatopamaiḥ

vulgate_text: tadbalārṇavamakṣobhyaṃdadṛśāteniśācarau / taudadarśamahātejāḥpraticchannaucavibhīṣaṇaḥ / ācacakṣe'tharāmāyagṛhītvāśukasāraṇau
ce_text: tau dadarśa mahātejāḥ pracchannau ca vibhīṣaṇaḥ / ācacakṣe 'tha rāmāya gṛhītvā śukasāraṇau / laṅkāyāḥ samanuprāptau cārau parapuraṃjayau

vulgate_text: tasyaimaurākṣasendrasyamantriṇauśukasāraṇau / laṅkāyassamanuprāptaucārauparapurañjayaḥ
ce_text: tau dadarśa mahātejāḥ pracchannau ca vibhīṣaṇaḥ / ācacakṣe 'tha rāmāya gṛhītvā śukasāraṇau / laṅkāyāḥ samanuprāptau cārau parapuraṃjayau

vulgate_text: krodhaṃbhīmamahaṃmokṣyesasainyetvayirāvaṇaḥ / śvaḥkālyevajravānvajraṃdānaveṣvivavāsavaḥ
ce_text: ghoraṃ roṣam ahaṃ mokṣye balaṃ dhāraya rāvaṇa / śvaḥkāle vajravān vajraṃ dānaveṣv iva vāsavaḥ

vulgate_text: jayetipratinandyaitaurāghavaṃdharmavatsalam / āgamyanagarīṃlaṅkāmabrūtāṃrākṣasādhipam
ce_text: iti pratisamādiṣṭau rākṣasau śukasāraṇau / āgamya nagarīṃ laṅkām abrūtāṃ rākṣasādhipam

vulgate_text: śatam śata sahasrāṇām trimśac ca hari yūthapāḥ / yam yāntam vānarā ghorāścaṇḍāścaṇḍparākramāḥ
ce_text: śataṃ śatasahasrāṇāṃ triṃśac ca hariyūthapāḥ / parivāryānugacchanti laṅkāṃ marditum ojasā

vulgate_text: na ca samvijate mṛtyor na ca yūthād vidhāvati / prakampate ca roṣena tiryakca punarīkṣate
ce_text: yas tu karṇau vivṛṇute jṛmbhate ca punaḥ punaḥ / na ca saṃvijate mṛtyor na ca yūthād vidhāvati

vulgate_text: paśyan lāṅgūlamapi ca ksveḍatyeṣa mahābalaḥ / mahābalo vīta bhayo ramyam sālveya parvatam
ce_text: mahābalo vītabhayo ramyaṃ sālveya parvatam / rājan satatam adhyāste śarabho nāma yūthapaḥ

vulgate_text: tvām āhvayati yuddhāya krathano nāma yūthapaḥ / vikrāntā balavantaśca yathā yūthāni bhāgaśaḥ
ce_text: ṣaṣṭiḥ śatasahasrāṇi balam asya plavaṃgamāḥ / tvām āhvayati yuddhāya krathano nāma yūthapaḥ

vulgate_text: yas tu gairika varṇa ābham vapuḥ puṣyati vānaraḥ / avamatya sadā sarvānvānarān baladarpitaḥ
ce_text: yas tu gairikavarṇābhaṃ vapuḥ puṣyati vānaraḥ / gavayo nāma tejasvī tvāṃ krodhād abhivartate

vulgate_text: yūthapā harirājasya kimkarāḥ samupasthitāḥ / nīlān iva mahāmeghāms tiṣṭhato yāms tu paśyasi
ce_text: nīlān iva mahāmeghāṃs tiṣṭhato yāṃs tu paśyasi / asitāñ janasaṃkāśān yuddhe satyaparākramān

vulgate_text: eṣa yūthapatirnetā garjan giriguhāśayaḥ / gajān rodhayate vanyānārujamśca mahīruhān
ce_text: eṣa yūthapatir netā gacchan giriguhāśayaḥ / harīṇāṃ vāhinī mukhyo nadīṃ haimavatīm anu

vulgate_text: yasya prastham mahātmāno na tyajanti maharṣayaḥ / sarvakāmaphalā vṛkṣāḥ sarve phalasamanvitāḥ
ce_text: yasya bhāsā sadā bhānti tadvarṇā mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ / yasya prasthaṃ mahātmāno na tyajanti maharṣayaḥ

vulgate_text: madhūni ca mahārhāṇi yasmin parvatasattame / tatra eṣa ramate rājan ramye kāncana parvate
ce_text: tatraiṣa ramate rājan ramye kāñcanaparvate / mukhyo vānaramukhyānāṃ kesarī nāma yūthapaḥ

vulgate_text: mahāparvata samkāśā mahājīmūta nisvanāḥ / vṛttapiṅgalanetrā hi mahābhīmagatisvanāḥ
ce_text: sudīrghāñcitalāṅgūlā mattamātaṃgasaṃnibhāḥ / mahāparvatasaṃkāśā mahājīmūtanisvanāḥ

vulgate_text: mardayantīva te sarve tasthurlaṅkām samīkṣya te / eṣa caiṣāmadhipatirmadhye tiṣṭhati vīryavān
ce_text: eṣa caiṣām adhipatir madhye tiṣṭhati vīryavān / nāmnā pṛthivyāṃ vikhyāto rājañ śatabalīti yaḥ / eṣaivāśaṃsate laṅkāṃ svenānīkena marditum

vulgate_text: jayārthī nityamādityamupatiṣṭhati buddhimān / nāmnā pṛthivyām vikhyāto rājan śata balī iti yaḥ
ce_text: eṣa caiṣām adhipatir madhye tiṣṭhati vīryavān / nāmnā pṛthivyāṃ vikhyāto rājañ śatabalīti yaḥ / eṣaivāśaṃsate laṅkāṃ svenānīkena marditum

vulgate_text: eṣa eva āśamsate laṃkām svena anīkena marditum / vikrānto balavān śūraḥ pauruṣe sve vyavasthitaḥ
ce_text: ya enam anugacchanti vīrāś candanavāsinaḥ / eṣa āśaṃsate laṅkāṃ svenānīkena marditum

vulgate_text: rāmapriyārtham prāṇānām dayām na kurute hariḥ / gajo gava akṣo gavayo nalo nīlaḥ ca vānaraḥ / eka eka eva yūthānām koṭibhir daśabhir vṛtaḥ
ce_text: gajo gavākṣo gavayo nalo nīlaś ca vānaraḥ / ekaika eva yūthānāṃ koṭibhir daśabhir vṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: eṣa āśamsate laṃkām eko marditum ojasā / yeva jājvalyate'sau vai dhūmaketustavādya vai
ce_text: eṣa āśaṃsate laṅkām eko marditum ojasā / yaś caiṣo 'nantaraḥ śūraḥ śyāmaḥ padmanibhekṣaṇaḥ

vulgate_text: laṃkāyām nihitaścāpi katham vismarase kasim / yaḥ ca eṣo anantaraḥ śūraḥ śyāmaḥ padma nibha īkṣaṇaḥ
ce_text: eṣa āśaṃsate laṅkām eko marditum ojasā / yaś caiṣo 'nantaraḥ śūraḥ śyāmaḥ padmanibhekṣaṇaḥ

vulgate_text: yasya mṛtyor iva krodhaḥ śakrasya iva parākramaḥ / yasya bhāryā jansthānātsītā cāpi hṛtā tvayā
ce_text: yasya mṛtyor iva krodhaḥ śakrasyeva parākramaḥ / sa eṣa rāmas tvāṃ yoddhuṃ rājan samabhivartate

vulgate_text: sugrīvo vālinam hatvā rāmeṇa pratipāditaḥ / śatam śatasahasrāṇām koṭimāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ
ce_text: etāṃ ca mālāṃ tārāṃ ca kapirājyaṃ ca śāśvatam / sugrīvo vālinaṃ hatvā rāmeṇa pratipāditaḥ

vulgate_text: śatamoghasahasrāṇām mahaugha iti viśrutaḥ / evam koṭi sahasreṇa śankūnām ca śatena ca
ce_text: evaṃ koṭisahasreṇa śaṅkūnāṃ ca śatena ca / sugrīvo vānarendras tvāṃ yuddhārtham abhivartate

vulgate_text: sugrīvo vānara indras tvām yuddha artham abhivartate / mahābalavṛto nityam mahābalaparākramaḥ
ce_text: evaṃ koṭisahasreṇa śaṅkūnāṃ ca śatena ca / sugrīvo vānarendras tvāṃ yuddhārtham abhivartate

vulgate_text: upasthāpaya śīghram me cārān nīti viśāradān / mahodarastathoktastu śīghramājñāpayaccarān
ce_text: abravīt sa daśagrīvaḥ samīpasthaṃ mahodaram / upasthāpaya śīghraṃ me cārān nītiviśāradān

vulgate_text: praccannā dadṛśur gatvā sasugrīva vibhīṣaṇau / prekṣamāṇāścamūm tām ca babhūvurbhayavihvalāḥ
ce_text: te suvelasya śailasya samīpe rāmalakṣmaṇau / pracchannā dadṛśur gatvā sasugrīvavibhīṣaṇau

vulgate_text: anṛśamsena rāmeṇa mokṣitā rākṣasāḥ sare / vānarair arditās te tu vikrāntair laghu vikramaiḥ
ce_text: vānarair arditās te tu vikrāntair laghuvikramaiḥ / punar laṅkām anuprāptāḥ śvasanto naṣṭacetasaḥ

vulgate_text: niśśvasantaurudantaucarudhireṇasamukṣitau / asināvyāyatauchinnaumadhyehyariniṣūdanau
ce_text: maindaś ca dvividaś cobhau nihatau vānararṣabhau / niḥśvasantau rudantau ca rudhireṇa samukṣitau

vulgate_text: amātyaiḥ sa hitaḥ sarvaiḥ prahastastvāmupasthitaḥ / tena darśanakāmena aham prasthāpitaḥ prabho
ce_text: amātyaiḥ sahitaḥ sarvaiḥ prahastaḥ samupasthitaḥ / kiṃ cid ātyayikaṃ kāryaṃ teṣāṃ tvaṃ darśanaṃ kuru

vulgate_text: mānamasti mahārā ja rājabhāvāt kṣamānvita / kiṃcid ātyayikam kāryam teṣām tvam darśanam kuru
ce_text: amātyaiḥ sahitaḥ sarvaiḥ prahastaḥ samupasthitaḥ / kiṃ cid ātyayikaṃ kāryaṃ teṣāṃ tvaṃ darśanaṃ kuru

vulgate_text: ratha vāji gajānām ca bhūṣitānām ca rakṣasām / sambhramo rakṣasāmeṣa hṛṣitānām tarasvinām
ce_text: śāstrāṇāṃ ca prasannānāṃ carmaṇāṃ varmaṇāṃ tathā / rathavājigajānāṃ ca bhūṣitānāṃ ca rakṣasām

vulgate_text: atha tām jāta samtāpām tena vākyena moditām / saramā hlādayām āsa mahīṃ dagdhāmivāmbhasā
ce_text: atha tāṃ jātasaṃtāpāṃ tena vākyena mohitām / saramā hlādayām āsa pṛtivīṃ dyaur ivāmbhasā

vulgate_text: jagatpamtāpanaḥ krūrogarhayan rākṣaseśvaraḥ / taraṇam sāgarasya api vikramam bala samcayam
ce_text: taraṇaṃ sāgarasyāpi vikramaṃ balasaṃcayam / yad uktavanto rāmasya bhavantas tan mayā śrutam / bhavataś cāpy ahaṃ vedmi yuddhe satyaparākramān

vulgate_text: tūṣṇīkānīkṣatonyonyam viditvām rāmavikramam / tatas tu sumahā prājno mālyavān nāma rākṣasaḥ
ce_text: tatas tu sumahāprājño mālyavān nāma rākṣasaḥ / rāvaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā mātuḥ paitāmaho 'bravīt

vulgate_text: caryamāṇam tapas tīvram samtāpayati rākṣasān / devadānavayakṣebho gṛhītaśca varastvayā
ce_text: teṣu teṣu ca deśeṣu puṇyeṣu ca dṛḍhavrataiḥ / caryamāṇaṃ tapas tīvraṃ saṃtāpayati rākṣasān

vulgate_text: pakṣiṇaśca mṛgāḥ sarve pratyādityam rudanti te / karālo vikaṭo muṇḍaḥ puruṣaḥ kṛṣṇa pingalaḥ
ce_text: karālo vikaṭo muṇḍaḥ puruṣaḥ kṛṣṇapiṅgalaḥ / kālo gṛhāṇi sarveṣāṃ kāle kāle 'nvavekṣate / etāny anyāni duṣṭāni nimittāny utpatanti ca

vulgate_text: laṅkāyām sacivaiḥ rāmāya pratyavedayat / rāmaṃ kamalapatrākṣamidamuttaramabravīt
ce_text: etāṃ pravṛttiṃ laṅkāyāṃ mantriproktaṃ vibhīṣaṇaḥ / rāmaṃ kamalapatrākṣam idam uttaram abravīt

vulgate_text: rāvaṇāvarajaḥ śrīmān rāmapriyacikīrṣayā / kuberam tu yadā rāma rāvaṇaḥ pratyayudhyata
ce_text: kuberaṃ tu yadā rāma rāvaṇaḥ pratyayudhyata / ṣaṣṭiḥ śatasahasrāṇi tadā niryānti rākṣasāḥ

vulgate_text: suvela ārohaṇe buddhim cakāra matimān matim / ramaṇīyataram dṛṣṭvā suvelasya girestaṭm
ce_text: sa rāmaḥ kāryasiddhyartham evam uktvā vibhīṣaṇam / suvelārohaṇe buddhiṃ cakāra matimān matim

vulgate_text: suvelam sādhu jaila indram imam dhātu jataij citam / adhyārohāmahe sarve vatsyāmo atra nijām imām
ce_text: suvelaṃ sādhu śailendram imaṃ dhātuśataiś citam / adhyārohāmahe sarve vatsyāmo 'tra niśām imām

vulgate_text: eko hi kurute pāpam kāla pāja vajam gataḥ / nīcena ātma apacāreṇa kulam tena vinajyati
ce_text: eko hi kurute pāpaṃ kālapāśavaśaṃ gataḥ / nīcenātmāpacāreṇa kulaṃ tena vinaśyati

vulgate_text: dadṛjuḥ jikhare tasya viṣaktām iva khe purīm / tām jubhām pravata dvārām prākāra vara jobhitām
ce_text: te tv adīrgheṇa kālena girim āruhya sarvataḥ / dadṛśuḥ śikhare tasya viṣaktām iva khe purīm

vulgate_text: kurvantas te mahā vegā mahīm cāraṇa pīḍitām / ajaś ca sahasā eva ūrdhvam jagāma caraṇa uddhatam
ce_text: kurvantas te mahāvegā mahīṃ cāraṇapīḍitām / rajaś ca sahasaivordhvaṃ jagāma caraṇoddhatam

vulgate_text: atha tasminnimittāni dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇapūrvajaḥ / sugrīvaṃ sampariṣvajya tadā vacanamabravīt
ce_text: atha tasmin nimittāni dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇapūrvajaḥ / lakṣmaṇaṃ lakṣmisaṃpannam idaṃ vacanam abravīt

vulgate_text: ityevaṃ vādinaṃ vīramabhinandya sa rāghavaḥ / lakṣmaṇaṃ lakṣmisampannamidaṃ vacanamabravīt
ce_text: atha tasmin nimittāni dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇapūrvajaḥ / lakṣmaṇaṃ lakṣmisaṃpannam idaṃ vacanam abravīt

vulgate_text: tataḥ prāsādaśikharaṃ śailaśṛṅgamivonnatam / dadarśa rākṣasendrasya vāliputraḥ pratāpavān
ce_text: tataḥ prāsādaśikharaṃ śailaśṛṅgam ivonnatam / tat paphāla tadākrāntaṃ daśagrīvasya paśyataḥ

vulgate_text: tatpaphāla padākrāntaṃ daśagrīvasya paśyataḥ / purā himavataḥ śṛṅgaṃ vajriṇeva vidāritam
ce_text: tataḥ prāsādaśikharaṃ śailaśṛṅgam ivonnatam / tat paphāla tadākrāntaṃ daśagrīvasya paśyataḥ

vulgate_text: nalaḥ pratapanasyāśu pātayāmāsa cakṣuṣī / bhinnagātraḥ śaraistīkṣṇaiḥ kṣiprahastena rakṣasā
ce_text: bhinnagātraḥ śarais tīkṣṇaiḥ kṣiprahastena rakṣasā / prajaghānādriśṛṅgeṇa tapanaṃ muṣṭinā gajaḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ salilamādāya vidyayā parijapya ca / sugrīvanetre dharmātmā sa mamārja vibhīṣaṇaḥ
ce_text: evam uktvā tatas tasya jalaklinnena pāṇinā / sugrīvasya śubhe netre pramamārja vibhīṣaṇaḥ

vulgate_text: pṛcchate ca yathāvṛttaṃ pitre sarvaṃ nyavedayat / yathā tau śarabandhena niśceṣṭau niṣprabhau kṛtau
ce_text: upāghrāya sa mūrdhny enaṃ papraccha prītamānasaḥ / pṛcchate ca yathāvṛttaṃ pitre sarvaṃ nyavedayat

vulgate_text: tataḥ puṣpakamāropya sītāṃ trijaṭayā saha / jagmurdarśayituṃ tasyai rākṣasyo rāmalakṣmaṇau
ce_text: tataḥ puṣpakam āropya sītāṃ trijaṭayā saha / rāvaṇo 'kārayal laṅkāṃ patākādhvajamālinīm

vulgate_text: tau dṛṣṭvā bhrātarau tatra vīrau sā puruṣarṣabhau / śayānau puṇḍarīkākṣau kumārāviva pāvakī
ce_text: tau dṛṣṭvā bhrātarau tatra vīrau sā puruṣarṣabhau / duḥkhārtā subhṛśaṃ sītā karuṇaṃ vilalāpa ha

vulgate_text: śaratalpagatau vīrau tathābhūtau nararṣabhau / duḥkhārtā subhṛśaṃ sītā suciraṃ vilalāpa ha
ce_text: tau dṛṣṭvā bhrātarau tatra vīrau sā puruṣarṣabhau / duḥkhārtā subhṛśaṃ sītā karuṇaṃ vilalāpa ha

vulgate_text: na śocāmi tathā rāmaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ ca mahābalam / nātmānaṃ jananīṃ vāpi yathā śvaśrūṃ tapasvinīm
ce_text: nāhaṃ śocāmi bhartāraṃ nihataṃ na ca lakṣmaṇam / nātmānaṃ jananī cāpi yathā śvaśrūṃ tapasvinīm

vulgate_text: ākāśādvighanāttīvrā ulkāścābhyapataṃstadā / vamantyaḥ pāvakajvālāḥ śivā ghoraṃ vavāśire
ce_text: vamantyaḥ pāvakajvālāḥ śivā ghorā vavāśire

vulgate_text: rākṣasān bhayavitrastān hanyamānān plavaṅgamaiḥ / dṛṣṭvā sa roṣatāmrākṣo vajradaṃṣṭraḥ pratāpavān
ce_text: sa tūtpātāṃs tato dṛṣṭvā rākṣasānāṃ bhayāvahān / prādurbhūtān sughorāṃś ca dhūmrākṣo vyathito 'bhavat

vulgate_text: praviveśa dhanuṣpāṇistrāsayan harivāhinīm / śarairvidārayāmāsa kaṅkapatrairajihmagaiḥ
ce_text: rākṣasāś cāpi saṃkruddhā vānarān niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ / vivyadhur ghorasaṃkāśaiḥ kaṅkapatrair ajihmagaiḥ

vulgate_text: samāpatantaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā rathādāplutya vīryavān / gadāpāṇirasambhrāntaḥ pṛthivyāṃ samatiṣṭhata
ce_text: āpatantīṃ śilāṃ dṛṣṭvā gadām udyamya saṃbhramāt / rathād āplutya vegena vasudhāyāṃ vyatiṣṭhata

vulgate_text: vajradaṃṣṭraṃ hataṃ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasā bhayamohitāḥ / trastāḥ pratyapatan laṅkāṃ vadhyamānāḥ plavaṅgamai / viṣaṇṇavadanā dīnā hriyā kiñcidavāṅmukhāḥ
ce_text: dhūmrākṣaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā hataśeṣā niśācarāḥ / trastāḥ praviviśur laṅkāṃ vadhyamānāḥ plavaṃgamaiḥ

vulgate_text: vajradaṃṣṭraṃ hataṃ śrutvā vāliputreṇa rāvaṇaḥ / balādhyakṣamuvācedaṃ kṛtāñjalimavasthitam
ce_text: dhūmrākṣaṃ nihataṃ śrutvā rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ / balādhyakṣam uvācedaṃ kṛtāñjalim upasthitam

vulgate_text: evamuktvā tu bhartāraṃ rāvaṇaṃ vāhinīpatiḥ / uvācedaṃ balādhyakṣān prahastaḥ purataḥ sthitān
ce_text: evam uktvā tu bhartāraṃ rāvaṇaṃ vāhinīpatiḥ / samānayata me śīghraṃ rākṣasānāṃ mahad balam

vulgate_text: narāntakaḥ kumbhahanurmahānādaḥ samunnataḥ / prahastasacivā hyete niryayuḥ parivārya tam
ce_text: narāntakaḥ kumbhahanur mahānādaḥ samunnataḥ / ete prahastasacivāḥ sarve jaghnur vanaukasaḥ

vulgate_text: meghāśca kharanirghoṣā rathasyopari rakṣasaḥ / vavṛṣū rudhiraṃ cāsya siṣicuśca purassarān
ce_text: vavarṣū rudhiraṃ cāsya siṣicuś ca puraḥsarān / ketumūrdhani gṛdhro 'sya vilīno dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ

vulgate_text: ketumūrdhani gṛdhro 'sya nilīno dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ / tudannubhayataḥ pārśvaṃ samagrāmaharat prabhām

ce_text: sa devagandharvagaṇair abhiṣṭutas tathaiva siddhaiḥ saha cāraṇair api / gabhastibhiḥ sūrya ivaujasā vṛtaḥ pituḥ samīpaṃ prayayau śriyā vṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: bhagavanpūrvamapyeṣā laṅkāsītpiśitāśinām / śrutvedaṃ bhagavadvākyaṃ jāto me vismayaḥ paraḥ
ce_text: bhagavan pūrvam apy eṣā laṅkāsīt piśitāśinām / itīdaṃ bhavataḥ śrutvā vismayo janito mama

vulgate_text: prahetirdhārmikastatra tapovanagatastadā / hetirdārakriyārthe tu paraṃ yatnamathākarot
ce_text: prahetir dhārmikas tatra na dārān so 'bhikāṅkṣati / hetir dārakriyārthaṃ tu yatnaṃ param athākarot

vulgate_text: utsṛṣṭastu tadā garbho ghanaśabdasamasvanaḥ / tayotsṛṣṭaḥ sa tu śiśuḥ śaradarkasamadyutiḥ / nidhāyāsye svayaṃ muṣṭiṃ ruroda śanakaistadā
ce_text: tayotsṛṣṭaḥ sa tu śiśuḥ śaradarkasamadyutiḥ / pāṇim āsye samādhāya ruroda ghanarāḍ iva

vulgate_text: ojastejobalavatāṃ mahatāmātmatejasā / gṛhakartā bhavāneva devānāṃ hṛdayepsitam
ce_text: gṛhakartā bhavān eva devānāṃ hṛdayepsitam / asmākam api tāvat tvaṃ gṛhaṃ kuru mahāmate

vulgate_text: dakṣiṇasyodadhestīre trikūṭo nāma parvataḥ / suvela iti cāpyanyo dvitīyastatra sattamāḥ
ce_text: dakṣiṇasyodadhes tīre trikūṭo nāma parvataḥ / śikhare tasya śailasya madhyame 'mbudasaṃnibhe / śakunair api duṣprāpe ṭaṅkacchinnacaturdiśi

vulgate_text: śaraṇyānyaśaraṇyāni hyāśramāṇi kṛtāni naḥ / svargācca devānpracyāvya svarge krīḍanti devavat
ce_text: śaraṇyāny aśaraṇyāni āśramāṇi kṛtāni naḥ / svargāc ca cyāvitaḥ śakraḥ svarge krīḍanti śakravat

vulgate_text: sa tvamasmaddhitārthāya jahi tānmadhusūdana / śaraṇaṃ tvāṃ vayaṃ prāptā gatirbhava sureśvara
ce_text: sa tvam asmatpriyārthaṃ tu jahi tān madhusūdana / cakrakṛttāsyakamalān nivedaya yamāya vai

vulgate_text: rākṣasānsamare duṣṭānsānubandhānmadoddhatān / nudaṃ tvaṃ no bhayaṃ deva nīhāramiva bhāskaraḥ
ce_text: bhayeṣv abhayado 'smākaṃ nānyo 'sti bhavatā samaḥ / nuda tvaṃ no bhayaṃ deva nīhāram iva bhāskaraḥ

vulgate_text: yo 'sau cakragadāpāṇiḥ pītavāsā janārdanaḥ / harirnārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān śaraṇaṃ taṃ prapadyatha
ce_text: yaḥ sa cakragadāpāṇiḥ pītavāsā janārdanaḥ / haniṣyati sa tān yuddhe śaraṇaṃ taṃ prapadyatha

vulgate_text: hiraṇyakaśipormṛtyuranyeṣāṃ ca suradviṣām / namuciḥ kālanemiśca saṃhrādo vīrasattamaḥ
ce_text: hiraṇyakaśipor mṛtyur anyeṣāṃ ca suradviṣām / duḥkhaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ jetuṃ yo no hantum abhīpsati

vulgate_text: nārāyaṇena nihatāḥ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ / etajjñātvā tu sarveṣāṃ kṣamaṃ kartumihārhatha
ce_text: tathā bāṇā vinirmuktāḥ śārṅgān narāyaṇeritāḥ / nirdhāvantīṣavas tūrṇaṃ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ

vulgate_text: devasāgaramakṣobhyaṃ śastraiḥ samavagāhya ca / jitā dviṣo hyapratimāstanno mṛtyukṛtaṃ bhayam
ce_text: devasāgaram akṣobhyaṃ śastraughaiḥ pravigāhya ca / jitā devā raṇe nityaṃ na no mṛtyukṛtaṃ bhayam

vulgate_text: asthīni meghā vavṛṣuruṣṇaṃ śoṇitameva ca / velāṃ samudrāścotkrāntāśceluścāpyatha bhūdharāḥ
ce_text: asthīni meghā varṣanti uṣṇaṃ śoṇitam eva ca / velāṃ samudro 'py utkrāntaś calante cācalottamāḥ

vulgate_text: aṭṭahāsānvimuñcanto ghananādasamasvanāḥ / vāśyantyaśca śivāstatra dāruṇaṃ ghoradarśanāḥ
ce_text: aṭṭahāsān vimuñcanto ghananādasamasvanān / bhūtāḥ paripatanti sma nṛtyamānāḥ sahasraśaḥ

vulgate_text: sampatantyatha bhūtāni dṛśyante ca yathākramam / gṛdhracakraṃ mahaccātra jvalanodgāribhirmukhaiḥ
ce_text: gṛdhracakraṃ mahac cāpi jvalanodgāribhir mukhaiḥ / rākṣasānām upari vai bhramate kālacakravat

vulgate_text: rākṣasānāmupari khe bhramate 'lātacakravat / kapotā raktapādāśca śārikā vidrutā yayuḥ
ce_text: gṛdhracakraṃ mahac cāpi jvalanodgāribhir mukhaiḥ / rākṣasānām upari vai bhramate kālacakravat

ce_text: sa devasiddharṣimahoragaiś ca gandharvamukhyāpsarasopagītaḥ / samāsasādāmaraśatrusainyaṃ cakrāsisīrapravarādidhārī

vulgate_text: niśācaraistāḍyamāno mīnairiva mahodadhiḥ / śārṅgamāyamya durdharṣo rākṣasebhyo 'sṛjaccharān
ce_text: niśācarais tudyamāno mīnair iva mahātimiḥ / śārṅgam āyamya gātrāṇi rākṣasānāṃ mahāhave

vulgate_text: so 'mbujo hariṇā dhmātaḥ sarvaprāṇena śaṅkharāṭ / rarāsa bhīmanirhādastrailokyaṃ vyathayanniva
ce_text: so 'mbujo hariṇā dhmātaḥ sarvaprāṇena śaṅkharāṭ / rarāsa bhīmanihrādo yugānte jalado yathā

vulgate_text: vraṇāni paragātrebhyo viṣṇucakrakṛtāni vai / asṛkkṣaranti dhārābhiḥ svarṇadhārā ivācalāḥ

vulgate_text: mālinaṃ vimukhaṃ kṛtvā śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ / mālimauliṃ dhvajaṃ cāpaṃ vājinaścāpyapātayat
ce_text: mālinaṃ vimukhaṃ kṛtvā mālimauliṃ harir balāt / rathaṃ ca sadhvajaṃ cāpaṃ vājinaś ca nyapātayat

vulgate_text: tiryagāsthāya saṅkruddhaḥ pakṣīśe bhagavānhariḥ / parāṅmukho 'pyutsasarja māleścakraṃ jighāṃsayā
ce_text: rakṣasāṃ nadatāṃ nādaṃ śrutvā harihayānujaḥ / parāṅmukho 'py utsasarja cakraṃ mālijighāṃsayā

vulgate_text: mālyavantaṃ sthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā mālyavantamivācalam / uvāca rākṣasendraṃ taṃ devarājānujo balī
ce_text: uvāca rākṣasendraṃ taṃ devarājānujo balī / yuṣmatto bhayabhītānāṃ devānāṃ vai mayābhayam / rākṣasotsādanaṃ dattaṃ tad etad anupālyate

vulgate_text: rākṣasendraḥ sa tu tadā vicaranvai mahītalam / tadāpaśyatsa gacchantaṃ puṣpakeṇa dhaneśvaram
ce_text: nīlajīmūtasaṃkāśas taptakāñcanakuṇḍalaḥ / kanyāṃ duhitaraṃ gṛhya vinā padmam iva śriyam / athāpaśyat sa gacchantaṃ puṣpakeṇa dhaneśvaram

vulgate_text: kiṃ kṛtaṃ śreya ityevaṃ vardhemahi kathaṃ vayam / athābravītsutāṃ rakṣaḥ kaikasīṃ nāma nāmataḥ
ce_text: taṃ dṛṣṭvāmarasaṃkāśaṃ gacchantaṃ pāvakopamam / athābbravīt sutāṃ rakṣaḥ kaikasīṃ nāma nāmataḥ

vulgate_text: avicintya tu tāṃ velāṃ dāruṇāṃ pitṛgauravāt / upasṛtyāgratastasya caraṇādhomukhī sthitā / vilikhantī muhurbhūmimaṅguṣṭhāgreṇa bhāminī
ce_text: sā tu tāṃ dāruṇāṃ velām acintya pitṛgauravāt / upasṛtyāgratas tasya caraṇādhomukhī sthitā

vulgate_text: sutābhilāṣo mattaste mattamātaṅgagāmini / dāruṇāyāṃ tu velāyāṃ yasmāttvaṃ māmupasthitā
ce_text: dāruṇāyāṃ tu velāyāṃ yasmāt tvaṃ mām upasthitā / śṛṇu tasmāt sutān bhadre yādṛśāñ janayiṣyasi

vulgate_text: paścimo yastava suto bhaviṣyati śubhānane / mama vaṃśānurūpaḥ sa dharmātmā ca bhaviṣyati
ce_text: athābravīn munis tatra paścimo yas tavātmajaḥ / mama vaṃśānurūpaś ca dharmātmā ca bhaviṣyati

vulgate_text: tau tu tatra mahāraṇye vavṛdhāte mahaujasau / kumbhakarṇadaśagrīvau lokodvegakarau tadā
ce_text: te tu tatra mahāraṇye vavṛdhuḥ sumahaujasaḥ / teṣāṃ krūro daśagrīvo lokodvegakaro 'bhavat

vulgate_text: tatastenaiva kopena daśagrīvaḥ sahānujaḥ / cikīrṣurduṣkaraṃ karma tapase dhṛtamānasaḥ
ce_text: tataḥ krodhena tenaiva daśagrīvaḥ sahānujaḥ / prāpsyāmi tapasā kāmam iti kṛtvādhyavasya ca / āgacchad ātmasiddhyarthaṃ gokarṇasyāśramaṃ śubham

vulgate_text: kumbhakarṇastato yatto nityaṃ dharmapathe sthitaḥ / tatāpa grīṣmakāle tu pañcāgnīnparitaḥ sthitaḥ

vulgate_text: meghāmbusikto varṣāsu vīrāsanamasevata / nityaṃ ca śiśire kāle jalamadhyapratiśrayaḥ
ce_text: varṣe meghodakaklinno vīrāsanam asevata / nityaṃ ca śaiśire kāle jalamadhyapratiśrayaḥ

vulgate_text: punastāni bhaviṣyanti tathaiva tava rākṣasa / vitarāmīha te saumya varaṃ cānyaṃ durāsadam
ce_text: hutāni yāni śīrṣāṇi pūrvam agnau tvayānagha / punas tāni bhaviṣyanti tathaiva tava rākṣasa

vulgate_text: ityuktvā kumbhakarṇāya varaṃ dātumupasthitam / prajāpatiṃ surāḥ sarve vākyaṃ prāñjalayo 'bruvan

vulgate_text: evamastviti taṃ coktvā prāyādbrahmā suraiḥ samam / devī sarasvatī caiva rākṣasaṃ taṃ jahau punaḥ

vulgate_text: kasyacittvatha kālasya vasantaṃ rāvaṇaṃ tataḥ / uktavantaṃ tathā vākyaṃ daśagrīvaṃ niśācaraḥ
ce_text: uktavantaṃ tathā vākyaṃ daśagrīvaṃ niśācaraḥ / prahastaḥ praśritaṃ vākyam idam āha sakāraṇam

vulgate_text: śūnyā sā nagarī laṅkā tyakttvaināṃ dhanado gataḥ / praviśya tāṃ sahāsmābhiḥ svadharmaṃ pratipālaya
ce_text: prahastas tu daśagrīvaṃ gatvā sarvaṃ nyavedayat / śūnyā sā nagarī laṅkā triṃśadyojanam āyatā / praviśya tāṃ sahāsmābhiḥ svadharmaṃ tatra pālaya

vulgate_text: atha dattvā svayaṃ rakṣo mṛgayāmaṭate sma tat / tatrāpaśyattato rāma mayaṃ nāma diteḥ sutam

vulgate_text: varṣaṃ caturdaśaṃ caiva tato hemamayaṃ puram / vajravaiḍūryacitraṃ ca māyayā nirmitaṃ mayā
ce_text: tasyāḥ kṛte ca hemāyāḥ sarvaṃ hemapuraṃ mayā / vajravaidūryacitraṃ ca māyayā nirmitaṃ tadā

vulgate_text: kanyā hi dve kule nityaṃ saṃśaye sthāpya tiṣṭhati / putradvayaṃ mamāpyasyāṃ bhāryāyāṃ sambabhūva ha
ce_text: kanyāpitṛtvaṃ duḥkhaṃ hi narāṇāṃ mānakāṅkṣiṇām / kanyā hi dve kule nityaṃ saṃśaye sthāpya tiṣṭhati

vulgate_text: ahaṃ paulastyatanayo daśagrīvaśca nāmataḥ / munerviśravaso yastu tṛtīyo brahmaṇo 'bhavat
ce_text: evam ukto rākṣasendro vinītam idam abravīt / ahaṃ paulastya tanayo daśagrīvaś ca nāmataḥ

vulgate_text: evamuktastadā rāma rākṣasendreṇa dānavaḥ / maharṣestanayaṃ jñātvā mayo harṣamupāgataḥ / dātuṃ duhitaraṃ tasmai rocayāmāsa yatra vai
ce_text: brahmarṣes taṃ sutaṃ jñātvā mayo harṣam upāgataḥ / dātuṃ duhitaraṃ tasya rocayām āsa tatra vai

vulgate_text: kareṇa tu karaṃ tasyā grāhayitvā mayastadā / prahasanprāha daityendro rākṣasendramidaṃ vacaḥ
ce_text: prahasan prāha daityendro rākṣasendram idaṃ vacaḥ / iyaṃ mamātmajā rājan hemayāpsarasā dhṛtā / kanyā mandodarī nāma patnyarthaṃ pratigṛhyatām

vulgate_text: manoharaṃ sarvasukhaṃ kārayāmāsa rākṣasaḥ / sarvatra sukhadaṃ nityaṃ meroḥ puṇyāṃ guhāmiva
ce_text: dantatoraṇavinyastaṃ vajrasphaṭikavedikam / sarvartusukhadaṃ nityaṃ meroḥ puṇyāṃ guhām iva

vulgate_text: taṃ tatrottamaparyaṅke varāstaraṇaśobhite / upaviṣṭaṃ daśagrīvaṃ dūto vākyamathābravīt
ce_text: tasyopanīte paryaṅke varāstaraṇasaṃvṛte / upaviśya daśagrīvaṃ dūto vākyam athābravīt

vulgate_text: paiṅgalyaṃ yadavāptaṃ hi devyā rūpanirīkṣaṇāt / prīto 'smi tava dharmajña tapasā nena suvrata
ce_text: prīto 'smi tava dharmajña tapasānena suvrata / mayā caitad vrataṃ cīrṇaṃ tvayā caiva dhanādhipa

vulgate_text: sanniviṣṭaṃ girau tasminrākṣasendraṃ niśamya tu / yuddhe 'tyarthakṛtotsāhaṃ durātmānaṃ samantriṇam
ce_text: taṃ niviṣṭaṃ girau tasmin rākṣasendraṃ niśamya tu / rājño bhrātāyam ity uktvā gatā yatra dhaneśvaraḥ

vulgate_text: yakṣā na śekuḥ saṃsthātuṃ pramukhe tasya rakṣasaḥ / rājño bhrāteti vijñāya gatā yatra dhaneśvaraḥ
ce_text: taṃ niviṣṭaṃ girau tasmin rākṣasendraṃ niśamya tu / rājño bhrātāyam ity uktvā gatā yatra dhaneśvaraḥ

vulgate_text: te gatvā sarvamācakhyurbhrātustasya cikīrṣitam / anujñātā yayurhaṣṭā yuddhāya dhanadena te
ce_text: gatvā tu sarvam ācakhyur bhrātus tasya viniścayam / anujñātā yayuś caiva yuddhāya dhanadena te

vulgate_text: tato balānāṃ saṅkṣobho vyavardhata mahodadheḥ / tasya nairṛtarājasya śailaṃ sañcālayanniva
ce_text: tato balasya saṃkṣobhaḥ sāgarasyeva vardhataḥ / abhūn nairṛtarājasya giriṃ saṃcālayann iva

vulgate_text: sa dṛṣṭvā tādṛśaṃ sainyaṃ daśagrīvo niśācaraḥ / harṣanādānbahūnkṛtvā sa krodhādabhyadhāvata
ce_text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛśaṃ sainyaṃ daśagrīvo niśācaraḥ / harṣān nādaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā roṣāt samabhivartata

vulgate_text: sa nirucchvāsavattatra vadhyamāno daśānanaḥ / varṣadbhiriva jīmūtairdhārābhiravarudhyata
ce_text: tair nirucchvāsavat tatra vadhyamāno daśānanaḥ / varṣamāṇair iva ghanair yakṣendraiḥ saṃnirudhyata

vulgate_text: kecitsamāhatā bhagnāḥ patitāḥ samarakṣitau / oṣṭhāṃśca daśanaistīkṣṇairadaśankupitā raṇe
ce_text: ke cit tv āyudhabhagnāṅgāḥ patitāḥ samarakṣitau / oṣṭhān svadaśanais tīkṣṇair daṃśanto bhuvi pātitāḥ

vulgate_text: śrāntāścānyonyamāliṅgya bhraṣṭaśastrā raṇājire / sīdanti ca tadā yakṣāḥ kūlā iva jalena ha
ce_text: bhayād anyonyam āliṅgya bhraṣṭaśastrā raṇājire / niṣedus te tadā yakṣāḥ kūlā jalahatā iva

vulgate_text: tena cakreṇa mārīco viṣṇuneva raṇe hataḥ / patito bhūtale śailātkṣīṇapuṇya iva grahaḥ
ce_text: tena yakṣeṇa mārīco viṣṇuneva samāhataḥ / patitaḥ pṛthivīṃ bheje kṣīṇapuṇya ivāmbarāt

vulgate_text: tatastoraṇamutpāṭya tena yakṣeṇa tāḍitaḥ / rudhiraṃ prasravanbhāti śailo dhātusravairiva
ce_text: tatas toraṇam utpāṭya tena yakṣeṇa tāḍitaḥ / rākṣaso yakṣasṛṣṭena toraṇena samāhataḥ / na kṣitiṃ prayayau rāma varāt salilayoninaḥ

vulgate_text: evamukto mahābāhurmāṇibhadraḥ sudurjayaḥ / vṛto yakṣasahasraistu caturbhiḥ samayodhayat
ce_text: tatra māṇicāro nāma yakṣaḥ paramadurjayaḥ / vṛto yakṣasahasraiḥ sa caturbhiḥ samayodhayat

vulgate_text: te gadāmusalaprāsaiḥ śaktitomaramudgaraiḥ / abhighnantastadā yakṣā rākṣasānsamupādravan
ce_text: te gadāmusalaprāsaśaktitomaramudgaraiḥ / abhighnanto raṇe yakṣā rākṣasān abhidudruvuḥ

vulgate_text: yakṣāṇāṃ tu prahastena sahasraṃ nihataṃ raṇe / mahodareṇa cānindyaṃ sahasramaparaṃ hatam
ce_text: tataḥ prahastena tadā sahasraṃ nihataṃ raṇe / mahodareṇa gadayā sahasram aparaṃ hatam

vulgate_text: tāḍito māṇibhadrasya mukuṭe prāharadraṇe / tasya tena prahārema mukuṭaṃ pārśvamāgatam
ce_text: tato rākṣasarājena tāḍito gadayā raṇe / tasya tena prahāreṇa mukuṭaḥ pārśvam āgataḥ / tadā prabhṛti yakṣo 'sau pārśvamaulir iti smṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: tataḥ saṃyudhyamānena viṣṭabdho na vyakampata / tadāprabhṛti yakṣo 'sau pārśvamauliriti smṛtaḥ / sannādaḥ sumahānrājaṃstasminśaile 'bhyavartata
ce_text: tato rākṣasarājena tāḍito gadayā raṇe / tasya tena prahāreṇa mukuṭaḥ pārśvam āgataḥ / tadā prabhṛti yakṣo 'sau pārśvamaulir iti smṛtaḥ

vulgate_text: buddhirūpaṃ phalaṃ putrāñchauryaṃ dhīratvameva ca / prāpnuvanti narā loke nirjitaṃ puṇyakarmabhiḥ

ce_text: na khalv idānīṃ paśyāmi duḥkhasyāntam ihātmanaḥ / aho dhin mānuṣāṃl lokān nāsti khalv adhamaḥ paraḥ

vulgate_text: sūryeṇodayatā kāle nakṣatrāṇīva nāśitāḥ / aho subalavadrakṣo vadhopāyeṣu yujyate
ce_text: aho subalavad rakṣo vadhopāyeṣu rajyate / aho durvṛttam ātmānaṃ svayam eva na budhyate

vulgate_text: aho durvṛttamāsthāya nātmānaṃ vaijugupsate / sarvathā sadṛśastāvadvikramo 'sya durātmanaḥ
ce_text: sarvathā sadṛśas tāvad vikramo 'sya durātmanaḥ / idaṃ tv asadṛśaṃ karma paradārābhimarśanam

vulgate_text: idaṃ tvasadṛśaṃ karma paradārābhimarśanam / yasmādeṣa parakyāsu ramate rākṣasādhamaḥ
ce_text: sarvathā sadṛśas tāvad vikramo 'sya durātmanaḥ / idaṃ tv asadṛśaṃ karma paradārābhimarśanam

vulgate_text: tasmādvai strīkṛtenaiva prāpsyate durmatirvadham / satībhirvaranārībhirevaṃ vākye 'bhyudīrite
ce_text: yasmād eṣa parakhyāsu strīṣu rajyati durmatiḥ / tasmād dhi strīkṛtenaiva vadhaṃ prāpsyati vāraṇaḥ

vulgate_text: nedurdundubhayaḥ khasthāḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ca / śaptaḥ strībhiḥ sa tu samaṃ hataujā iva niṣprabhaḥ
ce_text: śaptaḥ strībhiḥ sa tu tadā hatatejāḥ suniṣprabha / pativratābhiḥ sādhvībhiḥ sthitābhiḥ sādhu vartmani

vulgate_text: pativratābhiḥ sādhvībhirbabhūva vimanā iva / evaṃ vilapitaṃ tāsāṃ śṛṇvanrākṣasapuṅgavaḥ / praviveśa purīṃ laṅkāṃ pūjyamāno niśācaraiḥ
ce_text: evaṃ vilapamānāsu rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ / praviveśa purīṃ laṅkāṃ pūjyamāno niśācaraiḥ

vulgate_text: ete rājaṃstvayā vīrā daityā vinihatā raṇe / kālakeyā iti khyātāḥ sahasrāṇi caturdaśa
ce_text: ete viryāt tvayā rājan daityā vinihatā raṇe / kālakeyā iti khyātā mahābalaparākramāḥ

vulgate_text: so 'pi tvayā hatastāta ripuṇā bhrātṛgṛdhnunā / tvayā 'smi nihatā rājansvayameva hi bandhunā
ce_text: yā tvayāsmi hatā rājan svayam eveha bandhunā / duḥkhaṃ vaidhavyaśabdaṃ ca dattaṃ bhokṣyāmy ahaṃ tvayā

vulgate_text: rājanvaidhavyaśabdaṃ ca bhokṣyāmi tvatkṛte hyaham / nanu nāma tvayā rakṣyo jāmātā samareṣvapi / sa tvayā nihato yuddhe svayameva na lajjase
ce_text: nanu nāma tvayā rakṣyo jāmātā samareṣv api / taṃ nihatya raṇe rājan svayam eva na lajjase

vulgate_text: alaṃ vatse ruditvā te na bhetavyaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ / dānamānaprasādaistvāṃ toṣayiṣyāmi yatnataḥ
ce_text: alaṃ vatse viṣādena na bhetavyaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ / mānadānaviśeṣais tvāṃ toṣayiṣyāmi nityaśaḥ

vulgate_text: jāmātaraṃ na jāne sma praharanyuddhadurmadaḥ / tenāsau nihataḥ saṅkhye mayā bhartā tava svasaḥ
ce_text: yuddhe pramatto vyākṣipto jayakāṅkṣī kṣipañ śarān / nāvagacchāmi yuddheṣu svān parān vāpy ahaṃ śubhe / tenāsau nihataḥ saṃkhye mayā bhartā tava svasaḥ

vulgate_text: tatra mātṛṣvaseyaste bhrātā 'yaṃ vai kharaḥ prabhuḥ / bhaviṣyati tavādeśaṃ sadā kurvanniśācaraḥ
ce_text: tatra mātṛṣvasuḥ putro bhrātā tava kharaḥ prabhuḥ / bhaviṣyati sadā kurvan yad vakṣyasi vacaḥ svayam

vulgate_text: tato nikumbhilā nāma laṅkopavanamuttamam / tadrākṣasendro balavānpraviveśa sahānugaḥ
ce_text: tato nikumbhilā nāma laṅkāyāḥ kānanaṃ mahat / mahātmā rākṣasendras tat praviveśa sahānugaḥ

vulgate_text: taṃ samāsādya laṅkeśaḥ pariṣvajvātha bāhubhiḥ / abravītkimidaṃ vatsa vartase brūhi tattvataḥ
ce_text: rakṣaḥpatiḥ samāsādya samāśliṣya ca bāhubhiḥ / abravīt kim idaṃ vatsa vartate tad bravīhi me

vulgate_text: ehīdānīṃ kṛtaṃ viddhi sukṛtaṃ tanna saṃśayaḥ / āgaccha saumya gacchāmaḥ svameva bhavanaṃ prati
ce_text: ehīdānīṃ kṛtaṃ yad dhi tad akartuṃ na śakyate / āgaccha saumya gacchāmaḥ svam eva bhavanaṃ prati

vulgate_text: kumbhakarṇe mahārāja nidrāmanubhavatyatha / nihatya rākṣasaśreṣṭhānamātyāniha sammatān
ce_text: nihatya rākṣasaśreṣṭhān amātyāṃs tava saṃmatān / dharṣayitvā hṛtā rājan guptā hy antaḥpure tava

vulgate_text: yasmādavaśyaṃ dātavyā kanyā bhartre hi bhrātṛbhiḥ / tadetatkarmaṇo hyasya phalaṃ pāpasya durmate
ce_text: śrutvā tv etan mahārāja kṣāntam eva hato na saḥ / yasmād avaśyaṃ dātavyā kanyā bhartre hi dātṛbhiḥ / asminn evābhisaṃprāptaṃ loke viditam astu te

vulgate_text: asminnevābhisamprāptaṃ loke viditamastu te / vibhīṣaṇavacaḥ śrutvā rākṣasendraḥ sa rāvaṇaḥ / daurātmyenātmanoddhūtastaptāmbha iva sāgaraḥ
ce_text: śrutvā tv etan mahārāja kṣāntam eva hato na saḥ / yasmād avaśyaṃ dātavyā kanyā bhartre hi dātṛbhiḥ / asminn evābhisaṃprāptaṃ loke viditam astu te

vulgate_text: udite vimale candre tulyaparvatavarcasi / prasuptaṃ sumahatsainyaṃ nānāpraharaṇāyudham
ce_text: udite vimale candre tulyaparvatavarcasi / sa dadarśa guṇāṃs tatra candrapādopaśobhitān

vulgate_text: rāvaṇastu mahāvīryo niṣaṇṇaḥ śailamūrdhani / sa dadarśa guṇāṃstatra candrapādapaśobhitān
ce_text: udite vimale candre tulyaparvatavarcasi / sa dadarśa guṇāṃs tatra candrapādopaśobhitān

vulgate_text: divyacandanaliptāṅgī mandārakṛtamūrdhajā / divyotsavakṛtārambhā pūrṇacandranibhānanā
ce_text: etasminn antare tatra divyapuṣpavibhūṣitā / sarvāpsarovarā rambhā pūrṇacandranibhānanā

vulgate_text: babhāvanyatameva śrīkāntidyutimatihriyām / nīlaṃ satoyameghābhaṃ vastraṃ samavakuṇṭhitā
ce_text: kṛtair viśeṣakair ārdraiḥ ṣaḍartukusumotsavaiḥ / nīlaṃ satoyameghābhaṃ vastraṃ samavaguṇṭhitā

vulgate_text: athābravīddaśagrīvaścaraṇādhomukhīṃ sthitām / romaharṣamanuprāptāṃ dṛṣṭamātreṇa tāṃ tadā
ce_text: abravīt tāṃ daśagrīvaś caraṇādhomukhīṃ sthitām / sutasya yadi me bhāryā tatas tvaṃ me snuṣā bhaveḥ

vulgate_text: jñātvā lokagatiṃ sarvāṃ tasya mṛtyuṃ ca rakṣasaḥ / ṛṣayaḥ pitaraścaiva prītimāpuranuttamām
ce_text: prajāpatimukhāś cāpi sarve devāḥ praharṣitāḥ / jñātvā lokagatiṃ sarvāṃ tasya mṛtyuṃ ca rakṣasaḥ

vulgate_text: varapradānādbalavānna khalvanyena hetunā / tattu satyavacaḥ kāryaṃ yaduktaṃ padmayoninā
ce_text: varapradānād balavān na khalv anyena hetunā / tac ca satyaṃ hi kartavyaṃ vākyaṃ deva prajāpateḥ

vulgate_text: nahyanyo devadeveśa tvāmṛte madhusūdana / gatiḥ parāyaṇaṃ nāsti trailokye sacarācare
ce_text: na hy anyo deva devānām āpatsu sumahābala / gatiḥ parāyaṇaṃ vāsti tvām ṛte puruṣottama

vulgate_text: tvaṃ hi nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmānpadmanābhaḥ sanātanaḥ / tvayeme sthāpitā lokāḥ śakraścāhaṃ sureśvaraḥ
ce_text: tvaṃ hi nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān padmanābhaḥ sanātanaḥ / tvayāhaṃ sthāpitaś caiva devarājye sanātane

vulgate_text: tadācakṣva yathā tattvaṃ devadeva mama svayam / api cakrasahāyastvaṃ yotsyase rāvaṇaṃ prabho
ce_text: tad ākhyāhi yathātattvaṃ devadeva mama svayam / asicakrasahāyas tvaṃ yudhyase saṃyuge ripum

vulgate_text: na tāvadeṣa duṣṭātmā śakyo jetuṃ surāsuraiḥ / hantuṃ cāpi samāsādya varadānena durjayaḥ
ce_text: na tāvad eṣa durvṛttaḥ śakyo daivatadānavaiḥ / hantuṃ yudhi samāsādya varadānena durjayaḥ

vulgate_text: yattu māṃ tvamabhāṣiṣṭha yuddhyasveti sureśvara / nāhaṃ taṃ pratiyotsyāmi rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasaṃ yudhi
ce_text: bravīṣi yat tu māṃ śakra saṃyuge yotsyasīti ha / naivāhaṃ pratiyotsye taṃ rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasādhipam

vulgate_text: nāhatvā samare śatruṃ viṣṇuḥ pratinivartate / durlabhaścaiva kāmo 'dya varaguptāddhi rāvaṇāt
ce_text: anihatya ripuṃ viṣṇur na hi pratinivartate / durlabhaś caiṣa kāmo 'dya varam āsādya rākṣase

vulgate_text: ahameva nihantā 'smi rāvaṇaṃ sapuraḥsaram / devatā nandayiṣyāmi jñātvā kālamupāgatam / etatte kathitaṃ tattvaṃ devarāja śacīpate
ce_text: aham enaṃ vadhiṣyāmi rāvaṇaṃ sasutaṃ yudhi / devatās toṣayiṣyāmi jñātvā kālam upasthitam

vulgate_text: yāmi jñātvā kālamupāgatam / tato rudrāḥ sahādityā vasavo maruto 'śvanau / sannaddhā niryayustūrṇaṃ rākṣasānabhitaḥ purāt
ce_text: aham enaṃ vadhiṣyāmi rāvaṇaṃ sasutaṃ yudhi / devatās toṣayiṣyāmi jñātvā kālam upasthitam

vulgate_text: saṃhlādo dhūmaketuśca mahādaṃṣṭro ghaṭodaraḥ / jambumālī mahāhrādo virūpākṣaśca rākṣasaḥ
ce_text: saṃhrādir dhūmaketuś ca mahādaṃṣṭro mahāmukhaḥ / jambumālī mahāmālī virūpākṣaś ca rākṣasaḥ

vulgate_text: devāśca rākṣasānghorānmahābalaparākramān / samare vimalaiḥ śastrairupaninyuryamakṣayam
ce_text: surās tu rākṣasān ghorān mahāvīryān svatejasā / samare vividhaiḥ śastrair anayan yamasādanam

vulgate_text: tato vidrāvyamāṇeṣu daivateṣu sumālinā / vasūnāmaṣṭamaḥ kruddhaḥ sāvitro vai vyavasthitaḥ
ce_text: tato vidrāvyamāṇeṣu tridaśeṣu sumālinā / vasūnām aṣṭamo devaḥ sāvitro vyavatiṣṭhata

vulgate_text: tataḥ pragṛhya dīptāgrāṃ kāladaṇḍopamāṃ gadām / tāṃ mūrdhni pātayāmāsa sāvitro vai sumālinaḥ
ce_text: tāṃ pradīptāṃ pragṛhyāśu kāladaṇḍanibhāṃ śubhām / tasya mūrdhani sāvitraḥ sumāler vinipātayat

vulgate_text: sā tasyopari colkābhā patantīva babhau gadā / indrapramuktā garjantī girāviva mahāśaniḥ
ce_text: tasya mūrdhani solkābhā patantī ca tadā babhau / sahasrākṣasamutsṛṣṭā girāv iva mahāśaniḥ

vulgate_text: tasya naivāsthi na śiro na māṃsaṃ dadṛśe tadā / gadayā bhasmatāṃ nītaṃ nihatasya raṇājire
ce_text: tasya naivāsthi kāyo vā na māṃsaṃ dadṛśe tadā / gadayā bhasmasādbhūto raṇe tasmin nipātitaḥ

vulgate_text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā nihataṃ saṅkhye rākṣasāste samantataḥ / vyadravansahitāḥ sarve krośamānāḥ parasparam / vidrāvyamāṇā vasunā rākṣasā nāvatasthire
ce_text: taṃ dṛṣṭvā nihataṃ saṃkhye rākṣasās te samantataḥ / dudruvuḥ sahitāḥ sarve krośamānā mahāsvanam

vulgate_text: na babhūva tadā kaścidyuyutsorasya sammukhe / sarvānāviddhya vitrastāṃstataḥ śakro 'bravītsurān
ce_text: na tatrāvasthitaḥ kaś cid raṇe tasya yuyutsataḥ / sarvān āvidhya vitrastān dṛṣṭvā śakro 'bhyabhāṣata

vulgate_text: śacīsutaścāpi tathā jayantastasya sārathim / taṃ cāpi rāvaṇiḥ kruddhaḥ samantātpratyavidhyata
ce_text: śacīsutas tv api tathā jayantas tasya sārathim / taṃ caiva rāvaṇiṃ kruddhaḥ pratyavidhyad raṇājire

vulgate_text: sa hi krodhasamāviṣṭo balī visphāritekṣaṇaḥ / rāvaṇiḥ śakratanayaṃ śaravarṣairavākirat
ce_text: tataḥ kruddho mahātejā rakṣo visphāritekṣaṇaḥ / rāvaṇiḥ śakraputraṃ taṃ śaravarṣair avākirat

vulgate_text: nābhyajānanta cānyonyaṃ rakṣo vā devatā 'thavā / tatra tatra viparyastaṃ samantātparidhāvati
ce_text: nābhyajānaṃs tadānyonyaṃ śatrūn vā daivatāni vā / tatra tatra viparyastaṃ samantāt paridhāvitam

vulgate_text: saṅgṛhya taṃ tu dauhitraṃ praviṣṭaḥ sāgaraṃ tadā / āryakaḥ sa hi tasyāsītpulomā yena sā śacī
ce_text: gṛhītvā taṃ tu naptāraṃ praviṣṭaḥ sa mahodadhim / mātāmaho 'ryakas tasya paulomī yena sā śacī

vulgate_text: jñātvā praṇāśaṃ tu tadā jayantasyātha devatāḥ / aprahṛṣṭāstataḥ sarvā vyathitāḥ sampradudruvuḥ
ce_text: praṇāśaṃ dṛśya tu surā jayantasyātidāruṇam / vyathitāś cāprahṛṣṭāś ca samantād vipradudruvuḥ

vulgate_text: dṛṣṭvā praṇāśaṃ putrasya daivateṣu ca vidrutam / mātaliṃ cāha deveśo rathaḥ samupanīyatām
ce_text: dṛṣṭvā praṇāśaṃ putrasya rāvaṇeś cāpi vikramam / mātaliṃ prāha devendro rathaḥ samupanīyatām

vulgate_text: tato meghā rathe tasmiṃstaḍittvanto mahābalāḥ / agrato vāyucapalā neduḥ paramaniḥsvanāḥ
ce_text: tato meghā rathe tasmiṃs taḍidvanto mahāsvanāḥ / agrato vāyucapalā gacchanto vyanadaṃs tadā

vulgate_text: nānāvādyāni vādyanta gandharvāśca samāhitāḥ / nanṛtuścāpsaraḥsaṅghā niryāte tridaśeśvare
ce_text: nānāvādyāni vādyanta stutayaś ca samāhitāḥ / nanṛtuś cāpsaraḥsaṃghāḥ prayāte vāsave raṇam

vulgate_text: tāṃ praviśya mahāmāyāṃ prāptāṃ gopatinā purā / praviveśa susaṃrabdhastatsainyaṃ samabhidravat
ce_text: sa tāṃ praviśya māyāṃ tu dattāṃ gopatinā purā / adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tat sainyaṃ samavākirat

vulgate_text: sa sarvā devatāstyaktvā śakramevābhyadhāvata / mahendraśca mahātejā nāpaśyacca sutaṃ ripoḥ
ce_text: tataḥ sa devān saṃtyajya śakram evābhyayād drutam / mahendraś ca mahātejā na dadarśa sutaṃ ripoḥ

vulgate_text: taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā balāttena nīyamānaṃ mahāraṇāt / mahendramamarāḥ sarve kiṃ nu syādityacintayan
ce_text: taṃ dṛṣṭvātha balāt tasmin māyayāpahṛtaṃ raṇe / mahendram amarāḥ sarve kiṃ nv etad iti cukruśuḥ / na hi dṛśyati vidyāvān māyayā yena nīyate

vulgate_text: etasminnantare kruddhāḥ sarve suragaṇāstadā / rāvaṇaṃ vimukhīkṛtya śaravarṣairavākiran
ce_text: etasminn antare cāpi sarve suragaṇās tadā / abhyadravan susaṃkruddhā rāvaṇaṃ śastravṛṣṭibhiḥ

vulgate_text: rāvaṇastu samāsādya ādityāṃśca vasūṃstadā / na śaśāka sa saṅgrāme yoddhuṃ śatrubhirarditaḥ
ce_text: rāvaṇas tu samāsādya vasvādityamarudgaṇān / na śaśāka raṇe sthātuṃ na yoddhuṃ śastrapīḍitaḥ

vulgate_text: āgaccha tāta gacchāmo raṇakarma nivartatām / jitaṃ no viditaṃ te 'stu svastho bhava gatajvaraḥ
ce_text: āgaccha tāta gacchāvo nivṛttaṃ raṇakarma tat / jitaṃ te viditaṃ bho 'stu svastho bhava gatajvaraḥ

vulgate_text: yatheṣṭaṃ bhuṅkṣva lokāṃstrīnnigṛhyārātimojasā / vṛthā kiṃ te śrameṇeha yuddhamadya tu niṣphalam
ce_text: yatheṣṭaṃ bhuṅkṣva trailokyaṃ nigṛhya ripum ojasā / vṛthā te kiṃ śramaṃ kṛtvā yuddhaṃ hi tava niṣphalam

vulgate_text: ayaṃ ca putro 'tibalastava rāvaṇa vīryavān / jagatīndrajidityeva parikhyāto bhaviṣyati
ce_text: ayaṃ ca putro 'tibalas tava rāvaṇarāvaṇiḥ / indrajit tv iti vikhyāto jagaty eṣa bhaviṣyati

vulgate_text: balavāndurjayaścaiva bhaviṣyatyeva rākṣasaḥ / yaṃ samāśritya te rājansthāpitāstridaśā vaśe
ce_text: balavāñ śatrunirjetā bhaviṣyaty eṣa rākṣasaḥ / yam āśritya tvayā rājan sthāpitās tridaśā vaśe

vulgate_text: tato 'bravīnmahātejā meghanādaṃ prajāpatiḥ / nāsti sarvāmaratvaṃ hi kasyacitprāṇino bhuvi / catuṣpadaḥ pakṣiṇaśca bhūtānāṃ vā mahaujasām
ce_text: abravīt tu tadā devo rāvaṇiṃ kamalodbhavaḥ / nāsti sarvāmaratvaṃ hi keṣāṃ cit prāṇināṃ bhuvi

vulgate_text: vaṃ hi kasyacitprāṇino bhuvi / athābravītsa tatrasthaṃ meghanādo mahābalaḥ / śrūyatāṃ vā bhavetsiddhiḥ śatakratuvimokṣaṇe
ce_text: athābravīt sa tatrastham indrajit padmasaṃbhavam / śrūyatāṃ yā bhavet siddhiḥ śatakratuvimokṣaṇe

vulgate_text: tato mayā rūpaguṇairahalyā strī vinirmitā / halaṃ nāmeha vairūpaṃ halyaṃ tatprabhavaṃ bhavet
ce_text: tato mayā rūpaguṇair ahalyā strī vinirmitā / ahalyety eva ca mayā tasyā nāma pravartitam

vulgate_text: yasmānna vidyate halyaṃ tenāhalyeti viśrutā / ahalyeti mayā śakra tasyā nāma pravartitam
ce_text: tato mayā rūpaguṇair ahalyā strī vinirmitā / ahalyety eva ca mayā tasyā nāma pravartitam

vulgate_text: tadāprabhṛti bhūyiṣṭhaṃ prajā rūpasamanvitāḥ / sā taṃ prasādayāmāsa maharṣiṃ gautamaṃ tadā
ce_text: tadā prabhṛti bhūyiṣṭhaṃ prajā rūpasamanvitāḥ / śāpotsargād dhi tasyedaṃ muneḥ sarvam upāgatam

vulgate_text: tapaścācāra sumahatsā patnī brahmavādinaḥ / śāpotsargāddhi tasyedaṃ muneḥ sarvamupasthitam
ce_text: tadā prabhṛti bhūyiṣṭhaṃ prajā rūpasamanvitāḥ / śāpotsargād dhi tasyedaṃ muneḥ sarvam upāgatam

vulgate_text: bhagavanrākṣasaḥ krūro yadāprabhṛti medinīm / paryaṭatkiṃ tadā lokāḥ śūnyā āsandvijottama

ce_text: dṛṣṭaḥ saṃbhāṣitaś cāsi rāma gacchamahe vayam / evam uktvā gatāḥ sarve ṛṣayas te yathāgatam

vulgate_text: bharato lakṣmaṇaścaiva śatrughnaśca mahābalāḥ / ādāya tāni ratnāni svāṃ purīṃ punarāgatāḥ
